answer: Black point ki wajah se atta ki rangat dark ho sakti hai aur kuch buyers rate kam laga dete hain; kitna farq parta hai ye buyer ki quality demand aur infected grain ke proportion par depend karta hai.

text: Gandum ki jadon ke qareeb siah pan aur kamzor tillers common root rot ki nishani ho sakte hain kya?
label: disease
answer: Jadon ke qareeb bhoora ya siah pan, roots ka sadi hui soorat aur kamzor tillers jo pani milne ke bawajood recover nahi hotay, yeh sab common root rot ki taraf ishara karte hain, sirf drought se aise nishan kam hi bante hain.

text: Lagatar aik hi khet mein gandum bone se jad ki sadi hui bimariyan kyun barh jati hain?
label: disease
answer: Lagatar cereal cropping se fungus ko har saal host milta rehta hai, jis se soil mein us ki abadi barh jati hai; rotation se is silsile ko todna zaroori hota hai.

text: Barani zameen mein kharab drainage aur pani rukne se jad ki bimariyan zyada hoti hain ya kam?
label: disease
answer: Kharab drainage aur pani rukne se jadow par oxygen kam milti hai, pauda kamzor hota aur fungus ka hamla asaan ho jata hai, is liye aise halat mein root rot zyada dekhi jati hai.

text: Common root rot se bachne ke liye rotation mein kaun si fasslein dalna behtar rahega?
label: disease
answer: Rotation mein legumes, oilseed ya doosri non‑cereal fasslein dalne se root rot ke pathogens ko host nahi milta, is se un ki tadaad kam hoti aur agle wheat crop ka risk ghata jata hai.

text: Gandum ke kuch baal safed aur jaldi sookh gaye, lekin neeche ka hissa sab theek hai; kya ye sar par kisi fugal hamle ki nishani hai?
label: disease
answer: Agar sirf kuch saron par safed pan ho aur neeche ka hissa abhi sabz ho to ye aksar sar par kisi fungal ya physiological masley ki taraf ishara karta hai, is mein head blast, FHB ya severe stem damage shamil ho sakte hain.

text: Sar ke daane agar aadhe pakay aur aadhe sikkhay hon to kya isay head blast kaha jata hai?
label: disease
answer: Jahan sar ke kuch spikelets gulabi ya sikkhay ho kar jaldi sookh jayein aur baqi hissa normal ho, log aksar use head blast ke naam se pukarte hain; asal tashkhees ke liye nazdeek se dekhna zaroori hota hai.

text: Gandum ke sar per bemauqa safedi aajaye to is stage par kis qisam ki ehtiyat karni chahiye?
label: disease
answer: Aisi surat mein saron ki tasveer, sample aur field ka record sambhal kar rakhein, nitrogen aur pani ka balance check karein aur aglay saal ke liye resistant variety aur heading ke qareeb fungicide par gaur karein.

text: Zyada nitrogen heading ke qareeb dene se sar ki bimariyan kyun barh jati hain?
label: disease
answer: Zyada nitrogen se paude bohat lush aur ghane ho jate hain, jis se humidity barh kar sar ki bimariyon jaise blast aur FHB ke jarasim ko asan mahool mil jata hai.

text: Gandum ke baalo par halka gulabi ya surkh rang ka maaloom honay par kya mujhe fusal se danay alag rakhne chahiye?
label: disease
answer: Gulabi ya surkh fungus wale danon mein mycotoxin ka khatra hota hai, is liye in ko seed ke tor par bilkul use na karein aur feed ke liye bhi expert mashwara le kar hi istemal karein.

text: Maiz ke baad gandum lagane se sar ki fusal ke andar gulabi sadi hui bimari ka khatra kyun barhta hai?
label: disease
answer: Maiz residues Fusarium ka bohat bara source hotay hain, is liye maize ke baad wheat mein FHB aur related sar ki bimariyon ka risk zyada hota hai; residue management aur rotation is risk ko kam karte hain.

text: Gandum ke neeche wale hisay par siah aur bhura pan, sath hi plant ka chhota reh jana, foot rot ki taraf ishara karta hai kya?
label: disease
answer: Stem base aur crown ka siah, bhoora aur soggy hona, sath hi plant ka chhota aur kam tillers wala reh jana foot rot ki aam nishaniyan hain jo sirf nutrient kami se kam hi milti hain.

text: Pani ka lamba arsa jad ke gird khara rehne se foot rot aur crown rot kitna barh sakta hai?
label: disease
answer: Jitna zyada pani lamba arsa jad ke gird khara rahe ga, utni hi jad kamzor aur fungus mazboot hoti jayegi, is liye waterlogging se foot rot ki intensity bohat barh sakti hai.

text: Beds par bone se foot rot jesi bimariyon mein kahan tak kami aasakti hai gandum mein?
label: disease
answer: Beds par bone se jad ka hissa zameen se thora ooncha rehta hai, pani jaldi nikal jata aur hawa dari behtar hoti hai, jis se foot rot jesi bimariyon ka khatra kam ho jata hai.

text: Patton par lambay bhure daag jo aapas mein mil kar bara daagh bana dein, kya ye leaf blight hai ya kuch aur?
label: disease
answer: Lambay bhure daag jin ke gird peeli halo ho aur jo aapas mein mil kar bara necrotic area bana dein, aksar leaf blight/spot blotch ki nishani hotay hain; simple tip burn aksar sirf kinare se shuru hota hai.

text: Zyada ghaNta aur tez pani dene se leaf blight jesi pattay ki bimariyan kyun barh jati hain?
label: disease
answer: Zyada ghaNta, bohat gehri sinchai aur residues se humidity barh jati hai, ye sab conditions leaf blight ke jarasim ke liye ideal hoti hain jis se bimari tezi se phailti hai.

text: Agar tillering ke qareeb hi pattay par daag nazar aane lagain to kya is stage par dawai fayda degi?
label: disease
answer: Agar tillering ke qareeb hi daag numaya dikhne lagen aur mausam mozoon ho to is stage per ki gayi fungicide spray aksar baad ke damage ko kaafi had tak rok sakti hai.

text: Gandum ke patton ke upar safed mehl jesi parat ban jaye to isay powdery mildew kehte hain kya?
label: disease
answer: Ji haan, patton par dhoodh jesa safed mehl ki parat jo ungli se ragarne par hata jaye, khas tor par upper leaves par, powdery mildew ki classic nishani hai.

text: Powdery mildew se bachne ke liye gandum ki ghaNta kam rakhnay aur hawa dari barhane ka kya faida hai?
label: disease
answer: Kam ghaNta se hawa zyada guzar sakti hai aur pattay jaldi sookh jate hain, jis se powdery mildew aur doosri leaf diseases ke liye anukool nami kam ho jati hai.

text: Sasta gandhak chhidak kar powdery mildew ko control karna chhote kisaan ke liye kaisa raasta hai?
label: disease
answer: Gandhak sasti aur chhote kisano ke liye moujood dawai hai, jo powdery mildew ke khilaf kaafi asar andaaz ho sakti hai agar sahi waqt aur sahi matra mein chhidki jaye.

text: Agar season ke aakhir mein powdery mildew aaye to kya phir bhi dawai chhidakna zaroori hota hai?
label: disease
answer: Agar powdery mildew sirf season ke bilkul aakhir mein aaye jab dana lag bhag poora bhar chuka ho to aksar spray se khaas faida nahi hota, is liye late appearance par aam tor par dawai ki zarurat kam hoti hai.

text: Septoria jese pattay ke daagh mein chhote chhote kaale nukat dikhai dene par kiya samajhna chahiye?
label: disease
answer: Septoria jese daagon mein andar chhote chhote kaale nok jese dhabbay (pycnidia) dikhai dete hain, ye nishani use doosri leaf spot bimariyon se mukhtalif banati hai.

text: Pichli fasal ke bhusay ko khuli zameen par chhor dene se Septoria aur tan spot ka khatra kyun barh jata hai?
label: disease
answer: Bhusa aur residue jo zameen ki satah par rehte hain un par Septoria aur tan spot ke jarasim zinda bach jate hain, aglay season mein barish ke chhenthon ke zariye ye patton tak pohanch kar infection barhate hain.

text: Kya sirf rotation aur residue kam karne se tan spot jesi bimari ko kabu mein laya ja sakta hai?
label: disease
answer: Low pressure halat mein achhi rotation, residue ko jaldi tor kar mitti mein mila dena aur sahi variety ka intikhab tan spot ko kafi had tak control mein rakh sakta hai, lekin high pressure saalon mein phir bhi spray ki zarurat par sakti hai.

text: Smutt wali gandum mein daanon ki jagah kaala mail jese gola kyun ban jata hai?
label: disease
answer: Smutt mein normal dana nahi banta, us ki jagah fungus ka kaala mail jese gole bante hain jo tootne par hawa mein udd jate hain aur pass wale danon aur seed ko contaminate kar dete hain.

text: Agar aik saal smutt zyada ho to aglay saal ke liye seed ke sath kya salook karna chahiye?
label: disease
answer: Agle saal ke liye sirf certified ya bilkul saaf seed ka istemal karein aur usay mazboot fungicidal seed treatment ke sath treat karein; smutt wali fasal ka seed reuse na karein.

text: Garam pani se beej dhone ka tareeqa smutt ke khilaf chhote kisaan ke liye kitna mushkil ya asaan hai?
label: disease
answer: Garam pani se treatment technical kaam hai jisme hararat aur waqt ka bohat khayal rakhna padta hai; chhote kisaan ke liye agar sahi saaz o saman na ho to ready made seed dresser ka istemal ziyada asaan rehta hai.

text: Tan spot mein daagon ke gird peeli halqay dikhai dene se ye bimari doosri leaf spot se kaise mukhtalif lagti hai?
label: disease
answer: Tan spot ke daagon ke tan rang ke gird peeli halo aur kabhi kabhi center mein chhota sa dark spot hota hai, jab ke doosri spots mein ya to halo nahi hota ya pattern mukhtalif hota hai.

text: Kya tan spot aur zang ek sath ho sakte hain gandum mein aur is surat mein dawai ka intikhab kaise karein?
label: disease
answer: Haan, tan spot aur zang ek hi khet mein ho sakte hain; aisi surat mein aisi fungicide chunni chahiye jo dono par asar rakhti ho aur spray ka waqt flag leaf ko protect karne ke hisab se rakha jaye.

text: Gandum ke khet mein itni saari bimariyon ke bawajood spray ki ginti kam rakhne ka sab se acha tareeqa kya hai?
label: general_info
answer: Sab se acha tareeqa yeh hai ke resistant kisam, rotation, balanced khaad, timely sowing aur threshold based scouting ka istemal karein taa ke sirf un hi saalon aur hisson mein spray ho jahan waqai zarurat ho.

text: Kya aik hi dawai ko bar bar istemal karne se jarasim us ke khilaf mazboot ho jate hain?
label: general_info
answer: Aik hi zehr ko bar bar istemal karne se jarasim dheere dheere us se bachna seekh jate hain jise resistance kehte hain; is liye modes of action rotate karna bohat zaroori hai.

text: Gandum ke spray ka record diary mein rakhne se aglay saal behtar faislay kaise liye ja sakte hain?
label: general_info
answer: Spray ka record rakhne se aap dekh sakte hain kis product, kis dose aur kis stage per kitna faida hua, is se aglay saal behtar combination aur kam ghaltiyon wala plan ban sakta hai.

text: Integrated tareeqe se pests aur bimariyon ko control karne ka matlab kya hai gandum ke kisan ki zubaan mein?
label: general_info
answer: Integrated tareeqa ka matlab hai ke hum sirf zehr par nahi, balki resistant variety, rotation, healthy soil, faida mand keere aur sahi waqt per limited spray sab ko mila kar pests aur diseases ko control karen.

text: Kya hum padosi kisanon ke sath mil kar aik hi waqt par zang aur chust keeron ke khilaf kdam utha kar behtar natija hasil kar sakte hain?
label: general_info
answer: Ji haan, agar gaon ke kisan mil kar ek hi waqt par zang ke khilaf spray karein ya volunteer plants hata dein to jarasim ke liye bachne ki jagah kam rehti hai aur area level par bimari kam hoti hai.

text: Gandum ke sprays mein sab se aam ghaltiyan kaun si hoti hain jo chhote kisaan ko nuksan pohanchati hain?
label: general_info
answer: Aam ghaltiyon mein andaza se dose lagana, dhoop aur hawa mein spray karna, label na parhna, har masle ke liye sirf aik hi dawai use karna aur waiting period ka khayal na rakhna shamil hain.

text: Mobile se tasveer bhej kar bimari ki pehchan karwana aam kisan ke liye kitna madadgar sabit ho sakta hai?
label: general_info
answer: Mobile se clear tasveer bhejne se expert ko nishaniyaan seedhi nazar aati hain, jisse ghalat tashkhees ka imkaan kam hota aur aap ko zyada munasib mashwara milta hai.

text: Chhote chhote hisson mein alag alag tareeqe azma kar dekhna gandum mein behtar management seekhne ka sasta tareeqa hai ya nahi?
label: general_info
answer: Chhote plots ya strips mein mukhtalif tareeqe azma kar un ka nateeja dekhna sasti learning hai; is se aap dekh sakte hain ke kis combination se aap ke khet mein sab se behtar natija nikalta hai.

text: Kya zyada ghaNta kam karke seed rate thora kam rakhne se gandum mein bimari ka khatra kam hoga?
label: disease
answer: Bohat high fertility fields mein seed rate thora kam rakhne se ghaNta kam hota, hawa zyada guzar sakti aur kuch bimariyon ka khatra kam ho sakta hai, lekin rate itna kam na ho ke paidawar hi gir jaye.

text: Season ke aakhir mein agar sirf upar ke patton par halka daag ho to kya is waqt dawai se koi khaas faida hota hai?
label: disease
answer: Agar fasal almost mature ho, flag leaf zyada tar sookh chuki ho aur disease late stage par aaye to is waqt spray se paidawar mein bohat kam faida hota hai, is liye late season sprays aksar munafa bakhsh nahi rehte.

text: Gandum ke har saal ke photos aur notes sambhal kar rakhne se aane walay saalon mein kya faida mil sakta hai?
label: general_info
answer: Har saal ke photos aur notes se aap dekh sakte hain kis halat mein kaunsi bimari barhi, kis spray ne kaam kiya aur kya ghalti hui; ye sab future planning ko mazboot banata hai.

text: Kya fasal ke andar se kuch khet ko bilkul spray se bachakar rakhna comparison ke liye achha tajurba ho sakta hai?
label: general_info
answer: Chhota untreated hissa rakh kar aap compare kar sakte hain ke spray se asal mein kitna faida hua; is se anuman lagana asaan ho jata hai ke aglay saal isi spray mein paisa lagana chahiye ya nahi.

text: Waqt par scouting na karne se chust, zang aur doosri bimariyan itni phail jati hain ke dawai bhi kam asar dikhanay lagti hai, is baat ko kaise yaad rakha jaye?
label: general_info
answer: Jab tak aap khet ka chakkar nahi lagate, chust, zang aur doosri bimariyan chup kar tezi se barh sakti hain; is liye apne aap se wada karein ke har haftay kam az kam aik dafa poore khet ka ghoom kar jaiza zaroor lengay.

text: Har spray se pehle minimum kaun kaun si hifazati cheezen pehn kar gandum mein spray karna chahiye?
label: general_info
answer: Kam az kam dastanay, mask ya kapa jaisa mooh dhakne ka saman, lambi aastinon wali qameez aur band jootay pehn kar spray karna chahiye taa ke zehr jild ya saans ke zariye kam se kam jism mein jaye.

text: Khaali dabbon ko khet ke qareeb phainkne ki bajaye theek tareeqe se zaya karne ki ahmiyat kya hai?
label: general_info
answer: Khaali dabbon ko naalon, kheton ya agri waste ke sath phenkne se pani aur mitti dono aaloood ho jate hain; unhein teen dafa dho kar surakh karein aur safe jagah par daba den ya collection point per jama kar dein.

text: Gandum ke khet mein agar kuch hisson par bohat gehra pani aur kuch par sukhapan ho to pests aur bimariyon ka pattern kaise badalta hai?
label: general_info
answer: Jahan pani zyada der khara hota hai wahan diseases aur root rot barh sakti hain, jab ke bohat sukhay hisay stress ki wajah se pests aur kuch nutrient issues ka shikar ho jate hain; ye patchy condition overall management ko mushkil banati hai.

text: Kya ghoom phir kar rotation mein doodhiya ya danedaar fodder rakhne se gandum ke pests aur diseases mein kami dekhi gayi hai?
label: general_info
answer: Rotation mein doodhiya ya danedaar fodder rakhne se soil ka cycle badalta, pests aur diseases ka host toot ta aur organic matter barhta, jis se aglay wheat crop par risk kam ho sakta hai.

text: Gandum ke saste aur mehngay tareeqon ka muqabla karne ke liye simple hisab kitab kaisa hona chahiye?
label: general_info
answer: Simple hisab kitab mein har input (beej, khaad, spray, pani, labour) ka kharcha likhein, phir harvest ke baad total aamdani se minus kar ke dekhein ke kis jaga kharcha zyada aur faida kam tha.

text: Kya faida mand keeron ki pehchan ke posters ya calendar deewar par latkana kisan ke liye rozana yaad dehani ka kaam kar sakta hai?
label: general_info
answer: Posters ya calendar roz dekhne se kisan ko faida mand keeron ki shakal yaad rehti hai, jis se wo unhein ghalti se zehr se nahi marte aur IPM soch dimaag mein tazaa rehti hai.

text: Gandum ke kisan ke liye sab se pehla signal kya hota hai ke ab khet ka chakkar lagane ka waqt aa gaya hai?
label: general_info
answer: Jab aap ko lagay ke aglay kuch dinon mein weather mein tabdeeli aa rahi hai, ya fasal naye stage mein ja rahi ho (jaise tillering, booting), ya pichle chakkar ko ek haftay se zyada ho gaya ho to ye signal hai ke ab khet dekhna zaruri hai.

text: Agar sard mosamon mein lambi baarish ho jaye to gandum ke pattay aur saron per kaun kaun si bimariyan achanak zyada ho sakti hain?
label: disease
answer: Lambi barish aur nami se leaf blight, rust, FHB aur black point jesi bimariyan achanak barh sakti hain; is liye aise mosam ke foran baad gandum ka qareeb se jaiza lena bohat ahm hota hai.

text: Gandum ki planning mein pani, zehr aur mehnat teenon ko ek sath dekh kar faisla karna kyun zaroori hai?
label: general_info
answer: Agar aap sirf yield dekhen aur mehnat, pani, zehr ka kharcha na ginen to asal munafa samajh nahi aata; teeno cheezon ko ek sath dekh kar hi decide ho sakta hai ke kaun sa tareeqa waqai faida mand hai.

text: Kya chhota kisan mobile par seedhi seedhi checklist bana kar har spray se pehle usay dekh kar ghaltiyan kam kar sakta hai?
label: general_info
answer: Ji haan, ek simple checklist jisme dose, weather, PPE, nozzle check jaise points hon, har spray se pehle dekhne se ghaltiyon ka imkaan bohat kam ho jata hai.

text: Gandum ke khet mein bohat kam qismon par depend rehne se disease risk barhta hai ya kam hota hai?
label: disease
answer: Sirf chand limited qismon par depend rehna agar sab susceptible niklein to kisi naye rust race ke aane par bara risk ban jata hai; kuch diverse resistant varieties ka mix is risk ko kam karta hai.

text: Kya har gaon ke kisan mil kar apne apne tajurbe likh kar ek chhoti si kitab bana sakte hain jo aglay saal gandum ke liye rehnuma bane?
label: general_info
answer: Haan, kisan apne local tajurbe, photos aur noton ko jama kar ke ek chhota manual bana sakte hain jo us ilaqe ke mosam, zameen aur market ke mutabiq sab se zyada relevant hota hai.

text: Gandum ki fassal mein bachon ko bhi field visit par le jana un ko future farming ke liye kis had tak motivate kar sakta hai?
label: general_info
answer: Bachon ko field visits par le jane se wo plant, mitti aur mehnat se qareeb ho kar seekhte hain, jis se un mein future farming ke liye dilchaspi aur zimmedari ka ehsaas barhta hai.

text: My wheat has insects what to do?
label: pest
answer: Spray a recommended insecticide when pest count crosses the threshold; use correct dose and spray in cooler hours. For aphids, target undersides of leaves.

text: When to give water to wheat?
label: irrigation
answer: Give first irrigation around 20–25 days after sowing at crown-root stage; then at tillering, booting, flowering and grain filling. Gap is often 12–20 days.

text: Wheat leaves are yellow why?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Yellow leaves often mean nitrogen deficiency; topdress with urea at tillering. If zinc deficient, use zinc sulphate or foliar zinc spray as recommended.

text: How to control weeds in wheat?
label: weed_control
answer: Spray recommended herbicide for wheat when weeds are small, usually 25–35 days after sowing. Use grass or broad-leaf product as per weed type; follow label.

text: Best time to sow wheat?
label: sowing
answer: Best time is late October to mid-November in most areas. Use recommended seed rate per acre, line sowing 3–5 cm depth, and treat seed before sowing.

text: Wheat crop has disease help.
label: disease
answer: For rust, spray a recommended systemic fungicide at first signs; use resistant varieties and avoid late sowing. For smut, treat seed with fungicide before next sowing.

text: Fertilizer for wheat per acre?
label: fertilizer
answer: Apply DAP and part of urea at sowing; split rest of nitrogen at first irrigation and tillering. Dose depends on soil test and yield target.

text: How many irrigations for wheat?
label: irrigation
answer: Critical stages are crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering and grain filling. Missing water at these times can cut yield; avoid over-irrigation to prevent lodging.

text: Wheat ready for harvest when?
label: harvest
answer: Harvest when grain is hard, straw yellow and moisture in safe range. Dry grain well before storage; keep in clean, dry bags or bins away from moisture.

text: I have sown wheat last week when should I give the first water and what is the right gap between two irrigations?
label: irrigation
answer: First irrigation for wheat is usually given around 20–25 days after sowing, at the crown-root initiation stage. The gap between two irrigations depends on soil and weather: generally 12–20 days for medium soils. After that, give water at tillering, booting, flowering and grain filling; missing these stages can reduce yield.

text: Meri gandum ki fasal mein patte zard ho rahe hain aur thore kamzor lag rahe hain kya wajah ho sakti hai?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Zard patte aur kamzor plants aksar nitrogen ki kami ya zinc deficiency ki wajah se hote hain. Pehle check karein ke purane patte zard hain (N kami) ya naye patton par safed lakeeren (zinc). N kami ho to urea topdress karein tillering par; zinc kami ho to zinc sulphate ya foliar zinc spray use karein. Pani bhi theek rakhein taake roots khaad sookh sakein.

text: There are too many weeds in my wheat field and I missed the first spray what should I do now?
label: weed_control
answer: If you missed the first spray, apply post-emergence herbicide as soon as weeds are still small, usually within 25–35 days after sowing. Use a product recommended for wheat and match it to your weed type (grass or broad leaf). Do not mix with urea unless the label allows it; spray in calm weather and follow the correct dose to avoid crop damage.

text: Gandum bone ka behtar waqt kab hai aur kitna beej per acre dalna chahiye?
label: sowing
answer: Gandum bone ka behtar waqt zyada tar ilaqon mein late October se mid-November hota hai. Per acre recommended seed rate use karein (region aur variety ke hisaab se, aam tor par 40–50 kg). Line sowing 3–5 cm gehrayi par karein aur bone se pehle seed treatment zaroor karein taake smut aur bunt se bachav ho.

text: My crop has got some disease leaves have yellow and brown spots and I am worried
label: disease
answer: Yellow and brown spots on leaves can be rust (yellow, brown or black pustules) or other leaf diseases. First identify: rust has powdery pustules that rub off. Spray a recommended systemic fungicide at early signs and repeat if needed; also avoid excess nitrogen and prefer resistant varieties. If unsure, send a photo to your extension officer or use the crop clinic.

text: Khaad kab dalni chahiye aur urea aur DAP dono kitni kitni per acre?
label: fertilizer
answer: Bone par DAP ya phosphorus source dalen (soil test ke mutabiq, aam tor par 1–2 bag DAP per acre). Urea ko split karein: ek hissa bone par ya pehle pani ke sath, doosra tillering par topdress. Total nitrogen per acre local recommendation follow karein; barani mein thori kam aur irrigated mein full dose.

text: Wheat is almost ready but I am not sure when exactly to harvest and how to know grain is ready
label: harvest
answer: Wheat is ready for harvest when the grain is hard, straw has turned yellow and moisture has dropped to a safe level (around 12–15%). Test by pressing a grain with your nail: if it does not dent easily, it is ready. Harvest at the right time to avoid shattering loss or too-wet grain; use combine with correct setting or manual harvest with care.

Dose aur waiting period label par follow karein. Agar faida mand keere (jaise ladybird) bhi hain to selective insecticide prefer karein.

text: I want to know the best wheat variety for my area and when to sow after rice harvest
label: sowing

Chawal kattai ke baad jald se jald gandum boen, aam tor par late October se mid-November tak. Khet tayari, certified beej aur seed treatment use karein taake stand achha ho.

text: Pehla pani bone ke kitne din baad dena chahiye aur kitni dafa pani dena hai total?
label: irrigation
answer: Pehla pani bone ke 20–25 din baad dein, jab crown-root stage ho. Total irrigations zameen aur mausam par depend karti hain: aam tor par 4–6 pani canal areas mein. Do paniyon ke beech 12–20 din ka gap rakhein; raiti zameen par kam gap, bhari zameen par zyada. Critical stages hain: crown-root, tillering, booting, phool aur grain filling.

text: Yellow rust has appeared on my wheat leaves what spray should I use and when?
label: disease
answer: Yellow rust (stripe rust) peeli pustules patton par dikhata hai. Jald systemic fungicide chhidkain jo rust ke liye recommend ho; coverage achha hona chahiye. Doosri spray 10–14 din baad zarurat ho to karein. Resistant variety agle saal ke liye use karein aur der bone se bachein.

text: Jhariyan zyada ho gayi hain ab weedicide chhidkain ya haath se godai karein?
label: weed_control
answer: Agar jhariyan chhoti hain (25–35 din tak) to post-emergence weedicide chhidkain; product wheat ke liye aur jhari ki qism (grass/broad leaf) ke mutabiq ho. Jhariyan zyada badi hon to pehle haath se godai karein phir baqi ke liye spray. Tank mix sirf tab karein jab label allow kare.

text: How much nitrogen and phosphorus should I apply at sowing and when to give top dressing?
label: fertilizer
answer: At sowing apply full dose of phosphorus (DAP or SSP) and potash if needed; apply one-third to half of nitrogen as basal. Give first top dressing at crown-root or first irrigation, and second at tillering or early stem elongation. Total N and P per acre should follow local recommendation based on soil test and yield target.

text: Gandum kaatne ke baad dana kaise sukhaen aur store karein taake keerey na lagain?
label: harvest

Saaf, sukhi boriyon ya bins mein store karein; keerey se bachav ke liye fumigation ya recommended treatment use karein. Godown dry aur hawa daar rakhein.

text: Government support price kya hai is saal aur procurement center kahan hai?
label: market_price
answer: Support price har saal sarkar announce karti hai; agri department ya news se check karein. Procurement centers ki list food department, agri office ya local Kisan call center se milegi. Bechnay se pehle grain saaf, sukha aur grade karein taake reject na ho.

text: Aphids have come on wheat ears in large number which insecticide is safe and effective?
label: pest
answer: Aphids on ears in large number need timely spray. Use an insecticide recommended for wheat aphid at the correct dose; spray in cooler part of the day for better effect. Target the ears and upper leaves; repeat only if population builds again and follow the waiting period before harvest.

text: Chawal ke baad gandum kab boen aur khet ki tayari kaise karein?
label: sowing
answer: Chawal ke baad jald gandum boen, aam tor par late October se mid-November. Khet tayari: chawal ki residual ko manage karein, zameen bareek karein aur level karein. Zero till drill ya happy seeder use karein agar available ho; warna normal preparation ke baad line sowing karein. Certified beej aur seed treatment zaroori hain.

text: I gave first irrigation late will it affect yield and what to do for next irrigations?
label: irrigation
answer: First irrigation late dene se early growth aur tillering kam ho sakti hai. Ab critical stages—tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling—par pani time par dein. Doosre paniyon ka gap 12–18 din rakhein. Agar zameen zyada sukhi hai to ek light irrigation jald dein; us ke baad schedule theek rakhein.

text: Pattay pe peeli peeli daag aur bhoora powder nazar aa raha hai zang to nahi?
