text: Weeds are competing with crop when is the right time for post emergence herbicide?
label: weed_control
answer: Post-emergence herbicide ka sahi waqt jab wheat 2–3 leaf stage se aage ho aur jhariyan chhoti hon, aam tor par 25–35 din after sowing. Product wheat ke liye aur weed type (grass ya broad leaf) ke mutabiq chunien. Dose aur nozzle label par follow karein; hawa zyada ho to spray na karein.

text: Urea kab dalen pehli pani se pehle ya baad mein aur kitni dafa?
label: fertilizer
answer: Urea pehle pani ke sath ya us ke foran baad dalen; pehli dose sowing/crown-root par aur doosri tillering par. Kitni dafa: aam tor par 2–3 split (basal + tillering + kabhi booting). Per acre total nitrogen local recommendation follow karein; zyada tar 1.5–2 bag urea equivalent use hoti hai.

text: Harvest time is near how to reduce shattering loss and when to use combine?
label: harvest
answer: Shattering loss kam karne ke liye sahi waqt par kattai karein jab grain hard ho lekin zyada sookha na ho. Combine use karein to drum speed aur concave setting theek karein; manual threshing mein dheere kaatein. Garm dhoop aur tez hawa mein kattai avoid karein.

text: Mandi mein rate check kaise karein aur beopari se behtar rate kaise lein?
label: market_price
answer: Mandi rate rozana mandi office, SMS service ya agri app se check karein. Beopari se behtar rate lene ke liye rate pehle jaan lain, grain saaf aur grade karein, aur agar possible ho to do teen dukandar se rate puchen. Group selling ya cooperative bhi option hai.

text: Termite is damaging wheat roots and stems what treatment to do?
label: pest
answer: Termite ke liye field drainage theek karein taake pani khara na rahe. Seed treatment insecticide se karein; soil mein termite ho to recommended termiticide use karein. Purani stubble jalaen ya hataen; FYM agar dalen to bilkul galay hui use karein.

text: Barani ilaqe mein gandum kab boen aur beej ki kitni quantity per acre?
label: sowing
answer: Barani ilaqe mein barish ke hisaab se boen: aam tor par late October se mid-November jab nami enough ho. Seed rate irrigated se thori zyada rakhein (45–55 kg/acre) taake stand achha aaye. Drought tolerant aur early variety prefer karein; local agri office se list lein.

text: Canal water is short how to manage wheat irrigation and which stages are most critical?
label: irrigation
answer: Canal shortage mein critical stages par pani dena sab se zaroori hai: crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering aur grain filling. In mein se booting aur grain filling sab se sensitive hain. Pani bachane ke liye ridges ya beds use karein, field level theek rakhein aur zyada evaporation wale din avoid karein.

text: Smut ya bunt lag rahi hai beej agli fasal ke liye kaise safe karun?
label: disease
answer: Smut/bunt se bachne ke liye agli fasal ka beej certified ya bilkul saaf use karein. Fungicidal seed treatment zaroor karein (systemic product jo bunt/smut ke khilaf ho). Smut wali fasal ka beej dobara na use karein. Treatment ke baad beej ko shade mein sukhaen.

text: Broad leaf and grass dono weeds hain kaun sa spray use karein?
label: weed_control
answer: Agar dono qism ki jhariyan (broad leaf aur grass) hain to do alag spray kar sakte hain ya woh product use karein jo dono par label pe allow ho. Pehle grass control phir broad leaf ya reverse, label ke mutabiq. Tank mix sirf tab karein jab dono products ki label allow kare.

text: Soil is low in fertility how much extra fertilizer and which type for wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: Low fertility soil mein soil test ke mutabiq dose barhaen; NPK balanced rakhein. Zyada tar 1.5–2x normal dose use hoti hai; phosphorus aur organic matter (FYM/compost) zyada dena faida mand hai. Zinc aur boron agar soil mein kami hon to add karein. Split nitrogen zaroori hai.

text: Kattai ke baad bhoosa ka kya karein charay ya bech kar paise len?
label: harvest
answer: Bhoosa charay ke tor par use kar sakte hain ya bech kar paise le sakte hain. Agar baler hai to bale bana kar bechna behtar; nahi to loose bhoosa bhi mandi mein bikta hai. Kuch kisan ise next crop ke liye mulch ya bed planting mein use karte hain.

text: I need loan for wheat crop where to apply and what documents are needed?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Wheat crop loan ke liye bank, agriculture department ya Kisan scheme office mein apply karein. Documents mein zameen ke kaghzat, CNIC, aur application form hota hai. Kisan card ya kissan loan scheme ki details local bank ya agri office se lein. Eligibility aur interest rate wahan confirm karein.

text: Chust keera patton par bahut hai spray kab karein subah ya sham?
label: pest
answer: Chust (aphid) par spray subah ya sham ko karein jab hawa thandi ho; dhoop mein spray kam asar karti hai. Recommended insecticide sahi dose par use karein; patton ke niche bhi coverage dein. Hadd se zyada hone par hi spray karein taake faida mand keere bach jayein.

text: Late November sowing is still okay or yield will be less what to do?
label: sowing
answer: Late November sowing ab bhi theek hai lekin yield thori kam ho sakti hai. Seed rate thori barha den (5–10% zyada); der se tillering kam hoti hai. Resistant variety aur balanced khaad den; critical irrigations time par dein. December mein bone se bachain jitna ho sake.

text: Pani zyada de diya hai khet mein pani khara hai kya nuqsan hoga?
label: irrigation
answer: Pani zyada hone se waterlogging ho sakti hai; is se jaden galti hain, plants kamzor aur bimariyan barh sakti hain. Ab pani nikalne ka bandobast karein (drainage); zameen ko hawa lagnay dein. Agli irrigations mein gap barha kar pani kam dein. Waterlogging wale hisse mein khaad ka effect bhi kam hota hai.

text: Rust is spreading in my field which fungicide and how many sprays needed?
label: disease
answer: Rust ke liye systemic fungicide use karein jo leaf/stripe/stem rust ke khilaf recommend ho. Pehli spray jald karein jab pehli nishani dikhe; doosri 10–14 din baad agar disease pressure bari ho. Coverage achha hona chahiye; resistant variety agle saal use karein.

text: Weedicide aur urea ek sath mix karke chhidkain to chalega?
label: weed_control
answer: Weedicide aur urea ka tank mix sirf tab karein jab dono products ki label allow kare. Kaheen label pe likha hota hai ke urea ke sath mix na karein. Agar mix allowed hai to sahi order aur dilution follow karein. Best practice: alag alag din spray karein taake crop safe rahe.

text: When to give second dose of nitrogen and how much for good tillering?
label: fertilizer
answer: Second dose of nitrogen (top dressing) tillering stage par dein, aam tor par bone ke 40–50 din baad ya pehle pani ke 15–20 din baad. Per acre local recommendation follow karein; zyada tar 0.5–1 bag urea. Pani de kar ya light irrigation ke baad dalen taake sookh na jaye.

text: Grain moisture at harvest should be how much for safe storage?
label: harvest
answer: Grain moisture at harvest for safe storage usually 12–14% ya us se kam honi chahiye. Zyada nami se storage mein fungus aur keerey lagte hain. Moisture meter se check karein; nahi ho to grain ko dant se test karein (sakht, toot na sake). Sukhane ke baad hi store karein.

text: Sarkari procurement mein bechna better hai ya mandi mein?
label: market_price
answer: Sarkari procurement mein support price milti hai aur payment direct; lekin timing aur quality rules follow karne padte hain. Mandi mein kabhi rate zyada mil sakta hai lekin beopari commission aur delay bhi hota hai. Apni zarurat aur local rate dekh kar decide karein; dono options ki list rakh lain.

text: Keeron ne nuqsan kar diya ab spray kiya hai kya aur bhi chhidkain?
label: pest
answer: Spray ke baad agar keerey phir bhi zyada hain ya naye aaye hain to doosri spray kar sakte hain, lekin waiting period (label par) harvest se pehle follow karein. Doosri spray alag mode of action wala product use karein taake resistance na bane. Faida mand keeron ko bachane ke liye selective insecticide prefer karein.

text: Zero till drill se gandum bone ka faida kya hai aur kab use karein?
label: sowing
answer: Zero till drill se gandum bone se waqt aur diesel bachta hai, moisture bachti hai aur soil structure behtar rehta hai. Chawal ke baad stubble rehne dete hain aur seed usi mein place karte hain. Use tab karein jab chawal jald katti ho aur gandum ka time aa raha ho; drill ki setting sahi honi chahiye.

text: First water after sowing when exactly and how much gap to next irrigation?
label: irrigation
answer: First water usually 20–25 days after sowing at crown-root stage dein. Next irrigation ka gap 12–20 days rakhein (soil type par depend). Critical stages: crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling. In stages par pani na chhorna yield ke liye bahut zaroori hai.

text: Leaf blight ya spot disease lag rahi hai fungicide kaun si?
label: disease
answer: Leaf blight ya spot disease ke liye fungicide use karein jo wheat ke leaf spots ke khilaf recommend ho (tan spot, septoria, etc.). Spray jald karein jab pehli daag dikhein; coverage achha hona chahiye. Resistant variety aur balanced nitrogen bhi madad karte hain.

text: Pre emergence weedicide use kiya nahi ab post emergence kab chhidkain?
label: weed_control
answer: Pre emergence miss hone par post-emergence herbicide use karein jab jhariyan chhoti hon, aam tor par 25–35 din after sowing. Product wheat ke liye aur weed type ke mutabiq chunien. Dose sahi rakhein; zyada tar 2,4-D ya clodinafop jaisi products use hoti hain. Label parhen.

text: DAP and urea ratio per acre for wheat and when to apply each?
label: fertilizer
answer: DAP and urea ratio: bone par 1–2 bag DAP (P fix) aur urea ka hissa (1/3 se 1/2 N); baqi urea pehle pani aur tillering par topdress. Total per acre soil test aur target yield se decide hota hai; aam tor par 1.5–2 bag urea aur 1–2 bag DAP. Potash agar soil test mein kam ho to add karein.

text: Combine se kaatne par setting kaise karein taake nuqsan kam ho?
label: harvest
answer: Combine ki drum speed aur concave clearance theek karein taake dana tootey kam aur straw sahi cut ho. Manual mein setting guide ke mutabiq karein. Kattai thandi subah ya sham ko karein; garmi mein shattering zyada hoti hai. Field ki condition ke hisaab se speed adjust karein.

text: Crop insurance for wheat how to get and is it useful?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Crop insurance wheat ke liye bank ya insurance company se le sakte hain; premium sarkar subsidize karti hai. Nuqsan (frost, hail, flood) hone par claim file karte hain; survey ke baad compensation milti hai. Useful hai kyunke ek bura saal bhi loss thora cover ho jata hai. Details agri office ya bank se lein.

text: Armyworm is cutting wheat plants at base what to spray?
label: pest
answer: Armyworm ke liye recommended insecticide use karein jo armyworm/cutworm ke khilaf wheat par allow ho. Spray sham ko karein jab larvae zyada active hon; coverage crop canopy tak hona chahiye. Field edges aur dense patches par zyada dhyan dein. Early detection se ek hi spray kaafi ho sakti hai.

text: Cotton kattai ke baad gandum kab tak bo len aur seed rate?
label: sowing
answer: Cotton kattai ke baad jald gandum boen, aam tor par late October tak. Seed rate normal ya thori zyada (cotton ke baad zameen thori kam fertile ho sakti hai). Zero till drill use karein agar available ho; cotton stalks ko manage karein taake drill atakay na.

text: Sandy soil hai pani jaldi sookh jata hai irrigation ka schedule kya rakhein?
label: irrigation
answer: Raiti zameen mein pani jaldi sookh jata hai is liye pani ka gap kam rakhein, aam tor par 10–15 din. Kam pani lekin bar bar dein taake percolation kam ho. Mulching ya residue cover se nami bachti hai. Critical stages (crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling) par pani zaroor dein.

text: Powdery mildew on wheat leaves what is the treatment?
label: disease
answer: Powdery mildew patton par safed powder jaisa dikhata hai. Fungicide use karein jo powdery mildew ke khilaf wheat par recommend ho; sulphur ya triazole products kaam karti hain. Spray jald karein; coverage achha hona chahiye. Resistant variety aur balanced nitrogen se bachav better hai.

text: Jhariyan resistant ho gayi hain puri spray kaam nahi kar rahi kya karein?
label: weed_control
answer: Resistant jhariyan ke liye alag mode of action wala herbicide use karein; same product bar bar na chhidkain. Rotation mein different herbicide (grass vs broad leaf) use karein. Hand weeding se bachi hui jhariyan hataen. Agli fasal ke liye weed-free seed aur clean equipment use karein.

text: FYM or compost with chemical fertilizer for wheat how much to use?
label: fertilizer
answer: FYM ya compost well decomposed honi chahiye; 2–4 ton per acre theek hai. Chemical fertilizer ke sath dein: DAP/urea ki full dose na ghatayein, FYM extra benefit ke liye. Sowing se pehle mix karein taake galay ho. Is se zameen behtar rehti hai aur pani hold karti hai.

text: Storage mein dana ko keerey se kaise bachain?
label: harvest
answer: Storage keerey se bachane ke liye dana bilkul sukha store karein (nami 12–14% se kam). Boriyon ko fumigation ya recommended storage insecticide se treat karein. Godown dry, hawa daar aur clean rakhein. Check karte rahein; keerey dikhein to phir treatment karein.

text: Quality wheat ka zyada rate milta hai grading kaise karein?
label: market_price
answer: Quality wheat ke liye grain saaf karein, mote danay alag karein aur test weight behtar rakhein. Grading se premium rate milta hai; mandi ya procurement center ki quality standards follow karein. Storage mein bhi saaf aur sukha rakhein taake bechte waqt reject na ho.

text: Natural way se keeron ko control kar sakte hain bina zehr ke?
label: pest
answer: Natural control: faida mand keere (ladybird, parasitoids) bachain; broad-spectrum spray kam karein. Neem oil ya neem-based product early stage par try kar sakte hain. Field sanitation rakhein; stubble jalaen ya galay karein. Threshold par hi spray karein taake balance bana rahe.

text: Seed treatment before sowing is necessary for wheat and with what?
label: sowing
answer: Seed treatment wheat ke liye zaroori hai taake smut, bunt aur kuch soil-borne diseases na aayein. Fungicide (systemic) jo seed-borne diseases ke khilaf ho use karein; insecticide treatment bhi termite/soil pests ke liye kar sakte hain. Treatment ke baad beej ko shade mein sukha kar sow karein.

text: Critical stages for wheat irrigation please tell all and gap between each
label: irrigation
answer: Critical stages for wheat irrigation: crown-root initiation (20–25 days after sowing), tillering, booting, flowering aur grain filling. In panch stages par pani na chhorna chahiye. Gap between irrigations: 12–20 days zameen ke hisaab se; raiti zameen par kam, bhari zameen par zyada.

text: Karnal bunt ki pehchan kya hai aur beej se kaise bachain?
label: disease
answer: Karnal bunt danon ko kaala, fishy smell ke sath banata hai; kuch danay spike mein affected hote hain. Beej se bachne ke liye certified/clean seed use karein aur fungicidal seed treatment zaroor karein. Infected grain alag karein aur beej ke liye use na karein.

text: Hand weeding and spray dono karna padega ya sirf spray kaafi hai?
label: weed_control
answer: Choti jhariyan hon to sirf spray kaafi ho sakti hai; badi jhariyan hon to pehle godai karein phir baqi ke liye spray. Mix situation mein dono karna behtar: spray se zyada hissa control, godai se border aur bachi hui jhariyan. Time par control zaroori hai (25–35 din).

text: Zinc deficiency in wheat leaves white stripes what to apply?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: White stripes on young leaves often indicate zinc deficiency. Apply zinc sulphate to soil at sowing or use foliar zinc spray at tillering. Repeat foliar spray if symptoms persist; follow recommended dose. Balanced NPK bhi rakhein taake zinc uptake theek ho.

text: Top dressing of urea at tillering stage how much per acre?
label: fertilizer
answer: Top dressing at tillering: aam tor par 0.5–1 bag urea per acre, local recommendation follow karein. Pehle pani dein phir urea dalen ya light irrigation dein taake sookh na jaye. Doosri dose booting stage par bhi de sakte hain agar target yield high ho.

text: Harvest ke baad grain ko dry karke store karne ka tareeqa?
label: harvest
answer: Kattai ke baad grain ko patli layer mein faila kar dhoop mein sukhaen; roz palattein. Safe storage ke liye nami 12–14% tak laen. Phir saaf boriyon ya bins mein store karein; keerey se bachav ke liye fumigation ya recommended treatment. Godown dry aur hawa daar rakhein.

text: Forward selling ya contract farming wheat ke liye kya faida?
label: market_price
answer: Forward selling ya contract se aap rate pehle fix kar lete hain; rate girne ka risk kam hota hai. Nuqsan ye hai ke rate barh jaye to faida nahi milta. Contract ki terms aur payment time clearly jaan lain. Local trader ya mill se contract karte waqt rate compare karein.

text: Rodent is damaging wheat in field how to control?
label: pest
answer: Rodent control: field edges aur bunds saaf rakhein; burrows dhoond kar band karein. Poison bait (safety se) use kar sakte hain; bachon aur janwaron se door rakhein. Trap bhi kaam karte hain. Storage godown ko rodent-proof rakhein; darwazay aur cracks band karein.

text: Rice wheat rotation mein gandum bone ka exact time kya hai?
label: sowing
answer: Rice-wheat rotation mein gandum bone ka exact time chawal kattai ke baad jald, aam tor par late October se mid-November. Jitna jaldi ho sake prepare karke boen taake terminal heat na lage. Zero till ya happy seeder use karein agar available ho; seed rate aur fertilizer full dein.

text: Over irrigation se kya problem hoti hai aur pani ka gap kitna rakhein?
label: irrigation
answer: Over irrigation se waterlogging, root rot, lodging aur bimariyan barh sakti hain. Pani ka gap 12–20 din rakhein; zameen type dekh kar. Zyada pani na dein; critical stages par hi focus karein. Drainage theek rakhein taake pani khara na rahe.

text: Septoria or tan spot on wheat which fungicide to use?
label: disease
answer: Septoria ya tan spot ke liye fungicide use karein jo leaf spot diseases ke khilaf wheat par recommend ho. Spray jald karein jab pehli daag dikhein; coverage achha hona chahiye. Resistant variety aur crop rotation bhi madad karte hain. Nitrogen zyada na dein.

text: Cultural methods se jhariyan kaise control karein spray ke ilawa?
label: weed_control
answer: Cultural control: line sowing, sahi plant population, timely irrigation aur crop rotation jhariyan kam karte hain. Stale seedbed: pehle pani dein jhariyan niklein phir spray karein aur bone karein. Clean equipment aur weed-free seed use karein. Mulching ya residue bhi jhariyan suppress karti hai.

text: Basal dose at sowing what to apply and how much DAP and urea?
label: fertilizer
answer: Basal dose at sowing: full phosphorus (DAP 1–2 bag/acre) aur potash agar soil test mein kam ho; nitrogen ka 1/3 se 1/2 hissa bhi basal de sakte hain. DAP aur urea ko seed se thora door rakhein taake germination pe asar na ho. Soil test ke mutabiq exact dose adjust karein.

text: Threshing loss kam karne ke liye kya karein?
label: harvest
answer: Threshing loss kam karne ke liye grain ko bilkul ready hone dein, na jaldi na zyada der. Combine use karein to drum speed aur concave sahi set karein; manual threshing mein dheere kaatein. Garm dhoop mein kattai avoid karein; grain handle karte waqt care lein.

text: Kisan card se wheat ke liye qarz kaise milega?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Kisan card se qarz ke liye bank ya designated office mein apply karein; zameen ke kaghzat, CNIC aur form zaroori hain. Scheme ki details (limit, interest, tenure) agri office se lein. Loan crop input (beej, khaad) ke liye milta hai; timely repayment se agli baar asani hoti hai.

text: Beneficial insects in wheat field should we avoid spraying to save them?
label: pest
answer: Beneficial insects (ladybird, parasitoids) aphid aur chote pests ko khate hain. Inhe bachane ke liye selective insecticide use karein; broad-spectrum spray avoid karein jab tak zarurat na ho. Threshold par hi spray karein; IPM follow karein taake balance bana rahe.

text: Land preparation for wheat how many ploughings and when to level?
label: sowing
answer: Land preparation: 1–2 deep ploughs, phir 2–3 harrows se tilth bareek karein. Clods hataen aur zameen level karein; laser leveler agar ho to behtar. Sowing se 1–2 haftay pehle tayari khatam karein. Organic matter (FYM) agar dalen to pehle mix karein.

text: Brackish or saline water wheat ko de sakte hain?
label: irrigation
answer: Thora brackish ya saline pani kabhi use ho sakta hai agar EC limit se zyada na ho; soil salinity check karte rahein. Zyada khari pani avoid karein; blend karke use karein agar possible ho. Gypsum zameen mein dalen agar soil saline hai; drainage theek rakhein.

text: Black rust on wheat stem what spray and when?
label: disease
answer: Black rust (stem rust) stem aur patton par kaale/bhooray pustules banata hai. Systemic fungicide jo stem rust ke khilaf ho jald chhidkain; coverage stem tak hona chahiye. Resistant variety agle saal use karein. Volunteer wheat hataen taake rust cycle toot jaye.

text: Herbicide rotate karna kyun zaroori hai resistance se bachne ke liye?
label: weed_control
answer: Herbicide rotate karna is liye zaroori hai ke ek hi product bar bar use se jhariyan resistant ho jati hain. Alag mode of action wale products alternate karein (grass vs broad leaf; different chemistries). Is se resistance delay hoti hai aur long-term control behtar rehta hai.

text: Potash for wheat when to apply and how much per acre?
label: fertilizer
answer: Potash agar soil test mein kam ho to sowing par PK ya potash source dalen; aam tor par 25–50 kg K2O per acre. Zyada tar soils mein P aur N ki kami zyada hoti hai; potash sirf deficiency pe dein. Split mein dene ki zarurat nahi; basal dose kaafi hai.

text: Wheat straw baling for sale is it profitable?
label: harvest
answer: Wheat straw baling se aap bhoosa bech sakte hain; dairy ya fodder buyers khareedte hain. Baler ka kharcha aur labour dekhein; agar area mein demand hai to profitable ho sakta hai. Bale storage dry jagah par karein. Loose bhoosa bhi mandi mein bikta hai.

text: Mandi rate daily kaise check karein mobile se?
label: market_price
answer: Mandi rate daily check karne ke liye sarkari SMS service, agri apps (PASS, etc.) ya qareebi mandi office se puchen. Rate roz badalta hai; bechne se pehle same din ka rate dekh lain. Support price aur procurement ki list bhi online ya agri office se milegi.

text: Spray drift se bachne ke liye hawa aur nozzle ka kya rakhein?
label: general_info
answer: Spray drift se bachne ke liye tez hawa (5 km/h se zyada) mein spray na karein. Nozzle sahi size aur pressure use karein; flat fan nozzle coverage ke liye theek hai. Sprayer ki height aur speed theek rakhein. Paani ke srot aur padosi khet se door rahein.

text: Plant population per acre for wheat what is ideal?
label: sowing
answer: Ideal plant population wheat ke liye region aur variety par depend karta hai; aam tor par 300–400 plants per square meter ya 30–40 lakh per acre theek hai. Seed rate aur germination se achieve hota hai; line sowing se uniform stand aata hai. Local recommendation follow karein.

text: Frost has damaged wheat seedlings what to do now?
label: weather_risk
answer: Frost damage ke baad kuch plants recover ho sakte hain; extra nitrogen mat dein abhi. Pani light dein agar zameen sukhi ho; heavy irrigation avoid karein. Agli irrigations aur khaad schedule theek rakhein. Agar damage bahut zyada ho to crop insurance claim consider karein.

text: Waterlogging in wheat field how to drain and save crop?
label: irrigation
answer: Waterlogging hone par pani nikalne ka bandobast turant karein; drainage channels ya pump use karein. Khara pani hataen taake jaden saans le sakein. Us hisse mein khaad ka effect kam hota hai; recovery ke baad light topdress de sakte hain. Aage irrigation mein gap barha kar pani kam dein.

text: Fusarium head blight ki pehchan aur ilaaj?
label: disease
answer: Fusarium head blight (FHB) saron par ghalat rang, pink mould aur chhote danay banata hai. Resistant variety use karein; flowering par fungicide spray (FHB ke khilaf) karein. Residue galay karein; rotation mein non-host crop len. Infected grain alag karein.

text: Post emergence weedicide ka sahi waqt aur dose?
label: weed_control
answer: Post-emergence weedicide ka sahi waqt 25–35 din after sowing jab wheat 2–3 leaf stage se aage ho aur jhariyan chhoti hon. Dose label par hoti hai; nozzle aur pressure theek rakhein. Hawa calm ho; dhoop mein spray avoid karein. Product weed type ke mutabiq chunien.

text: Soil test ke baad wheat ke liye khaad ka plan kaise banayein?
label: fertilizer
answer: Soil test ke baad N, P, K aur micronutrients ki recommendation aati hai. Us ke mutabiq DAP, urea aur potash ki dose fix karein. Kam zarkhaiz zameen mein dose barhi hoti hai; zinc/boron agar report mein kam hon to add karein. Split nitrogen zaroor follow karein.

text: Grain storage pest control fumigation or spray which is better?
label: harvest
answer: Grain storage pest control: fumigation strong attack ke liye (aluminium phosphide etc.; safety rules follow karein). Spray (contact insecticide) surface aur bags par use ho sakta hai. Pehle grain bilkul sukha store karein; clean godown use karein. Regular check karein; keerey dikhein to phir treatment.

text: Test weight aur quality se rate pe kya asar padta hai?
label: market_price
answer: Test weight aur quality behtar hon to rate zyada milta hai; mills aur export buyers premium dete hain. Grain saaf, mote aur uniform rakhein; grading karein. Storage mein bhi quality maintain karein; moisture aur damage kam rakhein.

text: IPM approach for wheat pests kya hai step by step?
label: pest
answer: IPM approach: pehle scout karein ke kon sa pest hai aur kitna. Threshold cross hone par hi spray karein; faida mand keere bachain. Selective insecticide use karein; neem ya biopesticide shuru mein try karein. Crop rotation, clean field aur healthy plant bhi pest kam karte hain.

text: Happy seeder for wheat after rice how to use and benefits?
label: machinery
answer: Happy seeder chawal ki stubble ke beech gandum ka beej aur khaad ek sath place karta hai; jooti nahi karni parti. Benefits: waqt aur diesel bachta hai, moisture bachti hai, soil structure behtar rehta hai. Use karte waqt drill ki setting aur seed rate theek karein; stubble zyada ghana na ho.

text: Sowing depth for wheat seed how many cm?
label: sowing
answer: Wheat seed sowing depth aam tor par 3–5 cm (1.5–2 inch) rakhein. Zyada gehrayi se germination late ya kam hoti hai; zyada uthti se birds nuqsan ya sookhpan. Nami zameen mein 3–4 cm kaafi hai; sukhi zameen mein 4–5 cm.

text: Heat stress at grain filling wheat ko nuqsan kaise?
label: weather_risk
answer: Grain filling par heat stress se dana chhota aur weight kam hota hai. Waqt par bone karein taake grain filling peak garmi se pehle ho. Last pani grain filling par zaroor dein. Heat tolerant variety agar available ho to use karein.

text: Bed planting for wheat saves water how to do?
label: irrigation
answer: Bed planting: zameen ko beds par banayein (raised beds); beej beds par ya furrow mein. Pani furrows mein dein; is se pani bachta hai aur aeration behtar hoti hai. Bed planter implement use karein; spacing aur depth theek rakhein.

text: Root rot in wheat kaise pehchanen aur bachain?
label: disease
answer: Root rot mein jaden galti, brown/black hoti hain aur plant nikal jata hai. Drainage theek karein; waterlogging na hone dein. Resistant variety use karein; crop rotation karein. Fungicide seed treatment se kuch control hota hai; infected plants hataen.

text: Mixed weeds grass and broad leaf one spray for both?
label: weed_control
answer: Grass aur broad leaf dono weeds hon to pehle grass herbicide phir broad leaf ya woh product use karein jo dono ke khilaf label pe allow ho. Do alag spray bhi kar sakte hain; timing dono ki alag ho sakti hai. Label aur local advice follow karein.

text: 4R nutrient management for wheat kya hai?
label: fertilizer
answer: 4R nutrient matlab Right source (sahi khaad), Right rate (sahi dose), Right time (sahi waqt) aur Right place (sahi jagah). Source: DAP/urea jaisi recommended; rate: soil test se; time: basal + split topdress; place: seed ke paas lekin touch na ho.

text: Moisture meter for wheat harvest when to use?
label: harvest
answer: Moisture meter harvest ke waqt use karein jab grain hard ho jaye; safe storage ke liye 12–14% ya kam target karein. Meter se check karke decide karein kab kattai karein aur kab store karein. Manual test: grain ko dant se tootna mushkil ho to ready hai.

text: Cooperative or group selling wheat ka faida?
label: market_price
answer: Cooperative ya group selling se aap mil kar quantity zyada bech sakte hain; buyer ko bada lot pasand aata hai. Rate negotiate karne mein bhi faida hota hai. Local cooperative ya farmer group join karein; terms aur payment clearly likhwa lain.

text: Pheromone trap for wheat pests does it work?
label: pest
answer: Pheromone trap kuch pests (e.g. armyworm) ko attract karke count kam karne mein madad karti hai; lekin wheat ke liye aphid/rust jaisi cheezen trap se control nahi hoti. IPM ka hissa ban sakta hai; spray ki jagah nahi le sakti. Local extension se puchen ke aapke area ke pests ke liye koi trap recommend hai ya nahi.

text: Laser leveling before wheat sowing is it worth the cost?
label: sowing
answer: Laser leveling se pani uniform banta hai aur yield 5–15% barh sakta hai; cost ek baar ka hai, saalon use hota hai. Chhote kisan rent par leveler le sakte hain. Agar field zyada uchi neechi hai to faida zyada; flat fields mein bhi pani bachta hai.

text: Terminal heat wheat crop ko kaise affect karti hai?
label: weather_risk
answer: Terminal heat grain filling stage par garmi se dana chhota aur weight kam hota hai. Waqt par bone karein taake grain filling March–April ki peak garmi se pehle ho jaye. Last irrigation grain filling par zaroor dein. Heat tolerant variety agar available ho to prefer karein.

text: Supplemental irrigation in rainfed wheat when to give?
label: irrigation
answer: Rainfed wheat mein supplemental irrigation 1–2 pani critical stages par dein agar source ho: booting aur grain filling sab se important. Pani kam ho to inhi do stages par focus karein. Farm pond ya small tank se bhi ek do pani de sakte hain.

text: Viral disease in wheat leaves curling and yellowing what to do?
label: disease
answer: Viral disease (e.g. barley yellow dwarf) mein patte curl, zard hote hain aur growth ruk jati hai. Infected plants hataen; vector (aphid) control karein taake virus na phile. Healthy seed use karein; resistant variety agar ho to len. Virus ka direct ilaaj nahi hota.

text: Organic weed control in wheat without herbicide?
label: weed_control
answer: Organic weed control: line sowing se godai asaan; hand weeding 25–30 din tak karein. Stale seedbed: pehle jhariyan niklein phir bone karein. Crop rotation aur dense stand bhi weeds suppress karte hain. Herbicide ke bina thori zyada mehnat lagti hai lekin possible hai.

text: Foliar urea spray for wheat when and how much?
label: fertilizer
answer: Foliar urea tab use karein jab N deficiency dikhe ya soil se uptake kam ho. Tillering ya early stem stage par 2–5% urea solution spray karein; dhoop aur tez hawa mein avoid karein. Ye supplement hai; soil mein nitrogen ki jagah nahi le sakta.

text: Cleaning grain before selling for better price?
label: harvest
answer: Cleaning grain before selling: mote danay, kankar aur tootay hataen. Winnowing ya simple machine se safai karein. Clean grain ka rate behtar milta hai aur rejection kam hoti hai. Grading bhi karein agar buyer quality chahta ho.

text: Commission agent se deal karte waqt kya dhyan dein?
label: market_price
answer: Commission agent se deal karte waqt rate pehle clear karein; weight aur commission percent likhwain. Weighbridge khud dekhein; receipt lo. Payment time (same day ya baad) aur deduction list karein. Agar possible ho to do agents se rate compare karein.

text: Selective insecticide matlab kya hai keere ke liye?
label: pest
answer: Selective insecticide matlab woh zehr jo sirf target pest ko marta hai aur faida mand keeron (ladybird, bees) ko kam nuqsan pahunchata hai. Broad-spectrum ki jagah selective use karein taake IPM balance bana rahe. Label par 'selective' ya target pest likha hota hai.

text: Stubble mulch ke sath gandum bone zero till se?
label: sowing
answer: Stubble mulch ke sath zero till se bone karne se moisture bachti hai aur soil structure behtar rehta hai. Happy seeder ya zero till drill use karein; seed aur khaad stubble ke beech place hota hai. Residue zyada ghana na hona chahiye taake drill atakay na.

text: Hail damage on wheat crop can we get compensation?
label: weather_risk
answer: Hail damage par crop insurance claim kar sakte hain agar policy li hai. Photos lein aur damage report agri office ya insurance company ko turant karwain. Survey ke baad compensation milti hai. Policy terms aur time limit follow karein.

text: Ridges par wheat bone se pani bachta hai?
label: irrigation
answer: Ridges par wheat bone se pani furrows mein chalta hai; is se wastage kam aur aeration behtar hoti hai. Ridge seeder use karein; beej ridges par ya furrow mein. Pani bachta hai aur waterlogging bhi kam hoti hai.

text: Black point on wheat grains cause and prevention?
label: disease
answer: Black point danon ke end par kaala daag hota hai; quality aur germination pe asar padta hai. Fungal infection grain filling/ harvest time par hoti hai. Resistant variety aur timely harvest se bachav; storage dry rakhein. Infected grain alag karein.

text: Weed competition se wheat yield kitna kam hota hai?
label: weed_control
answer: Weed competition se wheat yield 20–50% tak kam ho sakti hai agar jhariyan control na hon. Early control zaroori hai (25–35 din); jhariyan badi hon to nuqsan zyada. Line sowing aur timely herbicide se yield bachti hai.

text: Lodging in wheat due to excess nitrogen how to prevent?
label: fertilizer
answer: Lodging rokne ke liye nitrogen zyada mat dein; split karein aur booting par zyada mat chhadayein. Pani bhi grain filling par zyada mat dein. Resistant/tolerant variety use karein. Agar lodging aaye to harvest jald karein taake quality kam na ho.

text: Safe moisture level for wheat storage in bags?
label: harvest
answer: Safe moisture for wheat storage in bags: 12–14% ya us se kam. Zyada nami se fungus aur keerey lagte hain. Moisture meter se check karein; boriyon ko dry jagah par rakhein. Fumigation ya treatment use karein agar keerey ka risk ho.

text: Warehouse receipt loan for wheat how does it work?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Warehouse receipt loan: aap grain warehouse ko deposit karte hain aur receipt milti hai; us receipt par bank se loan le sakte hain. Rate better hone par grain bech kar loan chuka dete hain. Warehouse charges aur loan terms puchen.

text: Neem based spray for aphid in wheat effective?
label: pest
answer: Neem-based spray aphid par halka asar dikhata hai; early stage par try kar sakte hain. Strong infestation par chemical insecticide zaroori ho sakta hai. Neem ka dose aur timing label par follow karein. IPM mein neem ek option hai, single solution nahi.

text: Certified seed vs farmer saved seed for wheat which better?
label: sowing
answer: Certified seed tested, disease-free aur recommended variety ka hota hai; yield aur uniformity behtar. Farmer saved seed agar saaf aur treated ho to use kar sakte hain lekin smut/bunt ka risk rehta hai. New variety ya disease pressure ho to certified behtar.

text: Barish zyada ho gayi waterlogging ho rahi hai kya karein?
label: weather_risk
answer: Barish zyada hone se waterlogging ho to turant pani nikalne ka bandobast karein; drain ya pump use karein. Khara pani hataen taake jaden saans le sakein. Aage pani ka gap barha kar irrigations kam dein; critical stages par hi focus karein.

text: Sprinkler irrigation for wheat suitable hai ya nahi?
label: irrigation
answer: Sprinkler wheat ke liye suitable hai khaas kar light/uneven zameen par; pani uniform banta hai. Lekin canal se zyada cost aur maintenance hoti hai. Chhote kisan rent par ya group use kar sakte hain; pressure aur nozzle theek rakhein.

text: Slow rusting variety kya hoti hai aur kaise pehchanen?
label: disease
answer: Slow rusting variety mein rust dheere phalti hai aur severity kam hoti hai; yield nuqsan kam. Pehchanne ke liye variety description ya research station se list lein; aksar un ke naam mein 'resistant' ya 'tolerant' likha hota hai. Agli fasal ke liye aisi variety choose karein.

text: One pass weeding and fertilizer possible in wheat?
label: weed_control
answer: One pass mein weeding aur fertilizer possible hai agar herbicide aur urea ki label allow kare tank mix. Nahi to alag din spray aur topdress safe hai. Some pre-mix products bhi aate hain; extension se puchen ke aapke area mein kya use hota hai.

text: Green manure before wheat which crop and when to incorporate?
label: fertilizer
answer: Green manure: moong, mash ya berseem jaisi short crop 6–8 haftay uga kar galay karke mix kar dein. Wheat bone se 3–4 haftay pehle incorporate karein taake galay ho jaye. Is se nitrogen aur organic matter milti hai; chemical dose thori kam ho sakti hai.

text: Condensation in storage damaging grain how to avoid?
label: harvest
answer: Condensation avoid karne ke liye grain bilkul sukha store karein (12–14% nami). Godown hawa daar rakhein; boriyon ko deewar se door rakhein. Temperature change kam rakhein; thand aur garmi mein condensation hota hai.

text: Digital platforms se wheat bech sakte hain?
label: market_price
answer: Digital platforms se wheat bech sakte hain: sarkari e-mandi, agri apps ya private portals. Registration aur quality photos/weight enter karein. Rate aur payment terms check karein; delivery ka kharcha aur timing clear ho.

text: Biopesticide for wheat pests which one to use?
label: pest
answer: Biopesticide: neem-based, Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) ya fungus-based products wheat pests ke liye use hoti hain. Early stage par zyada asar; heavy infestation par chemical bhi zaroori ho sakta hai. Label dose aur timing follow karein.

text: Wide row vs narrow row sowing for wheat which gives more yield?
label: sowing
answer: Narrow row (15–22 cm) sowing zyada tar wheat areas mein behtar yield deti hai; canopy jaldi close hoti hai aur weeds kam. Wide row (25–30 cm) kaam use hoti hai. Local recommendation aur drill availability follow karein.

text: Climate smart wheat farming kya hota hai?
label: weather_risk
answer: Climate smart wheat matlab aise amal jo pani bachayein, mausam ke sath adjust hon aur yield stable rahe: timely sowing, drought tolerant variety, residue cover, efficient irrigation. Is se long-term sustainability behtar hoti hai.

text: Community tube well se pani wheat ke liye kaise manage karein?
label: irrigation
answer: Community tube well se pani ko schedule karein: sab milkar fixed days ya turns fix karein taake har kisi ko critical stages par pani mile. Pani bachane ke liye leveling aur bed/ridge use karein. Dispute na ho is ke liye committee bana kar rules likhein.

text: Resistant variety for rust which to choose for my area?
label: disease
answer: Rust resistant variety apne ilaqe ke liye agri department ya research station se list lein; har zone ki alag recommendation hoti hai. Current season ki rust races ke hisaab se variety choose karein. Extension officer se latest resistant list puchen.

text: Mechanical weeder for wheat available and effective?
label: weed_control
answer: Mechanical weeder (e.g. cono weeder, power weeder) wheat mein use ho sakta hai jab jhariyan chhoti hon; 25–30 din tak. Effective hai lekin labour chahiye; herbicide se combine karke use karein. Local market ya agri machinery center se available check karein.

text: Gypsum for saline soil before wheat how much?
label: fertilizer
answer: Gypsum saline/sodic soil ke liye use hota hai; dose soil test se decide hoti hai, aam tor par 1–2 ton per acre. Sowing se pehle spread karke mix karein. Drainage theek rakhein taake salts nikal sakein.

text: Fumigation of wheat godown when and how?
label: harvest
answer: Fumigation jab storage ke andar keerey zyada hon ya grain long term store ho. Aluminium phosphide tablets use hoti hain; safety rules zaroor follow karein, bachon aur janwaron se door. Godown band karke 5–7 din rakhein; phir hawa lagnay dein.

text: Insurance claim for wheat crop loss kaise karein?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Insurance claim: nuqsan hone par turant photos lein aur agri office ya insurance company ko report karein. Survey aata hai; us ke baad form aur documents submit karein. Compensation policy ke mutabiq milti hai. Time limit follow karein.

text: Scout wheat field how often and what to look for?
label: general_info
answer: Scout wheat field har 7–10 din; disease/pest season mein zyada. Dekhein: rust ke daag, keerey, jhariyan, pani ki kami, nutrient deficiency. Early pehchan se ilaaj sasta aur zyada asar; record bhi rakhein taake agle saal compare karein.

text: Old seed one or two year old use for wheat okay?
label: sowing
answer: 1–2 saal purana beej use kar sakte hain agar germination theek ho (80%+) aur disease-free ho. Germination test karein; kam germination ho to seed rate barha den. Purana beej smut/bunt ka risk barhata hai; seed treatment zaroor karein.

text: Sardi mein frost aane wala hai wheat ko bachane ke liye kya karein?
label: weather_risk
answer: Frost aane wala ho to wheat ko bachane ke liye haftay bhar pehle light irrigation dein taake soil warmth rahe. Frost wali raat ko khet mein dhuwan ya smoke mat karein (unsafe). Sardiyon mein jaldi bone se bachein; frost-prone areas mein variety bhi resistant wali len.

text: Farm pond water for wheat irrigation use karein?
label: irrigation
answer: Farm pond ka pani wheat irrigation ke liye use kar sakte hain jab canal na ho ya shortage ho. Critical stages (crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling) par prioritize karein. Pond refill barish par depend kare; size ke hisaab se area plan karein.

text: Fungicide interval between two sprays for rust?
label: disease
answer: Fungicide interval rust ke liye aam tor par 10–14 din; pressure zyada ho to 7–10 din. Do se zyada sprays zaroori hon to different mode of action wala product use karein taake resistance na bane. Label par interval likha hota hai.

text: Strip cropping wheat with other crop for weed control?
label: weed_control
answer: Strip cropping wheat with mustard or another crop weed control mein madad karti hai aur biodiversity behtar hoti hai. Spacing aur strip width research station recommendation follow karein. Harvest aur management thora complex ho jata hai.

text: Legume crop ke baad wheat mein kam khaad deni chahiye?
label: fertilizer
answer: Legume (channa, moong, etc.) ke baad wheat mein nitrogen ki zarurat thori kam hoti hai kyunke legume nitrogen fix karti hai. Phir bhi full dose na chhoren; soil test se P, K aur N adjust karein. Legume residue galay hone dein.

text: Grading wheat before selling for premium price?
label: harvest
answer: Grading: grain ko size, weight aur cleanliness ke hisaab se sort karein. Clean, uniform, mote danay premium rate par bikte hain. Mandi ya buyer ki grading standards follow karein; reject kam hota hai.

text: Middleman se direct mandi bechne ka fark?
label: market_price
answer: Middleman commission leta hai aur rate thora kam deta hai; direct mandi bechne se aap ko poora rate milta hai lekin transport aur time khud lagana padta hai. Rate dono jagah compare karein; quantity zyada ho to direct bechna faida mand ho sakta hai.

text: Threshold for aphid in wheat when to spray?
label: pest
answer: Aphid threshold aam tor par 5–10 aphids per tiller ya ear par; local extension exact figure bata sakta hai. Is hadd par ya us se zyada hone par spray karein. Subah ya sham spray karein; coverage achha hona chahiye.

text: Germination test of wheat seed before sowing how to do?
label: sowing
answer: Germination test: 100–200 beej sample le kar geela kapra ya paper par 7–10 din rakhein; count karein kitne ugay. 80%+ achha hai; kam ho to seed rate barhaen ya naya beej len. Temperature normal rakhein.

text: Weather advisory for wheat when to check?
label: weather_risk
answer: Weather advisory wheat ke liye mausam department, agri SMS ya app se check karein. Frost, barish, garmi ya hail se pehle plan karein; irrigation aur spray timing adjust karein. Critical stages par roz check karein.

text: Border strip irrigation for wheat field?
label: irrigation
answer: Border strip irrigation: field ko choti strips mein divide karein; pani ek strip se doosri ko flow karein. Is se wastage kam hoti hai aur uniformity behtar. Leveling zaroori hai.

text: Mixed varieties in same field rust risk zyada hota hai?
label: disease
answer: Mix varieties ek hi khet mein rust risk barha sakti hain agar koi variety susceptible ho; rust us par phir baqi par phail sakti hai. Ek hi resistant variety prefer karein; agar mix karein to dono resistant honi chahiye.

text: Volunteer wheat plants as weeds next crop mein problem?
label: weed_control
answer: Volunteer wheat next crop (e.g. cotton, rice) ke liye weed ban jati hai; host bhi hai rust ka. Unhe hataen ya spray karein before next sowing. Clean harvest aur equipment se volunteer kam hoti hai.

text: Nitrogen use efficiency in wheat kaise barhayein?
label: fertilizer
answer: Nitrogen use efficiency barhane ke liye split application karein, pani ke sath dein, aur zyada pani/waterlogging avoid karein. Right time (tillering, booting) par dein. Soil test se dose fix karein; zyada N waste hota hai aur lodging bhi.

text: Godown safe storage wheat ke liye kya conditions?
label: harvest
answer: Godown safe storage: dry (nami 12–14% se kam), clean, hawa daar; boriyon ko floor aur deewar se door rakhein. Keerey aur rodents se bachav; fumigation ya treatment zarurat ho to karein. Regular check karein.

text: Documents required for selling wheat to government?
label: market_price
answer: Government wheat bechne ke liye: CNIC, land record, bank account; procurement center ki form aur quality standards (moisture, foreign matter). List food department ya agri office se; timing aur quota follow karein.

text: Ladybird beetle in wheat field good hai ya bura?
label: general_info
answer: Ladybird beetle faida mand hai; ye aphid aur chote keeron ko khata hai. Inhe mat maren; selective insecticide use karein taake ye bach jayein. IPM mein inki ahmiyat hai.

text: High density sowing for wheat more seed rate benefit?
label: sowing
answer: High density (zyada seed rate) kabhi trial se theek hota hai lekin zyada tar areas mein recommended rate behtar; zyada rate se lodging aur disease barh sakte hain. Local trial ya recommendation follow karein.

text: Garmi jaldi aa gayi wheat pe terminal heat ka asar?
label: weather_risk
answer: Garmi jaldi aane se terminal heat grain filling par asar dalti hai; dana chhota reh jata hai. Waqt par bone karein taake grain fill March–April ki peak garmi se pehle ho. Last pani grain filling par zaroor dein.

text: Rainfed wheat mein kab kab pani dein agar mauka ho?
label: irrigation
answer: Rainfed wheat mein agar 1–2 pani ka mauka ho to booting aur grain filling par dein; ye do stages sab se critical. Pani bachane ke liye residue cover aur timely sowing karein.

text: Non chemical control for wheat diseases possible?
label: disease
answer: Non-chemical control: resistant variety, crop rotation, balanced nutrition, field sanitation, timely sowing. Fungicide ki jagah nahi le sakta lekin pressure kam karta hai. Organic farming mein yehi options hain.

text: Herbicide resistant weeds in wheat how to manage?
label: weed_control
answer: Herbicide resistant weeds ke liye alag mode of action wala herbicide use karein; rotation zaroori hai. Hand weeding se bachi jhariyan hataen. Same product bar bar na chhidkain.

text: Boron deficiency in wheat symptoms and treatment?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Boron deficiency: growth points affect, pollen kam, grain set kam; purane patte theek naye abnormal. Soil ya foliar boron (borax etc.) recommended dose se dein. Soil test se confirm karein.

text: Cost of wheat cultivation per acre roughly kitna aata hai?
label: general_info
answer: Wheat cultivation cost per acre roughly: beej, khaad, pani, spray, labour aur machinery; region ke hisaab se 25,000–50,000+ rupees ho sakta hai. Apna hisab rakhein taake faida nuqsan pata rahe.

text: Residue burning after wheat harvest next crop ke liye?
label: general_info
answer: Residue burning se next crop ke liye nuqsan: soil biology kharab, pollution. Jalaen nahi; residue ko galay karein ya happy seeder/zero till se next crop bone. Mulch ke tor par bhi use ho sakta hai.

text: Drought tolerant wheat variety for dry area?
label: sowing
answer: Drought tolerant variety dry/barani areas ke liye agri department se list lein; aksar early aur stress-tolerant hoti hain. Seed rate aur sowing time bhi barani ke mutabiq rakhein.

text: Oala ya hail wheat ko nuqsan pahuncha sakta hai?
label: weather_risk
answer: Oala (hail) wheat ko nuqsan pahuncha sakta hai; patte toot jate hain aur yield gir jati hai. Bachav mushkil; insurance claim karein agar policy ho. Damage ke baad extra nitrogen mat dein; crop recover ho sakta hai thora.

text: Saline water use for wheat with gypsum?
label: irrigation
answer: Saline water agar EC limit se zyada na ho to thora use ho sakta hai; gypsum zameen mein dalen aur drainage theek rakhein. Blend with good water agar possible. Soil salinity monitor karein.

text: Crop rotation to reduce wheat diseases which crops?
label: disease
answer: Crop rotation: wheat ke baad legume (moong, mash), oilseed (sarson) ya cotton; non-host se disease cycle toot jati hai. 2–3 year rotation behtar; same wheat bar bar na boen.

text: Precision sowing wheat seed drill calibration?
label: sowing
answer: Precision sowing: drill calibration karein taake seed rate aur spacing theek ho. Cup/roller check karein; speed constant rakhein. Field test karein taake depth uniform ho.

text: Wheat straw for mushroom cultivation use kar sakte hain?
label: harvest
answer: Wheat straw mushroom cultivation ke liye use hoti hai; compost banate hain. Agar mushroom unit qareeb ho to bhoosa bech sakte hain. Otherwise charay ya baling se bechna.

text: Direct sale to flour mill better rate than mandi?
label: market_price
answer: Direct mill sale kabhi mandi se behtar rate deti hai; quantity aur quality deal pe depend. Transport khud ya mill arrange karti hai. Terms aur payment time clear karein.

text: Seed vigor test for wheat before sowing?
label: sowing
answer: Seed vigor test: germination ke sath growth speed bhi dekhi jati hai; weak seed late ya kam ugati hai. Simple test: 100 beej 7 din mein kitne strong seedlings; 80%+ achha. Purana ya doubtful beej ka vigor test karwa lain.

text: Residue agle fasal ke liye jalaen ya rehne dein?
label: general_info
answer: Residue jalaen nahi; pollution aur soil nuqsan. Galay karein ya zero till/happy seeder se next crop bone. Residue mulch ke tor par nami bachati hai aur weeds kam karti hai.

text: Small farmer wheat best practices low cost?
label: general_info
answer: Small farmer best practices: certified seed, recommended dose, timely irrigation, group buying se sasta input, shared machinery. Scout karte rahein; early control sasta. Record rakhein taake cost faida pata rahe.

text: Wheat crop calendar month by month kya karein?
label: general_info
answer: Wheat calendar: Oct–Nov bone, Nov–Dec first pani aur weed control, Dec–Jan topdress, Jan–Feb booting pani, Feb–Mar phool/grain filling, Apr–May kattai. Mausam aur region se thora farq ho sakta hai.

text: Photo bhej kar disease identify karwa sakte hain?
label: general_info
answer: Photo bhej kar disease identify karwa sakte hain; extension officer, agri app ya crop clinic ko clear photo bhejein. Leaf dono taraf, close-up aur full plant. Early pehchan se sahi ilaaj milta hai.

text: Neighbor farmers coordinate spray for rust control?
label: general_info
answer: Neighbor farmers agar mil kar same time rust spray karein to disease phailne ka risk kam hota hai. Volunteer plants sab hata dein. Coordination se area-level control behtar.

text: Salam main naya kisaan hoon gandum ke bare mein batayein
label: greeting
answer: Wa alaikum assalam. Main gandum ke bare mein bone, khaad, pani, jhariyan, keere, bimariyan, kattai aur bechne tak rehnumai kar sakta hoon. Kya poochna hai bataein.

text: Assalam o alaikum meri fasal mein masla hai madad chahiye
label: greeting
answer: Wa alaikum assalam. Batayein aap ki fasal mein kya masla hai—patte zard, keerey, bimari ya pani—main step by step bataunga. Location bhi likhein agar zaroori ho.

text: Hello I have some questions about wheat crop
label: greeting
answer: Hello. I can help with wheat sowing, fertilizer, irrigation, weeds, pests, diseases, harvest and selling. Tell me what you need; I will answer in simple steps.

text: Bhai gandum ki bimari ke bare mein poochna tha
label: greeting
answer: Wa alaikum assalam. Gandum ki bimari ke liye batayein kya nishaniyan hain—daag, zard patte, powder—phir main fungicide ya ilaaj bataunga. Photo bhej sakte hain agar ho.

text: Meri gandum ki fasal mein keerey bahut zyada ho gaye hain kaun si dawai use karun?
label: pest
answer: Keerey zyada hon to pehle pest pehchanen (chust, termite, armyworm); phir us ke mutabiq insecticide extension se puchen. Dose aur time sahi rakhein; subah/sham spray karein. Doosri spray sirf zarurat par waiting period dekh kar.

text: Aphid attack is severe on ears which insecticide and what dose per acre?
label: pest
answer: Aphid ears par zyada hon to recommended insecticide use karein jo wheat aphid ke khilaf ho; dose per acre label par. Ears aur upper leaves par coverage dein. Cooler time spray karein.

text: Termite ne gandum ki jaden kha di hain kaise bachain?
label: pest
answer: Termite jaden kha rahe hon to drainage theek karein; waterlogging hataen. Seed treatment insecticide se karein; soil treatment ya termiticide affected hisse par use karein. Purani stubble hataen.

text: Cutworm is cutting plants at night what to do?
label: pest
answer: Cutworm raat ko plants kaat raha hai to soil surface par recommended insecticide spray karein ya bait use karein. Evening spray behtar; coverage base tak hona chahiye.

text: Chust keera patton par honeydew chhod raha hai spray kab karein?
label: pest
answer: Honeydew chust (aphid) ki nishani hai; colony zyada hon to spray karein. Recommended insecticide sahi dose par; patton ke niche bhi chhidkain. Subah ya sham spray karein.

text: Rodents are eating wheat in field how to control?
label: pest
answer: Rodents: field edges clean rakhein; burrows band karein. Poison bait (safe use) ya trap; bachon/janwaron se door. Storage bhi rodent-proof rakhein.

text: Keeron ki hadd kya hoti hai jab spray karna zaroori ho jata hai?
label: pest
answer: Spray ki hadd pest type par depend karti hai; aphid ke liye aam tor par 5–10 per tiller/ear. Extension se exact threshold puchen. Is par ya us se upar hone par spray karein.

text: Natural enemies like ladybird should we avoid spraying to protect them?
label: pest
answer: Yes; ladybird aur doosre beneficials ko bachane ke liye selective insecticide use karein aur spray sirf threshold par karein. Broad-spectrum avoid karein jab tak zarurat na ho.

text: Mite attack on wheat leaves kaun si dawai?
label: pest
answer: Mite ke liye recommended miticide ya sulphur-based product use karein; label par wheat aur mite likha ho. Coverage achha hona chahiye. Water stress kam karein.

text: Armyworm larvae are feeding on leaves what spray?
label: pest
answer: Armyworm leaves kha raha ho to labeled insecticide spray karein; sham ko spray karein jab larvae active hon. Canopy tak coverage; field edges par zyada dhyan.

text: Pehla pani de chuke hain ab doosra kab den aur kitna gap?
label: irrigation
answer: Doosra pani pehle ke 12–20 din baad dein (zameen ke hisaab se); tillering stage par. Phir booting, flowering aur grain filling par. Total 4–6 pani canal area mein.

text: Crown root stage irrigation when exactly after sowing?
label: irrigation
answer: Crown root stage irrigation aam tor par sowing ke 20–25 din baad; jab 2–3 leaves aur crown roots ban rahe hon. Exact din soil moisture aur variety se thora farq ho sakta hai.

text: Canal band hai pani nahi aa raha wheat ko kya karein?
label: irrigation
answer: Canal band ho to tube well, pond ya stored pani use karein agar ho. Critical stages (tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling) par zaroor dein. Pani bachane ke liye ridges/beds; jitna ho sake inhi stages par concentrate karein.

text: Last irrigation before harvest when to give?
label: irrigation
answer: Last irrigation grain filling stage par, maturity se 2–3 haftay pehle. Is ke baad pani mat dein taake grain dry ho aur lodging na aaye.

text: Pani ki kami hai tube well bhi kam hai critical stage pe pani dena zaroori hai?
label: irrigation
answer: Pani kami ho to critical stages par zaroor dein: booting aur grain filling sab se important. Ek do pani in par dene se bhi fark padta hai. Prioritize karein; tube well sharing ya small pond consider karein.

text: Flooding in wheat field due to rain how to drain?
label: irrigation
answer: Flooding: turant drainage channel ya pump se pani bahaen. Khara pani hataen; jaden galti na hon. Recovery ke baad light topdress; heavy irrigation avoid karein.

text: Bed planting se pani bachta hai kaise karein?
label: irrigation
answer: Bed planting: zameen ko raised beds par banayein; beej beds par. Pani furrows mein dein; wastage kam, aeration behtar. Bed planter use karein.

text: How many total irrigations for wheat in canal area?
label: irrigation
answer: Canal area wheat ko aam tor par 4–6 irrigations: crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling. Soil type se 12–20 din gap.

text: Raiti zameen hai pani jaldi sookh jata hai kitni dafa pani dein?
label: irrigation
answer: Raiti zameen mein pani jaldi sookhta hai; gap kam rakhein (10–15 din). Kam volume bar bar; mulch ya residue se nami bachayein. Critical stages par zaroor dein.

text: Drip irrigation for wheat is it practical?
label: irrigation
answer: Drip wheat mein aam nahi; cost zyada aur spacing wide. Experiment ya special case mein ho sakta hai. Sprinkler zyada practical light soils ke liye.

text: Pattay zard hain nitrogen ki kami lag rahi hai urea kab dalen?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Pattay zard N kami ho to urea topdress karein tillering par; pehle pani dein phir urea. Dose local recommendation; purane patte zard hon to N hi hai. Zinc agar naye patton par safed lakeeren hon to alag zinc dein.

text: Yellow patches on young leaves zinc deficiency?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Young leaves par yellow patches zinc deficiency ho sakti hai; whitish stripes bhi. Zinc sulphate soil mein ya foliar zinc spray tillering par use karein. Repeat if needed.

text: Purane patte zard ho rahe hain N kami hai topdress kab karein?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Purane patte zard N kami; topdress urea tillering stage par dein (bone ke 40–50 din). Pani ke sath ya light irrigation ke baad. Doosri dose booting par de sakte hain.

text: Sulphur deficiency in wheat what are symptoms?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Sulphur deficiency: young leaves pale yellow, growth kam. Gypsum ya sulphur-containing fertilizer use karein. Soil test se confirm karein.

text: Boron ki kami wheat mein kaise pehchanen?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Boron kami mein growth points affect, grain set kam; pollen weak. Borax ya boron fertilizer soil ya foliar; recommended dose. Soil test confirm kare.

text: Jhariyan ab bhi zyada hain ek aur spray karein ya godai?
label: weed_control
answer: Jhariyan chhoti hon to ek aur post-emergence spray karein alag mode wala; badi hon to godai karein. Do products mix sirf label allow kare to. Time par control zaroori hai.

text: Grassy weeds in wheat which herbicide to use?
label: weed_control
answer: Grassy weeds ke liye grass-selective herbicide (e.g. clodinafop) wheat ke liye use karein; timing 25–35 DAS. Dose aur nozzle label par. Broad leaf alag product se.

text: Broad leaf weedicide ka sahi waqt aur dose kya hai?
label: weed_control
answer: Broad leaf weedicide sahi waqt 25–35 din after sowing jab jhariyan chhoti hon. Dose label par (e.g. 2,4-D); hawa calm ho. Product wheat ke liye approved ho.

text: Tank mix of urea and herbicide is it safe?
label: weed_control
answer: Tank mix urea aur herbicide sirf tab safe jab dono ki label allow kare. Kaheen urea spray ko nuqsan pahunchati hai. Alag spray safe option.

text: Pre emergence spray miss ho gayi post emergence kab chhidkain?
label: weed_control
answer: Pre emergence miss ho to post-emergence jald chhidkain jab jhariyan chhoti hon (25–35 DAS). Product wheat aur weed type ke mutabiq; dose sahi rakhein.

text: Gandum bone ka sahi mahina konsa hai Punjab mein?
label: sowing
answer: Punjab mein gandum bone ka sahi mahina late October se mid-November. Region thora farq; agri office se exact dates lein. Der bone se yield kam hoti hai.

text: Late sowing in December what seed rate and variety?
label: sowing
answer: December sowing late hai; seed rate 5–10% barha den, early/resistant variety len. Full fertilizer aur critical irrigations time par dein. Yield thori kam expect karein.

text: Chawal ke baad jaldi gandum bone ke liye khet kaise tayar karein?
label: sowing
answer: Chawal ke baad jald: stubble manage karein, zero till drill ya happy seeder use karein agar ho. Nahi to light tillage, level karein aur line sowing. Certified beej aur treatment.

text: Row spacing for wheat drill how many cm?
label: sowing
answer: Row spacing wheat drill ke liye aam tor par 20–25 cm. Narrow spacing canopy jaldi close; wide se weeds zyada. Local recommendation follow karein.

text: Zero till se bone ka faida aur nuqsan kya hai?
label: sowing
answer: Zero till faida: waqt, diesel bachta hai; nami bachti hai; soil structure behtar. Nuqsan: residue manage karna; drill setting zaroori. Chawal ke baad ideal hai.

text: Seed treatment fungicide kaun sa use karein?
label: sowing
answer: Seed treatment ke liye systemic fungicide (smut/bunt ke khilaf) use karein; brand extension se puchen. Rate per kg seed label par. Treatment ke baad shade mein sukha kar bone karein.

text: Land preparation for wheat how many days before sowing?
label: sowing
answer: Land preparation sowing se 1–2 haftay pehle khatam karein. 1–2 deep plough, 2–3 harrow, leveling. Moisture theek honi chahiye bone ke waqt.

text: Barani area mein gandum kab boen barish ke hisaab se?
label: sowing
answer: Barani area mein barish ke baad boen jab nami enough ho; aam tor par late Oct–mid Nov. Drought tolerant variety; seed rate thori zyada. Local rain pattern dekh kar date fix karein.

text: Cotton after wheat when to sow cotton?
label: sowing
answer: Wheat kattai ke baad cotton April–May mein sow hoti hai. Wheat jald kaat kar field free karein; cotton ke liye preparation aur variety time par len.

text: Peeli zang pehli nishani par fungicide chhidkain?
label: disease
answer: Peeli zang pehli nishani par systemic fungicide chhidkain; coverage achha hona chahiye. Doosri spray 10–14 din baad agar disease dikhe. Resistant variety agle saal.

text: Stem rust black pustules on stem what fungicide?
label: disease
answer: Stem rust (black) stem aur patton par kaale pustules. Systemic fungicide stem rust ke khilaf jald chhidkain; stem tak coverage. Resistant variety use karein agle season.

text: Loose smut next crop ke liye beej kaise safe karein?
label: disease
answer: Loose smut next crop ke liye: certified ya bilkul saaf beej use karein; systemic fungicide seed treatment zaroor karein. Smut wali fasal ka beej reuse na karein.

text: Leaf blight and rust dono hain kaun si fungicide dono par kaam karegi?
label: disease
answer: Leaf blight aur rust dono hon to fungicide chunien jo dono ke khilaf label pe ho; triazole/strobilurin mix products kabhi use hoti hain. Ek spray se dono control; coverage achha hona chahiye.

text: Powdery mildew white powder on leaves treatment?
label: disease
answer: Powdery mildew: safed powder patton par. Sulphur ya triazole fungicide wheat par recommend; jald spray. Resistant variety aur balanced N.

text: Karnal bunt infected grain ko alag kaise pehchanen?
label: disease
answer: Karnal bunt infected grain: kaala powder, fishy smell, danay ke end par daag. Alag karke beej ke liye use na karein; saaf grain alag store karein. Seed treatment agli fasal.

text: Fungicide spray interval kitne din?
label: disease
answer: Fungicide spray interval aam tor par 10–14 din; label par bhi likha hota hai. Pressure zyada ho to 7–10 din. Mode of action rotate karein.

text: Resistant variety for yellow rust which one?
label: disease
answer: Yellow rust resistant variety list agri department ya research station se lein; har zone ki alag. Current races ke hisaab se choose karein.

text: Root rot wheat mein kaise pehchanen?
label: disease
answer: Root rot: jaden galti, brown/black; plant nikal jata hai. Drainage theek karein; waterlogging na hone dein. Resistant variety aur rotation; seed treatment bhi madad karta hai.

text: DAP kitni bags per acre bone par dalen?
label: fertilizer
answer: DAP bone par aam tor par 1–2 bag per acre (soil test ke mutabiq). Urea ka hissa split: bone par thora, baqi pehle pani aur tillering par. Total NPK local recommendation.

text: Split nitrogen application how many times and when?
label: fertilizer
answer: Split nitrogen 2–3 dafa: basal ya first irrigation, tillering, aur kabhi booting. Timing aur dose soil aur target yield ke hisaab se. Pani ke sath dein taake waste na ho.

text: Urea ki pehli aur doosri dose kab kab den?
label: fertilizer
answer: Urea pehli dose sowing/crown-root par (1/3), doosri tillering par (1/2 ya zyada). Kabhi teesri booting par. Total per acre recommendation follow karein.

text: FYM with DAP and urea mix at sowing?
label: fertilizer
answer: FYM well decomposed ho to sowing par DAP/urea ke sath de sakte hain; 2–4 ton/acre. Chemical dose kam mat karein; FYM extra. Pehle mix karein.

text: Low fertility soil wheat fertilizer dose zyada?
label: fertilizer
answer: Low fertility soil mein dose soil test se barhaen; P, K aur N balanced. Organic matter (FYM) add karein. Zinc/boron agar report mein kam hon.

text: Top dressing at tillering how much urea per acre?
label: fertilizer
answer: Tillering par topdress aam tor par 0.5–1 bag urea per acre; local recommendation. Pani de kar ya baad mein dein taake sookh na jaye.

text: Micronutrient zinc boron wheat mein kab den?
label: fertilizer
answer: Zinc foliar tillering par ya deficiency dikhe; boron agar soil test mein kam ho to sowing par ya foliar. Dose label ya extension se.

text: Balanced NPK ratio for wheat per acre?
label: fertilizer
answer: Balanced NPK ratio region aur soil par depend; aam tor par N:P:K 4:2:1 ya 3:1:1 jaisa. Soil test se exact; P aur K sowing par, N split.

text: Gobar ki khaad chemical ke sath de sakte hain kitni?
label: fertilizer
answer: Gobar ki khaad 2–4 ton per acre well decomposed; chemical ke sath dein, chemical kam mat karein. Sowing se pehle mix karein.

text: Kattai ka sahi waqt kaise pehchanen dana ready hai?
label: harvest
answer: Kattai ka sahi waqt: dana sakht ho, naakhun se toot na sake; bhoosa zard; nami 14–15% se neeche. Thora early better than late (shattering).

text: Combine harvest loss how to minimize?
label: harvest
answer: Combine loss kam karne ke liye drum speed aur concave sahi set karein; grain bilkul ready hone dein. Speed field condition ke mutabiq; thandi subah/sham kaatna behtar.

text: Dana store karte waqt nami kitni honi chahiye?
label: harvest
answer: Store karte waqt nami 12–14% ya kam; zyada nami se keerey aur fungus. Sukha kar ke store karein; boriyon ko dry jagah.

text: Threshing loss kam karne ka tareeqa?
label: harvest
answer: Threshing loss kam karne ke liye grain ko bilkul ready hone dein; combine setting theek; manual ho to dheere kaatein. Garmi mein kattai avoid karein.

text: Wheat straw disposal after harvest options?
label: harvest
answer: Straw options: charay, bechna, baling, mulch ya next crop residue. Local demand dekh kar; baling agar baler ho to.

text: Storage insect control which treatment?
label: harvest
answer: Storage insect: grain sukha store; fumigation ya contact insecticide boriyon/godown par. Regular check; keerey dikhein to phir treatment.

text: Grain drying after harvest kitne din?
label: harvest
answer: Grain drying patli layer mein 3–7 din dhoop; nami 12–14% tak. Stir karein; shade mein final rakhein taake condensation na ho.

text: Early harvest vs late harvest yield difference?
label: harvest
answer: Early harvest: grain abhi soft, yield kam. Late: shattering, quality kam. Right time pe kattai karein jab grain hard ho.

text: Boriyon mein store karein ya godown?
label: harvest
answer: Chote quantity boriyon mein; zyada godown. Boriyon dry, clean jagah; godown bhi dry, rodent-proof. Dono theek; quantity aur facility dekh kar.

text: Support price is year kya hai aur kab announce hoti hai?
label: market_price
answer: Support price sarkar har saal announce karti hai; news ya agri department. Procurement centers ki list food department/agri office se. Timing bhi wahan se.

text: When to sell wheat early or wait for better price?
label: market_price
answer: Sell early agar cash chahiye ya rate girne ka andaza ho. Wait karein agar store safe ho aur rate barhne ka chance ho. Quality aur test weight behtar rakhein taake rate achha mile.

text: Mandi rate aaj kya hai check kaise karein?
label: market_price
answer: Mandi rate rozana mandi, SMS, app se check karein. Bechne se pehle same din rate dekh lain; do teen jagah compare karein.

text: Quality wheat premium price kaise mile?
label: market_price
answer: Quality wheat: grain saaf, mote, uniform; grading karein. Test weight behtar; storage dry. Buyers premium dete hain; reject kam.

text: Procurement center list kahan se milegi?
label: market_price
answer: Procurement center list food department, agri office ya Kisan helpline se. Online bhi mil jati hai; zone ke hisaab se. Bechne se pehle quality standards aur documents ready rakhein.

text: Forward contract wheat selling benefit?
label: market_price
answer: Forward contract se rate fix; rate girne ka risk kam. Rate barh jaye to faida nahi. Terms clear karein; payment time aur quality.

text: Test weight behtar hone se rate zyada milta hai?
label: market_price
answer: Test weight behtar hone se rate zyada milta hai; mills premium dete hain. Grain mote, saaf rakhein; harvest aur storage theek karein.

text: Group selling cooperative se bechne ka faida?
label: market_price
answer: Group selling se quantity zyada; rate negotiate behtar. Cooperative join karein; terms aur payment likhwain.

text: Wheat crop loan kahan se milega documents kya?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Wheat loan bank ya Kisan scheme se; zameen ke kaghzat, CNIC, form. Agri office se scheme details; eligibility check karein.

text: Subsidy on wheat seed how to get?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Seed subsidy agri department se; eligibility aur form wahan. List aur quota har saal; time par apply karein.

text: Crop insurance claim process for wheat?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Crop insurance claim: loss report turant; photos; survey ke baad form. Documents policy ke mutabiq; time limit follow karein.

text: Interest free loan wheat ke liye kahan apply karein?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Interest free ya low interest loan Kisan scheme/bank se; agri office se list. Documents aur eligibility check karein.

text: Kisan card se kya kya benefits milte hain?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Kisan card se loan, subsidy, insurance jaisi benefits; bank ya agri office se details. Card banwane ke liye documents submit karein.

text: Frost damage to wheat seedlings recovery possible?
label: weather_risk
answer: Frost damage: kuch plants recover; extra N mat dein. Light irrigation; heavy avoid. Agar damage zyada ho to insurance claim.

text: Terminal heat se bachne ke liye kya karein?
label: weather_risk
answer: Terminal heat se bachne ke liye waqt par boen taake grain fill garmi se pehle; last pani grain filling par zaroor dein. Heat tolerant variety agar ho.

text: Hail damage insurance claim kaise?
label: weather_risk
answer: Hail damage: photos lein; report agri office/insurance turant. Survey ke baad claim; policy terms follow karein.

text: Barish zyada hone se wheat ko nuqsan?
label: weather_risk
answer: Barish zyada se waterlogging; drain karein. Lodging bhi ho sakti hai; pani nikal kar recovery. Next time drainage behtar karein.

text: Heat wave at flowering stage wheat effect?
label: weather_risk
answer: Heat wave at flowering/grain fill se dana chhota, yield kam. Timely sowing aur last irrigation zaroori; variety bhi heat tolerant len.

text: Happy seeder ka istemal kaise karein?
label: machinery
answer: Happy seeder chawal stubble mein seed aur fertilizer place karta hai. Setting theek karein; seed rate aur depth. Stubble zyada ghana na ho.

text: Zero till drill calibration for wheat?
label: machinery
answer: Zero till drill calibration: seed rate cup/roller se; depth adjustment; speed constant. Field test karein taake spacing uniform ho.

text: Sprayer nozzle and pressure for wheat spray?
label: general_info
answer: Sprayer: flat fan nozzle; pressure label par (2–3 bar aam); height aur speed theek. Coverage achha hona chahiye; drift avoid karein.

text: Wheat field scouting kitni dafa karein?
label: general_info
answer: Scout 7–10 din par; disease/pest season mein zyada. Rust, keerey, jhariyan, pani, nutrients dekhein. Record rakhein.

text: Yield per acre wheat normal kitni honi chahiye?
label: general_info
answer: Yield per acre normal 35–50 maund irrigated; barani kam. Variety, time, khaad, pani sab pe depend karta hai.

text: Lodging in wheat kaise rokain?
label: general_info
answer: Lodging rokne ke liye N zyada mat dein; split karein. Resistant variety; grain filling par pani zyada mat dein. Harvest jald agar lodging aaye.

text: Paidawar barhane ke liye kya amal behtareen hain?
label: general_info
answer: Paidawar barhane ke liye: certified beej, waqt par bone, balanced khaad, critical stages par pani, jhariyan aur bimari time par control. Scout karte rahein; record rakhein taake agle saal behtar karein.

text: Wheat best practices summary step by step?
label: general_info
answer: Best practices: timely sowing, certified seed, line sowing, basal P+K, split N, irrigation at crown-root/tillering/booting/flowering/grain fill, weed control 25–35 DAS, rust/pest at threshold, harvest at maturity, clean storage.

text: Meri fasal mein daag aur patte sookh rahe hain kya bimari hai?
label: disease
answer: Daag aur sookhe patte rust, blight ya nutrient kami ho sakte hain. Pehchanen: rust mein powder/pustules; blight mein daag. Fungicide ya nutrient (N/zinc) mutabiq dein; photo bhej kar confirm karwa lain.

text: Saron par kaala powder ya daag zang hai?
label: disease
answer: Saron par kaala powder/stripe stem rust ya kuch aur fungus ho sakta hai. Systemic fungicide jald chhidkain; coverage saron tak. Resistant variety agle saal.

text: Pani zyada ho gaya khet mein waterlogging ka nuqsan?
label: irrigation
answer: Waterlogging se jaden galti hain, yield kam; turant pani nikaalen. Drainage theek karein; aage pani ka gap barha kar dein. Us hisse mein khaad ka asar kam hota hai.

text: Urea ki kami lag rahi hai kab topdress karein?
label: fertilizer
answer: Urea kami lag rahi ho to topdress tillering par dein; pehle pani ya baad. Doosri dose booting par de sakte hain. Dose recommendation follow karein.

text: Jarhi booti kaun si hai aur kaun sa spray?
label: weed_control
answer: Jarhi booti grass ya broad leaf dono ho sakti hai; pehchan kar us ke mutabiq herbicide: grass product ya broad leaf product. Dose aur waqt label par.

text: Dana toot raha hai kattai jaldi karein?
label: harvest
answer: Dana toot raha ho to kattai jald karein; sahi waqt par. Combine setting theek karein; garmi avoid karein. Thora early better than late.

text: Mandi door hai bechne ka behtar tareeqa?
label: market_price
answer: Mandi door ho to group se bechein ya transport share karein; direct mill deal consider karein. Rate pehle check karein; quality saaf rakhein taake reject na ho.

text: Salam khet ke sawal ke liye
label: greeting
answer: Wa alaikum assalam. Main gandum ke bone se kattai tak madad kar sakta hoon. Kya sawal hai?

text: Rabi ki fasal gandum ke liye kya kya karein?
label: general_info
answer: Rabi gandum ke liye: Oct–Nov bone, certified beej, khaad split, pani critical stages par, jhariyan 25–35 din, keera/bimari threshold par control, maturity par kattai, saaf store.

text: Drill se bone ya broadcast?
label: sowing
answer: Drill se bone behtar: uniform stand, weed control asaan, khaad efficient. Broadcast se zyada beej aur kam uniformity; drill prefer karein.
