answer: Urea top dressing at tillering stage; amount per acre as per recommendation. Second dose at booting if target yield is high. Apply with irrigation.

text: Harvest moisture for wheat storage?
label: harvest
answer: Harvest moisture for safe storage about 12–14%. Dry grain well before storing. Too high causes pests and mould; use moisture meter if available.

text: Where to sell wheat better price?
label: market_price
answer: Sell wheat where you get better price: compare mandi, procurement, direct mill. Clean and grade grain; check rate before selling. Group selling can help.

text: Pest control in wheat IPM approach?
label: pest
answer: Pest control in wheat: scout regularly; spray only when threshold crossed. Use selective insecticide; protect beneficial insects. IPM approach is best.

text: Canal water shortage wheat irrigation?
label: irrigation
answer: Canal water shortage: prioritise critical stages—booting and grain filling most important. Use ridges or beds to save water. Improve field leveling.

text: Foliar spray for nutrient deficiency?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Foliar spray for nutrient deficiency when soil uptake is poor or deficiency appears. Use recommended dose for zinc, boron or urea; avoid hot windy time.

text: Weed resistance to herbicide what to do?
label: weed_control
answer: Weed resistance: rotate herbicide mode of action; do not use same product repeatedly. Hand weed escapes. Use pre-emergence where possible.

text: Zero till wheat sowing benefits?
label: sowing
answer: Zero till wheat saves time and diesel; conserves moisture. Use after rice where stubble remains. Calibrate drill; manage residue. Good for soil health.

text: Leaf rust treatment which spray?
label: disease
answer: Leaf rust: spray systemic fungicide at first signs. Good coverage; repeat if needed. Use resistant variety next season.

text: Balanced fertilizer for wheat NPK?
label: fertilizer
answer: Balanced fertilizer: NPK as per soil test; P and K at sowing, N split. Apply at sowing, first irrigation and tillering. FYM adds benefit.

text: Combine harvest timing for wheat?
label: harvest
answer: Combine harvest when grain is fully mature and hard. Adjust drum and concave to reduce loss. Harvest in cooler part of day if possible.

text: Wheat selling tips for better rate?
label: market_price
answer: Wheat selling tips: clean and grade grain; improve test weight. Check daily rate; compare buyers. Sell at right time for your need and market.

text: Spray for aphid in wheat when?
label: pest
answer: Spray for aphid when population crosses threshold (check extension). Use recommended insecticide; spray in cooler hours. Cover ear and leaf undersides.

text: First water after wheat sowing when?
label: irrigation
answer: First water after wheat sowing about 20–25 days at crown-root stage. Then tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling. Gap 12–20 days between irrigations.

text: Boron deficiency wheat symptoms?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Boron deficiency: poor grain set, growth points affected. Apply boron (borax or other) as per soil test or recommendation. Foliar or soil application.

text: Pre emergence vs post emergence weedicide?
label: weed_control
answer: Pre-emergence vs post-emergence: pre-emergence before weeds emerge; post when weeds are small (25–35 DAS). Use as per weed type and label.

text: Wheat sowing depth and spacing?
label: sowing
answer: Wheat sowing depth 3–5 cm; row spacing about 20–25 cm. Deeper sowing delays emergence; too shallow risks birds and drying. Line sowing better than broadcast.

text: Stem rust black rust control?
label: disease
answer: Stem rust (black): black pustules on stem and leaves. Spray systemic fungicide early; good coverage. Use resistant variety next year.

text: FYM with chemical fertilizer wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: FYM with chemical: use well-decomposed FYM 2–4 ton/acre at sowing. Do not reduce chemical dose; FYM is extra. Mix before sowing.

text: Threshing loss minimize how?
label: harvest
answer: Threshing loss: harvest at right maturity; adjust combine properly. Avoid very hot dry conditions. Handle grain carefully.

text: Support price and procurement center?
label: market_price
answer: Support price and procurement: government announces each year; list of centers from food/agri office. Quality and documents as required. Sell when ready.

text: Natural control for wheat pests?
label: pest
answer: Natural control: conserve beneficial insects; use selective insecticide. Neem or biopesticide in early stage. Spray only at threshold.

text: How many irrigations total for wheat?
label: irrigation
answer: Total irrigations for wheat often 4–6 in canal areas. Critical: crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling. Gap 12–20 days by soil type.

text: Sulphur deficiency in wheat?
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Sulphur deficiency: pale yellow young leaves, less growth. Apply gypsum or sulphur fertilizer. Confirm with soil test.

text: Tank mix herbicide and urea?
label: weed_control
answer: Tank mix herbicide and urea only if both labels allow. Otherwise apply separately. Wrong mix can damage crop or reduce effect.

text: Rice wheat rotation sowing time?
label: sowing
answer: Rice-wheat rotation sowing time: sow wheat soon after rice harvest, late October to mid-November. Prepare quickly; use zero till if possible.

text: Powdery mildew on wheat?
label: disease
answer: Powdery mildew: white powder on leaves. Use fungicide labeled for powdery mildew on wheat. Spray early; improve air flow. Resistant variety helps.

text: Soil test based fertilizer for wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: Soil test based fertilizer: apply N, P, K and micronutrients as per report. Adjust dose for low or high fertility. Split nitrogen.

text: Wheat straw use after harvest?
label: harvest
answer: Wheat straw after harvest: use as fodder, sell loose or baled, or use as mulch. Mushroom growers buy in some areas. Manage residue for next crop.

text: Crop loan for wheat where to get?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Crop loan for wheat from bank or Kisan scheme. Documents: land record, CNIC, application form. Check eligibility at agri office or bank.

text: Armyworm in wheat what to spray?
label: pest
answer: Armyworm in wheat: spray insecticide labeled for armyworm on wheat. Spray in evening when larvae active. Good coverage on canopy.

text: Over irrigation damage to wheat?
label: irrigation
answer: Over-irrigation causes waterlogging, root rot and lodging. Keep gap 12–20 days between irrigations. Focus on critical stages only.

text: Mixed weed control one spray?
label: weed_control
answer: Mixed weeds: use herbicide that controls both grass and broad leaf if label allows, or two separate sprays. Apply when weeds are small.

text: Barani area wheat sowing time?
label: sowing
answer: Barani area wheat sowing after rains, often late October to mid-November. Use drought tolerant variety; seed rate slightly higher. Match local rain pattern.

text: Karnal bunt in wheat prevention?
label: disease
answer: Karnal bunt prevention: use clean certified seed; fungicide seed treatment. Do not use grain from affected crop as seed. Rotate and avoid late irrigation at heading.

text: Potash for wheat when to apply?
label: fertilizer
answer: Potash for wheat when soil test shows low K. Apply at sowing with P; about 25–50 kg K2O per acre. No need to split.

text: Grain drying after harvest?
label: harvest
answer: Grain drying after harvest: spread in thin layer, sun dry 3–7 days. Stir regularly. Target 12–14% moisture before storage.

text: Quality premium for wheat?
label: market_price
answer: Quality premium: clean grain, better test weight, uniform size. Grade before sale; meet buyer standards. Store dry to maintain quality.

text: Cutworm damage wheat control?
label: pest
answer: Cutworm damage: spray recommended insecticide on soil surface or use bait. Evening application. Ensure coverage at plant base.

text: Bed planting wheat water saving?
label: irrigation
answer: Bed planting saves water; form raised beds and irrigate in furrows. Use bed planter; seed on bed or in furrow. Better aeration.

text: Grassy weed herbicide for wheat?
label: weed_control
answer: Grassy weed in wheat: use grass-selective herbicide (e.g. clodinafop) at 25–35 DAS. Correct dose and nozzle. Separate product for broad leaf.

text: Seed treatment for wheat which product?
label: sowing
answer: Seed treatment for wheat: use fungicide for smut/bunt; insecticide if termite risk. Rate per kg on label. Dry after treatment before sowing.

text: Leaf blight wheat fungicide?
label: disease
answer: Leaf blight wheat: use fungicide labeled for leaf spots (tan spot, septoria). Spray at first signs. Resistant variety and balanced N help.

text: Micronutrient spray for wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: Micronutrient spray for wheat when deficiency appears: zinc, boron or foliar urea. Use recommended dose; avoid hot windy time. Repeat if needed.

text: Safe storage moisture wheat?
label: harvest
answer: Storage pest control: keep grain dry (12–14% moisture); fumigate or use contact insecticide if needed. Clean store; check regularly.

text: Forward contract wheat selling?
label: market_price
answer: Test weight and wheat price: better test weight gets higher price. Keep grain plump and clean; good harvest and storage practices.

text: Rodent control wheat field?
label: pest
answer: Selective insecticide targets pest and spares beneficial insects. Use for IPM; spray only at threshold. Check label for target pest.

text: Sprinkler for wheat irrigation?
label: irrigation
answer: Farm pond for wheat: use when canal is short. Prioritise critical stages. Refill depends on rain; plan area according to pond size.

text: Herbicide rotation why important?
label: weed_control
answer: Herbicide rotation prevents resistance. Use different mode of action in rotation. Do not repeat same product season after season.

text: Happy seeder for wheat after rice?
label: sowing
answer: Happy seeder for wheat after rice: places seed and fertilizer in stubble. Saves time and moisture; improve soil. Set drill correctly; clear residue blockages.

text: Root rot wheat identification?
label: disease
answer: Root rot in wheat: roots rot, plant easy to pull. Improve drainage; avoid waterlogging. Resistant variety and rotation; seed treatment helps.

text: Green manure before wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: Green manure before wheat: grow short legume (moong, mash), incorporate 3–4 weeks before sowing. Adds N and organic matter. Reduce N dose slightly if heavy biomass.

text: Storage pest control wheat?
label: harvest
answer: Storage insect: keep grain dry and clean. Fumigation for heavy infestation; contact spray on bags/surface. Check regularly; treat if pests appear.

text: Test weight and wheat price?
label: market_price
answer: Test weight better means higher price from mills. Keep grain plump, clean and dry. Good harvest timing and storage.

text: Threshold for spray in wheat pest?
label: pest
answer: Pheromone trap helps monitor some pests; not full control for wheat aphid/rust. Use as part of IPM. Check if recommended for your pest.

text: Rainfed wheat supplemental irrigation?
label: irrigation
answer: Rainfed wheat supplemental irrigation: if 1–2 irrigations possible, give at booting and grain filling. Conserve moisture with residue and timely sowing.

text: Resistant weed management wheat?
label: weed_control
answer: Resistant weed: use herbicide with different mode of action; rotate products. Hand weed escapes. Do not rely on one herbicide only.

text: Laser leveling before wheat?
label: sowing
answer: Laser leveling before wheat improves water use and yield. One-time cost; rent available. Especially useful if field is uneven.

text: Fusarium wheat head blight?
label: disease
answer: Fusarium wheat head blight: pink mould, shriveled grains. Use resistant variety; fungicide at flowering if recommended. Remove residue; do not use affected grain as seed.

text: 4R nutrient wheat what is it?
label: fertilizer
answer: 4R nutrient: Right source (correct fertilizer), Right rate (soil test), Right time (basal + split), Right place (near seed but not touching). Improves efficiency.

text: Fumigation wheat storage?
label: harvest
answer: Fumigation of wheat storage when pests are present or long storage. Use aluminium phosphide with full safety; seal store 5–7 days. Ventilate before entry.

text: Group selling wheat benefit?
label: market_price
answer: Group selling wheat: larger quantity; better negotiation. Join cooperative or farmer group. Clear terms and payment in writing.

text: Biopesticide for wheat aphid?
label: pest
answer: Biopesticide for wheat aphid: neem or other approved product. Works better in early stage. Combine with good practice; may need chemical if heavy.

text: Supplemental irrigation wheat?
label: irrigation
answer: Supplemental irrigation in wheat when rain is not enough: give at booting and grain filling at least. Even one irrigation at right stage helps.

text: Organic weed control wheat?
label: weed_control
answer: Organic weed control: hand weeding, stale seedbed, line sowing, rotation. No herbicide; more labour. Mulch and dense crop help.

text: Wide row wheat sowing?
label: sowing
answer: Wide row wheat sowing sometimes used; narrow row (20–25 cm) usually gives better yield. Follow local recommendation and drill type.

text: Viral disease wheat curling?
label: disease
answer: Viral disease wheat curling: leaves curl and yellow. Remove infected plants; control aphid vector. Use healthy seed; no direct cure for virus.

text: Gypsum for saline soil wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: Gypsum for saline soil before wheat: dose from soil test, often 1–2 ton/acre. Apply and mix before sowing. Improve drainage to leach salts.

text: Grading wheat before sale?
label: harvest
answer: Grading wheat before sale: sort by size, weight and cleanliness. Better grade gets better price. Meet buyer or mandi standards.

text: Commission agent wheat sale?
label: market_price
answer: Commission agent: agree rate and commission in advance; check weight yourself. Get receipt; clarify payment time. Compare with other agents if possible.

text: Pheromone trap wheat pests?
label: pest
answer: Pheromone trap for wheat pests: used for monitoring some species; not main control for aphid/rust. Can be part of IPM; ask extension if useful for your area.

text: Border strip irrigation wheat?
label: irrigation
answer: Border strip irrigation: divide field into strips; water flows from one to next. Reduces waste. Needs good leveling.

text: Mechanical weeding wheat?
label: weed_control
answer: Mechanical weeding in wheat: use weeder when weeds are small (25–30 DAS). Complements herbicide; more labour. Available from machinery dealers.

text: Stubble mulch wheat sowing?
label: sowing
answer: Stubble mulch wheat sowing: sow with zero till in residue. Saves moisture and improves soil. Use happy seeder or zero till drill; manage residue amount.

text: Black point wheat grain?
label: disease
answer: Black point wheat grain: dark spot at grain end; affects quality. Use resistant variety; harvest at right time. Store dry; separate affected grain.

text: Compost with fertilizer wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: Compost with fertilizer for wheat: well-decomposed compost 2–4 ton/acre at sowing. Add to soil; do not replace full chemical dose. Improves soil.

text: Condensation storage wheat?
label: harvest
answer: Condensation in storage damages grain. Keep grain dry (12–14%); ventilate store; avoid big temperature change. Do not stack bags against cold walls.

text: Direct mill sale wheat?
label: market_price
answer: Direct mill sale can give better rate than mandi. Quantity and quality matter. Clarify transport and payment. Compare with mandi rate.

text: Selective insecticide wheat?
label: pest
answer: Selective insecticide kills target pest and spares beneficials. Use for IPM; check label for target. Avoid broad-spectrum when not needed.

text: Farm pond wheat irrigation?
label: irrigation
answer: Farm pond water for wheat irrigation: use when canal is short. Prioritise critical stages. Refill depends on rainfall; plan area accordingly.

text: Strip crop weed control?
label: weed_control
answer: Strip crop for weed control: alternate strips of wheat with other crop. Can reduce weed spread. Width and crop as per local practice.

text: Precision sowing wheat?
label: sowing
answer: Precision sowing wheat: calibrate drill for seed rate and depth. Check cups and speed. Test in field for uniform stand.

text: Slow rusting variety wheat?
label: disease
answer: Slow rusting variety has slower rust development. Ask research station or extension for list. Name may include resistant or tolerant. Use for next season.

text: Legume after wheat fertilizer?
label: fertilizer
answer: Legume after wheat: next crop (e.g. moong) needs less N because wheat residue and rotation. Apply P and K as needed; adjust N from soil test.

text: Weighbridge wheat sale?
label: market_price
answer: Weighbridge at sale: ensure you see weight; get slip. Check rate and deductions. Keep copy of weight and rate.

text: Scout wheat field frequency?
label: general_info
answer: Scout wheat field every 7–10 days; more often when disease or pest risk is high. Look for rust, aphid, weeds, water stress. Record what you see.

text: Drought variety wheat?
label: sowing
answer: Drought tolerant wheat variety for dry areas: get list from agri department. Often early and stress-tolerant. Suited to rainfed or limited irrigation.

text: Rust race wheat variety?
label: disease
answer: Rust race in wheat variety: different rust races exist; variety resistant to one may be susceptible to another. Use current recommended list from research station.

text: Phosphorus timing wheat?
label: fertilizer
answer: Phosphorus timing for wheat: apply full P at sowing as basal with DAP or SSP. No need to split; availability better when placed near seed at sowing.

text: Insurance claim wheat crop loss?
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Insurance claim for wheat crop loss: report loss to company or agri office with photos. Survey will be done; submit form and documents. Compensation as per policy. Follow time limit.

text: bhai gandum mein keera lag gaya kya karun
label: pest
answer: Pehle keera pehchanen ke chust hai ya termite ya koi aur. Chust ho to extension se recommended insecticide len aur sahi dose par subah ya sham chhidkain. Patton ke niche bhi spray karein taake sab keerey mar jayein. Zyada nitrogen mat dein aur khet saaf rakhein.

text: pani kab den gandum ko
label: irrigation
answer: Pehla pani bone ke 20–25 din baad dein jab crown-root stage ho. Us ke baad tillering, booting, phool aur grain filling par pani zaroori hai. Do paniyon ke beech 12–20 din ka gap rakhein zameen ke hisaab se.

text: meri fasal zard ho rahi hai kya wajah
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Zard patte aksar nitrogen ki kami se hote hain; kabhi zinc kami bhi hoti hai. Purane patte zard hon to urea topdress karein tillering par. Naye patton par safed lakeeren hon to zinc spray use karein. Pani bhi theek rakhein taake khaad sookh sake.

text: jhariyan zyada hain kaun sa spray marun
label: weed_control
answer: Jhariyan chhoti hon to post-emergence weedicide chhidkain bone ke 25–35 din baad. Grass jhari ho to grass wala spray, broad leaf ho to broad leaf wala len. Extension se product ka naam puchen; dose label par follow karein.

text: gandum kab boen sahi waqt kya hai
label: sowing
answer: Gandum bone ka behtar waqt late October se mid-November hota hai. Chawal ya cotton kattai ke baad jald boen. Certified beej use karein aur bone se pehle seed treatment zaroor karein.

text: patton pe daag aa gaye bimari lag rahi
label: disease
answer: Daag rust ya leaf blight ho sakte hain. Rust pe powder jaisi pustules hoti hain. Jald fungicide chhidkain jo wheat ke liye recommend ho. Resistant variety agle saal use karein.

text: urea kab dalni hai aur kitni
label: fertilizer
answer: Urea bone par thori aur zyada tillering par topdress dein. Pehli dose pehle pani ke sath ya crown-root stage par. Doosri dose tillering par; kitni per acre local recommendation dekhein.

text: kattai kab karein gandum ready hai ya nahi
label: harvest
answer: Jab dana sakht ho aur naakhun se toot na sake tab kattai karein. Bhoosa zard ho jaye aur nami kam ho. Jaldi kaatna behtar hai der se; der se dana toot jata hai.

text: aaj gandum ka rate kya hai
label: market_price
answer: Rate rozana mandi, sarkari SMS ya agri app se check karein. Aaj ka rate wahi se pata chalega. Bechne se pehle rate dekh lain taake beopari kam na de.

text: chust keera lag gaya dawai batao
label: pest
answer: Chust ke liye recommended insecticide use karein jab colony zyada ho. Subah ya sham thandi hawa mein spray karein. Patton ke niche bhi coverage dein; dose label par follow karein.

text: pehla pani kitne din baad dena hai
label: irrigation
answer: Pehla pani bone ke 20–25 din baad dein. Jab 2–3 patte nikle hon aur crown-root stage ho tab. Exact din zameen aur mausam se thora farq ho sakta hai.

text: patte zard kyun ho rahe nitrogen kami hai
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Purane patte zard nitrogen kami ki nishani hain. Urea topdress karein tillering par; pehle pani dein phir urea. Agar naye patton par safed lakeeren hon to zinc kami hai; zinc spray chhidkain.

text: weedicide kab chhidkain sahi waqt
label: weed_control
answer: Weedicide bone ke 25–35 din baad chhidkain jab jhariyan chhoti hon. Subah ya sham hawa calm ho to spray karein. Product wheat ke liye aur jhari ki qism ke mutabiq len.

text: chawal ke baad gandum kab tak bo len
label: sowing
answer: Chawal ke baad jald gandum boen; late October se mid-November tak. Zero till drill ya happy seeder use karein agar ho. Certified beej aur seed treatment zaroori hain.

text: zang lag gaya hai kaun si dawai chhidkain
label: disease
answer: Zang ke liye systemic fungicide use karein jo rust pe recommend ho. Pehli nishani par jald chhidkain; coverage achha hona chahiye. Resistant variety agle saal len.

text: DAP kab dalen aur kitni per acre
label: fertilizer
answer: DAP bone par dalen aam tor par 1–2 bag per acre. Urea ka hissa bone par thora aur baqi pehle pani aur tillering par. Total kitni local recommendation ya agri office se puchen.

text: dana kaise store karein keerey na lagain
label: harvest
answer: Dana bilkul sukha karke store karein; nami 12–14% se kam ho. Saaf sukhi boriyon ya bins mein rakhein. Keerey dikhein to fumigation ya recommended dawai use karein.

text: support price kya hai is saal
label: market_price
answer: Support price sarkar har saal announce karti hai. News ya agri department se check karein. Procurement centers ki list food department ya agri office se milegi.

text: termite ne jaden kha di hain kaise bachain
label: pest
answer: Termite ke liye pani nikalne ka bandobast karein; waterlogging na ho. Beej ko insecticide se treat karein bone se pehle. Purani stubble hataen; field drainage theek rakhein.

text: do paniyon ke beech kitna gap rakhein
label: irrigation
answer: Do paniyon ke beech 12–20 din ka gap rakhein. Raiti zameen par kam gap rakhein; bhari zameen par zyada. Critical stages par pani mat chhoren.

text: zinc ki kami hai patton pe safed lakeeren
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Zinc kami mein naye patton par safed lakeeren hoti hain. Zinc sulphate zameen mein ya foliar zinc spray tillering par use karein. Extension se dose puchen; repeat ho sake agar kami rahe.

text: jhariyan kaise hatain spray ya godai
label: weed_control
answer: Chhoti jhariyan hon to spray kaafi hai; badi hon to pehle godai karein. Post-emergence weedicide 25–35 din baad chhidkain. Product jhari ki qism ke mutabiq len.

text: kitna beej dalna hai per acre
label: sowing
answer: Per acre aam tor par 40–50 kg beej use hota hai. Region aur variety se thora farq ho sakta hai. Late bone ho to thori zyada beej dalen.

text: peeli zang lag gayi fungicide kaun si
label: disease
answer: Peeli zang ke liye systemic fungicide chhidkain jo stripe rust pe recommend ho. Jald spray karein pehli nishani par. Resistant variety agle saal use karein.

text: topdress urea kab den tillering par
label: fertilizer
answer: Topdress urea tillering stage par dein; bone ke 40–50 din baad. Kitni per acre local recommendation follow karein. Pani de kar ya light irrigation ke baad dalen.

text: kattai ke baad bhoosa ka kya karein
label: harvest
answer: Bhoosa charay ke tor par use kar sakte hain ya bech sakte hain. Baler ho to bale bana kar bechna behtar. Kuch kisan ise next fasal ke liye mulch bhi karte hain.

text: mandi rate kaise check karein
label: market_price
answer: Mandi rate mandi office, SMS service ya agri app se roz check karein. Bechne se pehle same din ka rate dekh lain. Do teen jagah se rate puchen taake behtar mile.

text: keeron se fasal nuqsan ho rahi hai
label: pest
answer: Keera pehchanen phir us ke mutabiq insecticide len. Extension se recommended product aur dose puchen. Spray subah ya sham karein; threshold par hi chhidkain.

text: nehr band hai pani kaise manage karein
label: irrigation
answer: Nehr band ho to tube well, pond ya stored pani use karein. Critical stages par zaroor dein: tillering, booting, grain filling. Pani bachane ke liye ridges ya beds use karein.

text: urea ki kami lag rahi kab topdress karein
label: fertilizer
answer: Urea kami lag rahi ho to tillering par topdress karein. Pehle pani dein phir urea dalen. Doosri dose booting par bhi de sakte hain agar zarurat ho.

text: broad leaf jhari ka kaun sa spray
label: weed_control
answer: Broad leaf jhari ke liye 2,4-D jaisa wheat ke liye approved product use karein. Bone ke 25–35 din baad jab jhariyan chhoti hon. Dose label par hoti hai.

text: der se bone theek hai ya nahi
label: sowing
answer: Der bone se yield kam hoti hai lekin ho sakta hai. Seed rate thori barha den; resistant variety len. Critical pani aur khaad time par dein.

text: kali zang stem pe aa gayi ilaaj
label: disease
answer: Kali zang stem pe hoti hai. Systemic fungicide jo stem rust pe recommend ho jald chhidkain. Coverage stem tak hona chahiye; resistant variety agle saal.

text: gobar ki khaad de sakte hain chemical ke sath
label: fertilizer
answer: Gobar ki khaad galay hui 2–4 ton per acre de sakte hain. Chemical khaad ke sath dein; chemical kam mat karein. Bone se pehle zameen mein mix karein.

text: combine se kaatne par nuqsan kam kaise karein
label: harvest
answer: Combine ki drum speed aur concave setting theek karein. Grain bilkul ready hone dein; thandi subah ya sham kaatein. Garmi mein kattai se nuqsan zyada hota hai.

text: bechne ka behtar waqt kab hai
label: market_price
answer: Bechne ka waqt aap ki zarurat aur rate par depend karta hai. Paise chahiye hon to jaldi bechein. Store safe ho aur rate barhne ka andaza ho to thora ruk sakte hain.

text: aphid bahut zyada ho gaye spray kab karein
label: pest
answer: Aphid zyada hon to recommended insecticide jald chhidkain. Ears aur upper leaves par coverage dein. Subah ya sham spray karein; dose label par follow karein.

text: crown root stage par pani kab den
label: irrigation
answer: Crown root stage par pani bone ke 20–25 din baad dena hai. Jab 2–3 patte aur crown roots ban rahe hon. Is ke baad tillering, booting, phool aur grain filling par pani dein.

text: boron kami hai kaise pehchanen
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Boron kami mein growth points aur grain set pe asar hota hai. Borax ya boron fertilizer soil ya foliar use karein. Soil test se confirm karwa sakte hain.

text: post emergence weedicide ka naam batao
label: weed_control
answer: Post-emergence weedicide 2,4-D (broad leaf) ya clodinafop (grass) jaisa wheat ke liye use hota hai. Bone ke 25–35 din baad chhidkain. Extension se apni jhari ke mutabiq naam puchen.

text: zero till se bone ka faida kya hai
label: sowing
answer: Zero till se waqt aur diesel bachta hai; nami bachti hai. Chawal ke baad ideal hai; stubble rehne dete hain. Drill ki setting sahi karein taake beej theek place ho.

text: smut bimari beej se kaise bachain
label: disease
answer: Smut se bachne ke liye certified ya saaf beej use karein. Fungicide seed treatment zaroor karein bone se pehle. Smut wali fasal ka beej dobara na use karein.

text: basal khaad bone par kya kya dalen
label: fertilizer
answer: Basal par DAP 1–2 bag per acre aur urea ka hissa dalen. Potash agar soil test mein kam ho to. Nitrogen ka baqi hissa pehle pani aur tillering par topdress dein.

text: grain ko sukha kar store kaise karein
label: harvest
answer: Dana patli layer mein dhoop mein sukhaen; roz palattein. Nami 12–14% tak laen phir store karein. Saaf boriyon ya bins mein rakhein; keerey se bachav karein.

text: procurement center kahan hai qareeb
label: market_price
answer: Procurement center ki list food department ya agri office se lein. Online bhi mil jati hai. Qareeb wala center puchen; quality standards follow karein.

text: armyworm plants kaat raha hai kya spray karun
label: pest
answer: Armyworm ke liye recommended insecticide use karein jo wheat par allow ho. Sham ko spray karein jab larvae zyada hon. Patton aur base par coverage dein.

text: kitni dafa pani dena hai total
label: irrigation
answer: Total 4–6 pani canal area mein aam tor par dena hota hai. Crown-root, tillering, booting, flowering aur grain filling par. Gap 12–20 din zameen ke hisaab se.

text: sulphur kami hai patte peeli ho rahe
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Sulphur kami mein young patte peele hote hain. Gypsum ya sulphur fertilizer use karein. Soil test se confirm karwa lain.

text: tank mix urea aur weedicide ek sath chalega
label: weed_control
answer: Tank mix sirf tab karein jab dono products ki label allow kare. Kaheen urea spray ko nuqsan pahunchati hai. Safe option alag alag spray karna hai.

text: seed treatment zaroori hai kaun sa fungicide
label: sowing
answer: Seed treatment zaroori hai smut bunt se bachne ke liye. Systemic fungicide use karein jo beej ke diseases ke khilaf ho. Treatment ke baad beej shade mein sukha kar boen.

text: leaf blight lag rahi fungicide batao
label: disease
answer: Leaf blight ke liye fungicide use karein jo leaf spots pe recommend ho. Jald chhidkain jab pehli daag dikhe. Resistant variety aur balanced nitrogen bhi madad karte hain.

text: soil test ke baad khaad ka plan kaise banayein
label: fertilizer
answer: Soil test ke baad N P K ki recommendation aati hai. Us ke mutabiq DAP urea dose fix karein. Kam zarkhaiz zameen mein dose barhi hoti hai; zinc boron agar kam hon to add karein.

text: storage mein keerey lag gaye kaise marain
label: harvest
answer: Storage keerey se bachane ke liye dana bilkul sukha store karein. Fumigation ya contact insecticide boriyon par use karein. Godown dry aur clean rakhein; check karte rahein.

text: quality wheat ka zyada rate kaise mile
label: market_price
answer: Quality wheat ke liye grain saaf karein mote danay alag karein. Grading karein taake behtar rate mile. Test weight achha rakhein; storage bhi dry rakhein.

text: rodent khet mein nuqsan kar raha control kaise karein
label: pest
answer: Rodent ke liye field edges saaf rakhein; burrows band karein. Poison bait safe tarike se use kar sakte hain; bachon janwaron se door. Storage bhi rodent-proof rakhein.

text: raiti zameen hai pani jaldi sookh jata kitni dafa den
label: irrigation
answer: Raiti zameen mein pani jaldi sookh jata hai is liye gap kam rakhein. 10–15 din ka gap; kam pani bar bar dein. Critical stages par zaroor dein.

text: pre emergence miss ho gayi ab kya karein
label: weed_control
answer: Pre emergence miss ho to post-emergence jald chhidkain jab jhariyan chhoti hon. 25–35 din after sowing. Product wheat aur jhari ki qism ke mutabiq len.

text: row spacing kitna rakhein drill mein
label: sowing
answer: Row spacing aam tor par 20–25 cm rakhein drill mein. Narrow spacing se canopy jaldi close hoti hai. Local recommendation follow karein.

text: powdery mildew safed powder patton par ilaaj
label: disease
answer: Powdery mildew patton par safed powder jaisa dikhata hai. Sulphur ya triazole fungicide wheat par use karein. Jald spray karein; resistant variety bhi len.

text: potash bhi deni chahiye kab aur kitni
label: fertilizer
answer: Potash soil test mein kam ho to sowing par dein. Aam tor par 25–50 kg K2O per acre. Zyada tar soils mein N aur P ki kami zyada hoti hai.

text: threshing loss kam karne ka tareeqa
label: harvest
answer: Threshing loss kam karne ke liye grain ko bilkul ready hone dein. Combine setting theek karein; manual ho to dheere kaatein. Garmi mein kattai avoid karein.

text: wheat loan kahan se milega
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Wheat loan bank ya Kisan scheme se milta hai. Zameen ke kaghzat CNIC aur form chahiye. Agri office se scheme ki details lein.

text: faida mand keere bachane chahiye spray se pehle
label: pest
answer: Faida mand keere (ladybird etc) ko bachane ke liye selective insecticide use karein. Spray sirf jab zarurat ho threshold par. Broad-spectrum avoid karein jab tak mushkil na ho.

text: land tayari kaise karein bone se pehle
label: sowing
answer: Land tayari: 1–2 plough phir 2–3 harrow karein. Zameen bareek aur level karein. Bone se 1–2 haftay pehle tayari khatam karein.

text: pani zyada ho gaya khet mein nuqsan hoga
label: irrigation
answer: Pani zyada hone se waterlogging ho sakti hai; jaden galti hoti hain. Turant pani nikalne ka bandobast karein. Aage pani ka gap barha kar dein.

text: herbicide rotate karna kyun zaroori hai
label: weed_control
answer: Herbicide rotate is liye zaroori hai ke ek hi product bar bar use se jhariyan resistant ho jati hain. Alag alag product alternate karein. Is se long-term control behtar rehta hai.

text: Punjab mein gandum bone ka mahina konsa
label: sowing
answer: Punjab mein gandum bone ka mahina late October se mid-November hota hai. Region se thora farq; agri office se exact dates puchen. Der bone se yield kam hoti hai.

text: karnal bunt danon pe kaala ilaaj
label: disease
answer: Karnal bunt danon pe kaala daag aur badboo hoti hai. Certified saaf beej use karein; seed treatment zaroor karein. Infected grain beej ke liye use na karein.

text: FYM kitni dalen per acre
label: fertilizer
answer: FYM 2–4 ton per acre galay hui dal sakte hain. Chemical khaad ke sath dein; chemical ki dose kam mat karein. Bone se pehle zameen mein mix karein.

text: moisture kitni honi chahiye store ke waqt
label: harvest
answer: Store ke waqt nami 12–14% ya us se kam honi chahiye. Zyada nami se keerey aur fungus lagte hain. Sukha kar ke hi store karein.

text: kisan card se qarz kaise milega
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Kisan card se qarz ke liye bank ya designated office mein apply karein. Zameen ke kaghzat CNIC aur form chahiye. Scheme ki details agri office se puchen.

text: subah spray karein ya sham chust ke liye
label: pest
answer: Chust ke liye subah ya sham spray karein jab hawa thandi ho. Dhoop mein spray kam asar karti hai. Recommended dose use karein; patton ke niche bhi coverage dein.

text: cotton ke baad gandum kab boen
label: sowing
answer: Cotton ke baad jald gandum boen late October tak. Seed rate normal rakhein; zero till drill use karein agar ho. Cotton stalks manage karein taake drill atakay na.

text: frost aa sakta hai wheat ko bachain kaise
label: weather_risk
answer: Frost se bachane ke liye frost se pehle light irrigation dein taake zameen thandi na ho. Frost-prone area mein jaldi bone se bachein. Variety bhi thori resistant len.

text: beds par bone se pani bachta hai
label: irrigation
answer: Beds par bone se pani furrows mein chalta hai; wastage kam hoti hai. Bed planter use karein; beej beds par ya furrow mein. Pani bachta hai aur aeration behtar hoti hai.

text: root rot lag rahi jaden galti ho rahi
label: disease
answer: Root rot mein jaden galti brown black hoti hain. Drainage theek karein; waterlogging na hone dein. Resistant variety aur rotation; seed treatment bhi madad karta hai.

text: grass aur broad leaf dono jhariyan hain ek spray se ho jayegi
label: weed_control
answer: Grass aur broad leaf dono hon to do alag spray kar sakte hain ya woh product len jo dono par label pe allow ho. Pehle ek qism phir doosri; label aur extension se confirm karein.

text: beej kitni gehrayi par bone karein
label: sowing
answer: Beej 3–5 cm gehrayi par bone karein. Zyada gehrayi se germination late hoti hai. Nami zameen mein 3–4 cm kaafi hai.

text: foliar urea kab chhidkain patton par
label: fertilizer
answer: Foliar urea tillering par chhidkain jab N kami dikhe. 2–5% solution use karein; dhoop aur tez hawa mein avoid karein. Ye supplement hai soil urea ki jagah nahi.

text: godaam mein dana safe kaise rakhein
label: harvest
answer: Godaam dry aur clean rakhein; nami 12–14% se kam. Boriyon ko deewar se door rakhein. Keerey dikhein to fumigation ya treatment karein.

text: crop insurance kaise len wheat ke liye
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Crop insurance bank ya company se len; premium sarkar subsidize karti hai. Nuqsan par claim file karte hain. Agri office se details lein.

text: selective insecticide matlab kya hai
label: pest
answer: Selective insecticide woh hota hai jo sirf nuqsan deh keera marta hai aur faida mand keere bach jate hain. Label par target pest likha hota hai. IPM ke liye selective use karein.

text: stubble ke sath zero till se kaise boen
label: sowing
answer: Stubble ke sath zero till: happy seeder ya zero till drill use karein. Seed aur khaad stubble ke beech place hota hai. Residue zyada ghana na hona chahiye.

text: terminal heat se bachne ka kya karein
label: weather_risk
answer: Terminal heat se bachne ke liye waqt par boen taake grain fill garmi se pehle ho jaye. Last pani grain filling par zaroor dein. Heat tolerant variety agar ho to len.

text: sprinkler wheat ke liye theek hai ya nahi
label: irrigation
answer: Sprinkler wheat ke liye theek hai khaas kar light zameen par. Pani uniform banta hai. Cost aur maintenance dekhein; chhote kisan rent par bhi use karte hain.

text: fusarium head blight ki pehchan kya hai
label: disease
answer: Fusarium head blight saron par ghalat rang pink mould aur chhote danay banata hai. Resistant variety use karein; flowering par fungicide agar recommend ho. Infected grain beej ke liye na use karein.

text: cultural method se jhariyan kaise control karein
label: weed_control
answer: Cultural method: line sowing sahi population timely pani crop rotation. Stale seedbed pehle jhariyan niklein phir boen. Haath se godai 25–30 din tak; clean equipment use karein.

text: barani area mein gandum kab boen
label: sowing
answer: Barani area mein barish ke baad boen jab nami enough ho. Late Oct se mid-Nov aam waqt. Drought tolerant variety aur seed rate thori zyada rakhein.

text: 4R khaad ka matlab kya hai
label: fertilizer
answer: 4R matlab Right source Right rate Right time Right place. Sahi khaad sahi dose sahi waqt par sahi jagah. Soil test se rate; basal aur split topdress; beej ke paas lekin touch na ho.

text: fumigation store ke andar kab karein
label: harvest
answer: Fumigation jab storage mein keerey zyada hon ya long term store ho. Aluminium phosphide use hoti hai; safety rules zaroor follow karein. Godown band karke 5–7 din rakhein phir hawa dein.

text: group bechne se faida hota hai
label: market_price
answer: Group bechne se quantity zyada hoti hai; rate negotiate behtar ho sakta hai. Cooperative join karein; terms aur payment likhwain. Buyer ko bada lot pasand aata hai.

text: IPM approach kya hai keeron ke liye
label: pest
answer: IPM matlab keeron ko sirf zarurat par control karein; faida mand keere bachain. Scout karein threshold dekhein; selective insecticide use karein. Neem ya biopesticide shuru mein try kar sakte hain.

text: happy seeder ka istemal kaise karein
label: machinery
answer: Happy seeder chawal ki stubble ke beech seed aur khaad place karta hai. Setting theek karein; seed rate aur depth sahi. Stubble zyada ghana na ho taake drill atakay na.

text: plant population kitni honi chahiye per acre
label: sowing
answer: Plant population per acre region aur variety par depend karti hai. Aam tor par 30–40 lakh plants per acre theek hai. Seed rate aur line sowing se achieve hota hai.

text: garmi wheat par asar daal rahi hai
label: weather_risk
answer: Garmi grain filling par asar dalti hai; dana chhota reh jata hai. Waqt par boen taake grain fill peak garmi se pehle ho. Last pani grain filling par zaroor dein.

text: supplemental irrigation barani wheat mein kab den
label: irrigation
answer: Barani wheat mein agar 1–2 pani ka mauka ho to booting aur grain filling par dein. Ye do stages sab se critical. Residue cover aur timely sowing se nami bachayein.

text: viral disease patte curl ho rahe hain
label: disease
answer: Viral disease mein patte curl aur zard hote hain. Infected plants hataen; aphid control karein taake virus na phile. Healthy seed use karein; direct ilaaj nahi hota.

text: organic tarike se jhariyan kaise hatain
label: weed_control
answer: Organic tarike se: line sowing godai stale seedbed rotation. Haath se nindaai 25–30 din tak. Herbicide ke bina thori zyada mehnat lagti hai.

text: gypsum khari zameen par kitni dalen
label: fertilizer
answer: Gypsum khari zameen ke liye soil test se dose aati hai. Aam tor par 1–2 ton per acre. Sowing se pehle spread karke mix karein; drainage theek rakhein.

text: grading karke bechein to zyada rate milega
label: harvest
answer: Grading se grain size aur cleanliness se sort karte hain. Clean mote danay zyada rate par bikte hain. Mandi ya buyer ki standards follow karein.

text: commission agent se deal karte waqt kya dhyan dein
label: market_price
answer: Commission agent se deal mein rate pehle clear karein. Weight khud dekhein; receipt lo. Payment time aur deduction likhwain. Do agents se rate compare karein.

text: biopesticide chust ke liye kaun si use karein
label: pest
answer: Biopesticide neem based ya Bt jaisi wheat ke liye use hoti hai. Early stage par zyada asar. Strong attack par chemical bhi zaroori ho sakta hai.

text: wide row ya narrow row kaun behtar
label: sowing
answer: Narrow row 20–25 cm zyada tar areas mein behtar yield deti hai. Wide row kam use hoti hai. Local recommendation aur drill dekhein.

text: climate smart wheat farming kya hoti hai
label: weather_risk
answer: Climate smart wheat matlab aise amal jo pani bachayein mausam ke sath adjust hon. Timely sowing drought variety residue cover efficient irrigation. Long-term ke liye behtar.

text: community tube well se pani ka schedule kaise banayein
label: irrigation
answer: Community tube well se pani ka schedule banaen; sab milkar fixed days fix karein. Critical stages par sab ko pani mile. Pani bachane ke liye leveling aur beds use karein.

text: resistant variety zang ke liye kaun si len
label: disease
answer: Zang resistant variety list agri department ya research station se lein. Har zone ki alag recommendation hoti hai. Current rust races ke hisaab se choose karein.

text: mechanical weeder wheat ke liye milta hai
label: weed_control
answer: Mechanical weeder wheat ke liye milta hai; cono weeder power weeder. Jab jhariyan chhoti hon 25–30 din tak use karein. Herbicide ke sath combine karke use karein.

text: green manure kaun si fasal bone se pehle
label: fertilizer
answer: Green manure moong mash jaisi short crop 6–8 haftay uga kar galay karein. Wheat bone se 3–4 haftay pehle incorporate karein. Nitrogen aur organic matter milti hai.

text: condensation se dana kharab ho raha kaise bachain
label: harvest
answer: Condensation se bachne ke liye grain bilkul sukha store karein. Godown hawa daar rakhein; boriyon ko deewar se door. Temperature change kam rakhein.

text: digital app se wheat bech sakte hain
label: market_price
answer: Digital app se wheat bech sakte hain; sarkari e-mandi ya agri apps. Registration aur quality weight enter karein. Rate aur payment terms check karein.

text: neem spray chust par kaam karti hai
label: pest
answer: Neem spray chust par early stage par kaam karti hai. Strong infestation par chemical insecticide zaroori ho sakta hai. Dose label par follow karein.

text: laser leveling bone se pehle zaroori hai
label: sowing
answer: Laser leveling bone se pehle use karein taake pani uniform mile. Yield 5–15% barh sakta hai. Chhote kisan rent par leveler le sakte hain.

text: hail damage ho gaya claim kaise karein
label: weather_risk
answer: Oala damage par crop insurance claim kar sakte hain agar policy ho. Photos lein; agri office ya company ko turant report karein. Survey ke baad compensation milti hai.

text: ridges par bone se pani bachta hai
label: irrigation
answer: Ridges par bone se pani furrows mein chalta hai. Bed planter use karein; beej ridges par. Pani bachta hai aur waterlogging kam hoti hai.

text: black point danon pe kaala daag kyun
label: disease
answer: Black point danon ke end par kaala daag hota hai. Timely harvest aur dry storage se bachav. Infected grain alag karein.

text: weed competition se yield kitna kam hoti hai
label: weed_control
answer: Weed competition se yield 20–50% tak kam ho sakti hai. Control 25–35 din mein zaroori hai. Line sowing aur timely herbicide se bachav.

text: lodging aa rahi hai kaise rokain
label: fertilizer
answer: Lodging rokne ke liye nitrogen zyada mat dein; split karein. Resistant variety use karein. Grain filling par pani zyada mat dein.

text: safe moisture level store ke liye kya hai
label: harvest
answer: Safe moisture 12–14% ya us se kam. Zyada nami se keerey fungus. Moisture meter se check karein; nahi ho to grain ko dant se test karein.

text: warehouse receipt loan kaise kaam karta hai
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Warehouse receipt se aap grain deposit karke receipt lete hain; us par bank se loan mil sakta hai. Rate better hone par bech kar loan chuka dete hain. Warehouse charges aur terms puchen.

text: threshold matlab kya hai jab spray karna zaroori ho
label: pest
answer: Threshold matlab woh hadd jis par spray zaroori ho jati hai. Aphid ke liye aam tor par 5–10 per tiller ya ear. Extension se exact figure puchen.

text: germination test beej ka kaise karein
label: sowing
answer: Germination test: 100 beej sample le kar geela kapra par 7–10 din rakhein. Kitne ugay count karein; 80%+ achha hai. Kam ho to seed rate barhaen ya naya beej len.

text: weather advisory kab check karein wheat ke liye
label: weather_risk
answer: Weather advisory mausam department agri SMS ya app se check karein. Frost barish garmi hail se pehle plan karein. Critical stages par roz check karein.

text: border strip irrigation kya hoti hai
label: irrigation
answer: Border strip irrigation mein field ko choti strips mein divide karte hain. Pani ek strip se doosri ko flow karta hai. Leveling zaroori hai.

text: mix varieties ek khet mein rust risk zyada hota hai
label: disease
answer: Mix varieties ek khet mein agar koi susceptible ho to rust phail sakti hai. Ek hi resistant variety prefer karein. Dono len to dono resistant honi chahiye.

text: volunteer wheat agle fasal ke liye problem hai
label: weed_control
answer: Volunteer wheat agle fasal ke liye weed ban jati hai; rust ka host bhi. Next sowing se pehle hataen ya spray karein. Clean harvest se volunteer kam hoti hai.

text: nitrogen use efficiency kaise barhayein
label: fertilizer
answer: Nitrogen use efficiency ke liye split application karein pani ke sath dein. Right time tillering booting par dein. Soil test se dose fix karein; zyada N waste hota hai.

text: documents bechne ke liye kya chahiye sarkar ko
label: market_price
answer: Sarkar ko bechne ke liye CNIC zameen ka record bank account chahiye. Procurement form aur quality standards. List food department ya agri office se.

text: ladybird beetle faida mand hai ya nuqsan
label: general_info
answer: Ladybird beetle faida mand hai; ye aphid khata hai. Inhe mat maren; selective insecticide use karein. IPM mein inki ahmiyat hai.

text: high density sowing matlab zyada beej dalna faida hai
label: sowing
answer: High density matlab zyada seed rate; kabhi trial se theek hota hai. Zyada tar recommended rate behtar; zyada se lodging bhi barh sakti hai. Local recommendation follow karein.

text: oala wheat ko nuqsan pahuncha sakta hai
label: weather_risk
answer: Oala wheat ko nuqsan pahuncha sakta hai; patte toot jate hain. Bachav mushkil; insurance claim karein agar policy ho. Damage ke baad extra N mat dein.

text: rainfed wheat mein kab kab pani den agar mauka ho
label: irrigation
answer: Rainfed wheat mein 1–2 pani agar mauka ho to booting aur grain filling par dein. Ye do stages sab se important. Residue cover se nami bachayein.

text: bina zehr bimari control ho sakti hai
label: disease
answer: Bina zehr bimari control: resistant variety rotation balanced nutrition field sanitation. Fungicide ki jagah nahi le sakta lekin pressure kam karta hai. Organic options hain.

text: resistant jhariyan ho gayi hain ab kya karein
label: weed_control
answer: Resistant jhariyan hon to alag mode of action wala herbicide use karein. Same product bar bar na chhidkain. Hand weeding se bachi jhariyan hataen.

text: cost per acre kitna aata hai gandum ki
label: general_info
answer: Cost per acre beej khaad pani spray labour machinery; region se 25000–50000+ ho sakta hai. Apna hisab rakhein taake faida nuqsan pata rahe.

text: residue jalaen ya rehne dein agle fasal ke liye
label: general_info
answer: Residue jalaen nahi; pollution aur soil nuqsan. Galay karein ya zero till se next crop boen. Mulch ke tor par bhi use hota hai.

text: drought tolerant variety sukhe ilaqe ke liye kaun si
label: sowing
answer: Drought tolerant variety sukhe ilaqe ke liye agri department se list lein. Early aur stress tolerant hoti hain. Seed rate aur sowing time barani ke mutabiq.

text: barish zyada ho gayi waterlogging ho rahi kya karein
label: weather_risk
answer: Barish zyada se waterlogging ho to turant drain karein. Pani nikaalen taake jaden saans le sakein. Aage drainage behtar karein.

text: khari pani wheat ko de sakte hain
label: irrigation
answer: Thora khari pani use ho sakta hai agar EC limit se zyada na ho. Gypsum zameen mein dalen; drainage theek rakhein. Blend karein agar possible ho.

text: crop rotation bimari kam karta hai kaun si fasal gandum ke baad
label: disease
answer: Crop rotation: wheat ke baad legume moong mash ya oilseed sarson. Non-host se disease cycle toot jati hai. 2–3 saal rotation behtar.

text: precision sowing matlab kya hai
label: sowing
answer: Precision sowing matlab drill calibration se seed rate aur spacing theek. Cup roller check karein; speed constant. Field test karein taake stand uniform ho.

text: bhoosa mushroom ke liye use kar sakte hain
label: harvest
answer: Bhoosa mushroom ke liye compost banate hain. Agar mushroom unit qareeb ho to bech sakte hain. Warna charay ya baling se bechna.

text: direct mill bechna behtar hai ya mandi
label: market_price
answer: Direct mill kabhi behtar rate deti hai; quantity quality deal pe depend. Transport khud ya mill. Terms aur payment clear karein.

text: seed vigor test kya hota hai
label: sowing
answer: Seed vigor test germination ke sath growth speed bhi dekhta hai. 100 beej 7 din mein kitne strong; 80%+ achha. Purana beej ka test karwa lain.

text: chhota kisaan best practices kya hain low cost
label: general_info
answer: Chhota kisaan: certified beej recommended dose timely pani group buying. Scout karte rahein; early control sasta. Record rakhein.

text: wheat calendar month by month kya karein
label: general_info
answer: Wheat calendar: Oct–Nov bone Nov–Dec first pani weed Dec–Jan topdress Jan–Feb booting Feb–Mar phool grain fill Apr–May kattai. Region se thora farq.

text: photo bhej kar bimari pehchan karwa sakte hain
label: general_info
answer: Photo bhej kar extension officer ya crop clinic se bimari pehchan karwa sakte hain. Leaf dono taraf close-up aur full plant. Early pehchan se sahi ilaaj.

text: padosi kisan mil kar spray karein zang ke liye
label: general_info
answer: Padosi kisan mil kar same time rust spray karein to disease phailne ka risk kam hota hai. Volunteer plants sab hata dein. Coordination se area control behtar.

text: salam main naya kisaan hoon gandum seekhna chahta hoon
label: greeting
answer: Wa alaikum assalam. Main gandum ke bone se kattai tak madad kar sakta hoon. Kya poochna hai bataein.

text: assalam meri fasal mein masla hai madad chahiye

text: When should I sow my crops
label: sowing
answer: Sowing time depends on crop and season. Rabi crops like wheat: Oct–Nov. Kharif crops like rice cotton: May–July. Check with your local agriculture office or extension worker for exact dates in your area.

text: Which crop is best for my land
label: general_info
answer: Best crop depends on your soil type, water, and season. Sandy soil: pulses, maize. Clay: rice, wheat. Get soil tested and ask extension for varieties suited to your area.

text: How to prepare soil before sowing
label: general_info
answer: Plough 1–2 times, harrow 2–3 times, then level the field. Do this 1–2 weeks before sowing. Remove weeds and stubble. Ensure soil has enough moisture at sowing.

text: When to give first irrigation to any crop
label: irrigation
answer: First irrigation is usually 20–25 days after sowing when crop is at crown-root stage. Exact days vary by crop and variety. Do not delay too much.

text: How much fertilizer per acre for crops
label: fertilizer
answer: Fertilizer per acre varies by crop and soil. General: 1–2 bag DAP at sowing, urea in splits. Get soil test and local recommendation for exact amount.

text: My crop has pests what to spray
label: pest
answer: Identify the pest first. Then use recommended insecticide for that pest from extension. Spray in morning or evening; cover leaves. Do not over-spray.

text: Leaves turning yellow what is wrong
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Yellow leaves can be nitrogen or zinc deficiency. Old leaves yellow: add urea top dress. New leaves with white streaks: zinc spray. Check water and drainage too.

text: When to harvest crop ready or not
label: harvest
answer: Harvest when grain is hard and does not break with nail. Straw turns yellow; moisture drops. Slightly early is better than too late to avoid shattering.

text: Where to sell crop for better rate
label: market_price
answer: Sell at mandi or procurement center. Check daily rate before selling. Compare 2–3 places. Better quality grain gets better price. Group selling can help.

text: Government support price for crops
label: market_price
answer: Government announces support price every year. Check news or agriculture department. Procurement is done at listed centers; get list from agri office.

text: How to control weeds in field
label: weed_control
answer: Use herbicide when weeds are small 25–35 days after sowing. Grass and broad leaf need different products. Hand weeding also works. Keep field clean.

text: Soil is hard how to improve
label: general_info
answer: Hard soil: add organic manure, do deep ploughing once, improve drainage. Avoid too much tillage when soil is wet. Green manure or compost helps.

text: Canal water less how to manage irrigation
label: irrigation
answer: When canal water is less use tube well or pond. Give water only at critical stages. Use beds or furrows to save water. Increase gap between irrigations.

text: Which fertilizer for nitrogen deficiency
label: fertilizer
answer: For nitrogen deficiency use urea. Apply as top dress when deficiency is seen. First give water then urea. Split dose is better than all at once.

text: Crop disease spots on leaves what spray
label: disease
answer: Spots on leaves can be fungal disease. Use fungicide recommended for that crop. Spray early when first spots appear. Resistant variety next season if possible.

text: When to give second dose of urea
label: fertilizer
answer: Second dose of urea is usually at tillering or before flowering. First dose at crown-root stage. Check crop and local recommendation for exact timing.

text: How to store grain without insects
label: harvest
answer: Dry grain to 12–14% moisture. Store in clean dry bags or bin. Use fumigation or insecticide if needed. Check regularly for insects.

text: Mandi rate how to check today
label: market_price
answer: Check mandi rate on SMS service, mandi office, or agri app daily. Check same day rate before selling. Compare 2–3 mandis.

text: Best time for rabi crop sowing
label: sowing
answer: Rabi sowing: late October to mid November for wheat; region varies. Other rabi crops: check local dates. Do not sow too late.

text: Best time for kharif crop sowing
label: sowing
answer: Kharif sowing: May–July for rice cotton maize. Exact month depends on region and rain. Early sowing is better where possible.

text: Crop rotation what to plant after wheat
label: sowing
answer: After wheat you can sow rice, maize, cotton, or pulses depending on water and season. Crop rotation keeps soil healthy. Ask extension for your area.

text: Crop rotation what after rice
label: sowing
answer: After rice you can sow wheat, mustard, potato, or vegetables. Prepare field quickly after rice harvest. Wheat in Oct–Nov is common.

text: My land is sandy what to grow
label: general_info
answer: Sandy soil: grow pulses, maize, groundnut, or sorghum. Add organic matter. Irrigate more often. Avoid heavy clay-loving crops.

text: Clay soil which crops suit
label: general_info
answer: Clay soil: rice, wheat, sugarcane suit. Improve drainage. Do not over irrigate. Organic matter helps structure.

text: How many irrigations needed for crops
label: irrigation
answer: Most crops need 4–6 irrigations. Critical stages: early growth, flowering, grain filling. Gap 12–20 days depending on soil and weather.

text: Gap between two irrigations how many days
label: irrigation
answer: Gap between irrigations: 12–20 days common. Sandy soil: shorter gap. Clay: longer gap. Do not skip critical stages.

text: DAP and urea when to apply
label: fertilizer
answer: DAP at sowing; urea split: some at sowing, rest at tillering or before flowering. Water after top dress. Local recommendation for amount.

text: Organic manure with chemical can we use
label: fertilizer
answer: Yes you can use organic manure with chemical. Apply 2–4 ton FYM or compost at sowing. Do not reduce chemical dose too much; balance both.

text: Aphids on crop which insecticide
label: pest
answer: For aphids use recommended insecticide from extension. Spray in morning or evening. Cover under leaves. Repeat if needed after 7–10 days.

text: Natural way to control insects
label: pest
answer: Natural control: keep field clean, use neem oil or garlic spray, encourage beneficial insects. Spray chemical only when pest crosses threshold.

text: Weeds resistant to spray what to do
label: weed_control
answer: If weeds are resistant change herbicide to different mode of action. Rotate products. Do hand weeding if needed. Ask extension for new options.

text: Pre emergence or post emergence which better
label: weed_control
answer: Pre emergence: right after sowing when soil has moisture. Post: when weeds are small 25–35 days. Both work; post is needed if pre is missed.

text: Frost damage to crop how to save
label: weather_risk
answer: Frost: light irrigation before frost can help. Avoid early sowing in frost area. Resistant variety if available. Damaged crop may recover partly.

text: Rain too much waterlogging what to do
label: irrigation
answer: Waterlogging: drain water as soon as possible. Make drains. Do not add more water. Next time improve drainage and avoid over irrigation.

text: Drought variety which crop
label: sowing
answer: Drought tolerant varieties exist for wheat, maize, sorghum. Ask agriculture department for list. Use slightly higher seed rate in dry area.

text: Seed rate per acre how much
label: sowing
answer: Seed rate per acre: 40–50 kg for wheat; varies by crop. Check recommendation for your crop and variety. Slightly more if late sowing.

text: Seed treatment why important
label: sowing
answer: Seed treatment controls seed-borne disease and some pests. Use recommended fungicide or insecticide. Treat then dry in shade before sowing.

text: Zero tillage benefit what is
label: sowing
answer: Zero tillage saves time fuel and moisture. Sow without full ploughing. Good after rice for wheat. Need suitable drill and residue management.

text: When to give water first time after sowing
label: irrigation
answer: First water 20–25 days after sowing for most crops. When crown-root stage. Exact days depend on crop; check recommendation.

text: Tube well water enough for crop
label: irrigation
answer: Tube well is enough if you can give 4–6 irrigations at right time. Critical stages must get water. Store some water if supply is irregular.

text: Nitrogen deficiency symptoms what are
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Nitrogen deficiency: old leaves turn yellow, growth is slow. Add urea as top dress. Water after application.

text: Phosphorus deficiency how to identify
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Phosphorus deficiency: purple or dark leaves, poor root growth. Add DAP or SSP at sowing. Soil test confirms.

text: Potash when to give to crop
label: fertilizer
answer: Potash give at sowing with DAP if soil test shows low K. Some crops need split. Check recommendation for your crop.

text: Zinc deficiency leaves white streaks
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: White streaks on new leaves are zinc deficiency. Use zinc sulphate in soil or foliar zinc spray. Repeat if symptoms remain.

text: Soil test how to do and when
label: general_info
answer: Soil test: take sample from field, send to lab or give to extension. Best before each season. Test every 2–3 years.

text: Crop loan where to get from
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Crop loan from bank under Kisan scheme. Take land papers and CNIC. Agri office has list of schemes and eligibility.

text: Seed subsidy how to apply

text: Crop insurance claim how to do
