answer: Crop insurance claim: report loss soon with photos. Survey will be done. Submit form as per policy. Keep documents.

text: Combine harvest when to use
label: harvest
answer: Use combine when grain is fully ripe and hard. Set drum and concave correctly. Harvest in morning or evening to reduce loss.

text: Threshing loss how to reduce
label: harvest
answer: Reduce threshing loss: let grain ripen fully, set combine properly, speed not too high. Manual: thresh gently.

text: Moisture level for safe storage
label: harvest
answer: Safe moisture for storage 12–14% or less. Higher moisture brings insects and fungus. Dry in sun in thin layer then store.

text: Better price tips for selling crop
label: market_price
answer: Better price: keep grain clean and well graded. Good test weight. Check rate before selling. Sell in group if possible. Avoid selling in rush.

text: Procurement center where is
label: market_price
answer: Procurement center list from food department or agriculture office. Also on Kisan helpline. Check for your zone.

text: Quality grain how to get premium rate
label: market_price
answer: Premium rate: clean uniform grain, good test weight. Dry and store properly. Grade well. Some mills pay more for quality.

text: Termite in field how to control
label: pest
answer: Termite: use soil insecticide at sowing or seed treatment. Improve drainage. Remove old stubble. Ask extension for product.

text: Cutworm damaging plants what spray
label: pest
answer: Cutworm: use soil insecticide at sowing or early spray. Cover base of plants. Control when damage is first seen.

text: Fungicide for leaf spots which one
label: disease
answer: Leaf spots: use fungicide recommended for that crop. Spray when first spots appear. Good coverage. Resistant variety next time.

text: Root rot how to identify and control
label: disease
answer: Root rot: roots turn brown or black, plant dies. Improve drainage; avoid waterlogging. Resistant variety and rotation help.

text: Over irrigation harms crop is it true
label: irrigation
answer: Yes over irrigation causes waterlogging, root rot, lodging. Keep gap 12–20 days. Water only when needed at critical stages.

text: Sprinkler good for crops or not
label: irrigation
answer: Sprinkler is good for uniform water and saving. Use in morning or evening. Pressure and nozzle should be correct.

text: Drip irrigation for field crops
label: irrigation
answer: Drip irrigation saves water and gives uniform moisture. Good for vegetables and some field crops. Cost and maintenance to be considered.

text: Bed planting saves water how
label: irrigation
answer: Bed planting: water runs in furrows, less waste. Better aeration. Need bed planter. Saves 20–30% water in many cases.

text: FYM how much per acre
label: fertilizer
answer: FYM 2–4 ton per acre well rotten. Apply before sowing with chemical. Do not reduce chemical dose much. Mix in soil.

text: Compost how to make and use
label: fertilizer
answer: Compost: pile crop residue, leaves, dung; keep moist; turn. Ready in 2–3 months. Use 2–4 ton per acre before sowing.

text: Green manure which crop before sowing
label: fertilizer
answer: Green manure: grow mung, mash or sesbania before main crop. Cut and mix 3–4 weeks before sowing. Adds nitrogen and organic matter.

text: Micronutrient spray when to give
label: fertilizer
answer: Micronutrient spray when deficiency is seen: zinc, boron, etc. Foliar at tillering or before flowering. Dose on label. Morning or evening spray.

text: Herbicide rotation why important
label: weed_control
answer: Herbicide rotation prevents weed resistance. Use different mode of action each season. Same product again and again makes weeds resistant.

text: Grass and broad leaf weed one spray
label: weed_control
answer: One spray for both only if product label allows tank mix for that crop. Otherwise spray grass herbicide then broad leaf separately.

text: Scouting field how often to do
label: general_info
answer: Scout field every 7–10 days in season. Check pest disease weed and water. More often when problem is seen. Keep record.

text: Best practices for higher yield
label: general_info
answer: Best practices: good seed, timely sowing, balanced fertilizer, water at critical stages, control weed and pest. Scout and follow recommendation.

text: When is kharif season start
label: sowing
answer: Kharif season starts May–June with first rain. Sowing from May to July depending on crop and region.

text: When is rabi season start
label: sowing
answer: Rabi season starts October–November. Wheat sowing late Oct–mid Nov. Other rabi crops around same time.

text: Late sowing what to do
label: sowing
answer: Late sowing: use slightly more seed, choose early or tolerant variety. Give full fertilizer and water on time. Yield may be less.

text: Seed depth how much for sowing
label: sowing
answer: Seed depth 3–5 cm for most crops. Too deep delays germination. Moisture should be at that depth.

text: Line sowing better than broadcast
label: sowing
answer: Line sowing is better: uniform stand, less seed, easy weeding and harvest. Broadcast uses more seed and is uneven.

text: First irrigation timing for any crop
label: irrigation
answer: First irrigation 20–25 days after sowing for most crops. When plants have 2–3 leaves and crown-root stage.

text: Critical stages when crop needs water
label: irrigation
answer: Critical stages: early growth, tillering, flowering, grain or fruit filling. Do not skip water at these stages.

text: Farm pond water use for irrigation
label: irrigation
answer: Farm pond water can be used. Store rain water. Use at critical stages. Check quality if water is brackish.

text: Saline soil which crops can grow
label: general_info
answer: Saline soil: barley, wheat some varieties, cotton, sorghum can tolerate. Improve drainage. Gypsum if needed. Soil test first.

text: Soil pH how to check and improve
label: general_info
answer: Soil pH: test at lab. Below 6 add lime; above 8 improve drainage and use gypsum. Organic matter helps.

text: Drainage poor how to improve
label: general_info
answer: Poor drainage: make drains, level field, avoid over irrigation. Add organic matter. Laser leveling helps where possible.

text: NPK ratio what for different crops
label: fertilizer
answer: NPK ratio varies by crop. Wheat 4:2:1; rice 3:1:1 roughly. Soil test gives exact. P and K at sowing; N in splits.

text: Basal dose what to apply at sowing
label: fertilizer
answer: Basal dose: DAP or SSP for P, some K if needed. Little N. Full dose as per soil test and crop.

text: Top dressing when and how much
label: fertilizer
answer: Top dressing: first at tillering, second before flowering. Urea common. Amount from recommendation. Water after application.

text: Insect pest threshold when to spray
label: pest
answer: Spray when pest crosses threshold: e.g. 5–10 aphids per plant. Extension gives threshold. Do not spray too early.

text: IPM what is and how to do
label: pest
answer: IPM: scout, use threshold, prefer natural control, spray only when needed. Keep field clean. Resistant variety. Saves cost and environment.

text: Selective insecticide meaning what
label: pest
answer: Selective insecticide kills only target pest; beneficial insects survive. Broad spectrum kills all. Use selective when available.

text: Rodent in field how to control
label: pest
answer: Rodent: use trap or poison bait in safe place. Keep grain and field clean. Protect from children and animals.

text: Leaf blight which fungicide
label: disease
answer: Leaf blight: use fungicide with triazole or strobilurin for that crop. Spray when first seen. Good coverage.

text: Powdery mildew which spray
label: disease
answer: Powdery mildew: sulphur or triazole fungicide. Spray when white powder appears. Resistant variety next season.

text: Seed borne disease how to avoid
label: disease
answer: Use certified or treated seed. Do not use seed from diseased crop. Seed treatment with fungicide. Clean storage.

text: Resistant variety what does it mean
label: disease
answer: Resistant variety does not get that disease or gets less. List from research station. Change variety if disease is common.

text: Harvest time how to know crop ready
label: harvest
answer: Crop ready: grain hard, straw yellow, moisture down. Thumbnail test for grain. Slightly early better than late.

text: Early harvest loss or not
label: harvest
answer: Early harvest: grain not full, yield less. Only if you have to save crop from pest or weather. Wait for right time when possible.

text: Grain drying how to do properly
label: harvest
answer: Dry grain in thin layer in sun 3–7 days. Stir. Moisture 12–14%. Cool before storing. Avoid condensation in store.

text: Straw after harvest what to do
label: harvest
answer: Straw: use as fodder, sell, or mulch. Baling if baler available. Do not burn; use for compost or animal.

text: Sell when rate high or store
label: market_price
answer: Sell when you need cash or when rate is good. Store if you have safe place and expect higher rate. Check market trend.

text: Forward contract for crop selling
label: market_price
answer: Forward contract: fix price before harvest. Less risk if price falls. No gain if price rises. Clear terms and payment.

text: Test weight and rate relation
label: market_price
answer: Higher test weight means better grain; mills pay more. Improve by good variety, harvest at right time, proper storage.

text: Weighbridge check when selling
label: market_price
answer: Check weighbridge when selling: correct weight, no cheating. Keep weight slip. Can verify at another weighbridge.

text: Hail damage crop what to do
label: weather_risk
answer: Hail damage: report for insurance. Photos. Do not add extra N. Light irrigation if soil is dry. Crop may partly recover.

text: Heat wave at flowering crop damage
label: weather_risk
answer: Heat at flowering: less grain. Timely sowing and last irrigation at grain fill help. Heat tolerant variety if available.

text: Rainfed area when to sow
label: sowing
answer: Rainfed: sow when soil has enough moisture after rain. Often late Oct for rabi; May–June for kharif. Use drought variety.

text: Multiple crops same year possible
label: sowing
answer: Two crops per year possible: e.g. wheat after rice, maize then potato. Depends on water and season length. Plan with extension.

text: Intercropping benefit what is
label: general_info
answer: Intercropping: two crops together use space and nutrients better. e.g. maize with bean. Plan spacing and harvest.

text: Laser leveling benefit for field
label: general_info
answer: Laser leveling: even field, less water, better yield. Hire or rent. One time cost. Good for irrigation efficiency.

text: Tractor for land preparation
label: machinery
answer: Tractor: 1–2 ploughing, 2–3 harrowing, then level. When soil is not too wet. Prepare 1–2 weeks before sowing.

text: Sprayer nozzle which type best
label: machinery
answer: Flat fan nozzle for most sprays. Pressure 2–3 bar. Height and speed even. Reduces drift and gives good coverage.

text: Drill calibration for sowing
label: machinery
answer: Calibrate drill: set seed rate and depth. Check on sheet. Uniform speed. Test in field for stand.

text: Hello I have question about farming
label: greeting
answer: Assalam o alaikum. You can ask about sowing, irrigation, fertilizer, pest, disease, harvest, or selling. What do you need?

text: Salam need advice on crops
label: greeting
answer: Assalam o alaikum. Tell me your crop and problem: sowing, water, fertilizer, pest, disease, or market. I will guide.

text: Which month to plant cotton
label: sowing
answer: Cotton: sow April–May when temperature is warm. Region varies. Early sowing better where bollworm is high.

text: Which month to plant maize
label: sowing
answer: Maize: kharif May–June; spring Feb–March. Depends on region. Avoid very late sowing.

text: Which month to plant sugarcane
label: sowing
answer: Sugarcane: Feb–March planting. Ratoon after harvest. Full water and fertilizer needed.

text: Which month to plant potato
label: sowing
answer: Potato: Oct–Nov in plains; Feb–March in hills. Cool weather crop. Good soil and water needed.

text: Which month to plant onion
label: sowing
answer: Onion: Oct–Nov for rabi; Feb for spring. Can do in both seasons. Seed or sets.

text: Which month to plant tomato
label: sowing
answer: Tomato: Feb–March spring; July–Aug monsoon. Avoid peak heat. Staking and spray for disease.

text: Which month to plant chili
label: sowing
answer: Chili: Feb–March or July–Aug. Warm crop. Need good drainage and spray for virus.

text: Which month to plant sunflower
label: sowing
answer: Sunflower: Feb–March spring; July kharif. Short duration. Good for rotation.

text: Which month to plant chickpea
label: sowing
answer: Chickpea: Oct–Nov rabi. Rainfed or one irrigation. Avoid late sowing.

text: Water requirement for cotton
label: irrigation
answer: Cotton needs 6–8 irrigations. Critical: flowering and boll formation. Gap 10–15 days. Drip or furrow saves water.

text: Water requirement for maize
label: irrigation
answer: Maize needs 6–8 irrigations. Critical: knee high, tasseling, grain fill. Gap 10–14 days. Sensitive to drought at flowering.

text: Water requirement for sugarcane
label: irrigation
answer: Sugarcane needs regular water throughout. 15–20 irrigations. Most in summer. Stop before harvest.

text: Fertilizer for cotton how much
label: fertilizer
answer: Cotton: 2–3 bag DAP, 3–4 bag urea per acre in splits. More in better soil. Boron and zinc if deficient.

text: Fertilizer for maize how much
label: fertilizer
answer: Maize: 1–2 bag DAP, 2–3 bag urea per acre. Full at sowing, top dress at knee high and tasseling.

text: Fertilizer for rice how much
label: fertilizer
answer: Rice: 1–2 bag DAP, 2–3 bag urea. Split N at tillering and panicle. Zinc in many areas.

text: Major pests of cotton
label: pest
answer: Cotton pests: bollworm, aphid, whitefly. Use recommended insecticide at threshold. Bt cotton reduces bollworm.

text: Major pests of maize
label: pest
answer: Maize pests: stem borer, aphid, armyworm. Spray when damage seen. Resistant variety and clean field help.

text: Major diseases of rice
label: disease
answer: Rice diseases: blast, blight, sheath blight. Resistant variety. Fungicide when needed. Seed treatment.

text: Major diseases of potato
label: disease
answer: Potato diseases: late blight, virus. Fungicide for blight. Certified seed. Rotate crop.

text: Weed control in rice field
label: weed_control
answer: Rice weeds: pre or post emergence herbicide. Hand weeding 25–35 days. Keep field flooded as per practice.

text: Weed control in maize field
label: weed_control
answer: Maize weeds: atrazine or post emergence. 25–35 days after sowing when weeds small. Hand weeding also.

text: Rice harvest when to cut
label: harvest
answer: Rice: harvest when 80% grain is ripe. Straw yellow. Moisture 20–25%. Combine or manual.

text: Cotton picking when to start
label: harvest
answer: Cotton: pick when bolls open. Pick in intervals. Do not leave open boll long. Store in dry place.

text: Maize harvest time
label: harvest
answer: Maize: harvest when grain is hard and black layer forms. Usually 90–120 days. Combine or hand.

text: Cotton rate today mandi
label: market_price
answer: Cotton rate: check mandi SMS or market. Varies daily. Quality and staple length affect price.

text: Rice rate today mandi
label: market_price
answer: Rice rate: check mandi or procurement. Quality and variety. Government procurement in season.

text: Maize rate today mandi
label: market_price
answer: Maize rate: check local mandi. Used for feed and industry. Price varies by season.

text: Soil preparation for kharif
label: general_info
answer: Kharif preparation: after rabi harvest, plough, harrow, level. Remove weeds. Ready by May–June.

text: Soil preparation for rabi
label: general_info
answer: Rabi preparation: after kharif, one or two ploughing, harrow, level. Timely for wheat Oct–Nov.

text: Ploughing how many times needed
label: general_info
answer: Ploughing 1–2 times enough for most crops. Deep plough once a year if soil is hard. Then harrow.

text: Harrowing when to do
label: general_info
answer: Harrowing after ploughing to break clods and level. 2–3 passes. When soil is not too wet.

text: Land leveling why important
label: general_info
answer: Level field so water spreads evenly. Less waste, better stand. Laser leveler best; manual also possible.

text: Certified seed benefit what
label: sowing
answer: Certified seed: tested, pure, good germination. Less disease. Worth the cost for yield and quality.

text: Saved seed when can use
label: sowing
answer: Saved seed: use if from healthy crop and treat with fungicide. Do not use if disease was in crop.

text: Seed storage how to keep safe
label: sowing
answer: Store seed in dry cool place. In bags or bin. Treat before next season. Keep away from insects.

text: Germination poor what to do
label: sowing
answer: Poor germination: check seed quality, depth, moisture. Re-sow if gap is large. Use certified next time.

text: Plant population per acre ideal
label: sowing
answer: Plant population: wheat 40–50 plants per sq m; maize 6–7 per sq m. Varies by crop. Check recommendation.

text: Spacing between plants how much
label: sowing
answer: Spacing: wheat 20–25 cm row; maize 60–75 cm. Depends on crop and variety. Uniform spacing better.

text: Flood damage crop recovery
label: weather_risk
answer: Flood: drain water soon. Light top dress when dry. Next time improve drainage and bunds.

text: Wind damage lodged crop
label: weather_risk
answer: Lodging: harvest early if possible. Next time less N, resistant variety. Support not practical in field.

text: Cold injury to young plants
label: weather_risk
answer: Cold injury: avoid very early sowing in cold area. Light irrigation before frost. Resistant variety if available.

text: Boron deficiency symptoms
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Boron deficiency: growth points die, poor grain set. Add borax or boron. Soil test confirms.

text: Sulphur deficiency symptoms
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Sulphur: young leaves pale, growth slow. Use gypsum or sulphur fertilizer. Yellow in mustard often sulphur.

text: Iron deficiency in crop
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Iron deficiency: young leaves yellow between veins. Foliar iron or improve drainage. Common in high pH.

text: Magnesium deficiency signs
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Magnesium: old leaves yellow from edge. Epsom salt or magnesium in fertilizer. Soil test.

text: Foliar spray when to give
label: fertilizer
answer: Foliar spray when soil application is late or deficiency is seen. Zinc, urea, micronutrients. Morning or evening.

text: Urea spray on leaves safe or not
label: fertilizer
answer: Urea spray on leaves: 2% can be used as supplement. Not substitute for soil N. Avoid in hot sun.

text: Tank mix fertilizer with pesticide
label: weed_control
answer: Tank mix only if both labels allow. Some mixes damage crop. Safer to spray separately. Ask extension.

text: Post emergence spray timing
label: weed_control
answer: Post emergence spray when weeds are small 25–35 days after sowing. Product as per weed type. Calm weather.

text: Broad leaf weed which herbicide
label: weed_control
answer: Broad leaf: 2,4-D or similar for that crop. Check crop safety. Dose on label. When weeds small.

text: Grass weed which herbicide
label: weed_control
answer: Grass weed: grass-specific herbicide for that crop. Clodinafop, quizalofop etc. Dose and timing on label.

text: Hand weeding when to do
label: weed_control
answer: Hand weeding when 25–35 days old. Before weeds seed. Second weeding if needed. Cheaper if labour available.

text: Stale seedbed for weed control
label: weed_control
answer: Stale seedbed: prepare field, let weeds grow, kill with spray or light tillage. Then sow. Reduces weed load.

text: Storage insect control which treatment
label: harvest
answer: Storage insects: fumigation or contact insecticide. Grain must be dry and clean. Follow safety. Repeat if needed.

text: Fumigation for grain when needed
label: harvest
answer: Fumigation when insects are inside grain. Seal store; use recommended fumigant. Ventilate after. Professional help better.

text: Safe moisture for wheat storage
label: harvest
answer: Wheat storage moisture 12–14% or less. Dry in sun. Store in clean dry place. Fumigate if insects seen.

text: Safe moisture for rice storage
label: harvest
answer: Rice storage: dry to 12–14%. Same as wheat. Parboiled keeps longer. Protect from moisture.

text: Bag storage or bulk which better
label: harvest
answer: Bags: easy to handle and sell. Bulk: need bin, less labour. Both ok if dry and protected from pest.

text: Government procurement for which crops
label: market_price
answer: Government procurement: wheat, rice, cotton sometimes. List from food department. Quality standards apply.

text: Kisan card what benefits
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Kisan card: identity, loan, subsidy, insurance linked. Apply at bank or agri office. Documents as required.

text: Interest free loan for farmers
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Interest free loan: government scheme for farmers. Bank and agri office. Eligibility and limit as per scheme.

text: Subsidy on fertilizer how to get
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Fertilizer subsidy: through dealer or scheme. Keep identity and land record. Quota as per policy.

text: Subsidy on machinery
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Machinery subsidy: on purchase of tractor, drill, etc. Apply through agri or bank. Scheme and amount vary.

text: Insurance premium for crop
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Crop insurance premium: part paid by government. Rest by farmer. Sum insured and crop. Details from company or agri office.

text: New farmer where to get advice
label: general_info
answer: New farmer: contact extension worker, agri department, or helpline. Join training. Start with one crop and learn.

text: Extension worker contact where
label: general_info
answer: Extension worker: at agriculture department or field office. Helpline number often on board. Visit or call.

text: Agriculture department helpline
label: general_info
answer: Agriculture helpline: number from agri department or Kisan portal. Call for advice, complaint, or scheme info.

text: Weather forecast for farming
label: weather_risk
answer: Weather: check forecast before spray and harvest. Plan irrigation. Frost and hail warning help. Radio, SMS, app.

text: When to irrigate after rain
label: irrigation
answer: After rain: if soil is wet wait. If crop needs water and rain was less give irrigation. Check field.

text: Brackish water for irrigation
label: irrigation
answer: Brackish water: use if EC is not too high. Mix with good water if possible. Gypsum and drainage help. Test water.

text: Mulch to save soil moisture
label: irrigation
answer: Mulch: straw or plastic on soil saves moisture, reduces weed. After sowing. Remove or leave as per crop.

text: Residue management after harvest
label: harvest
answer: Residue: leave on surface for zero till, or incorporate. Do not burn. Happy seeder uses residue. Compost if possible.

text: Burning crop residue good or bad
label: general_info
answer: Burning residue: bad for soil and air. Loss of organic matter. Use for mulch, compost, or incorporate.

text: Zero burn alternative what
label: general_info
answer: Zero burn: use happy seeder, incorporate, or remove residue. Government discourages burning. Penalty in some areas.

text: Happy seeder what is
label: machinery
answer: Happy seeder: drill that sows in standing stubble. No burn. Saves time and moisture. For wheat after rice.

text: Ridge planting for which crops
label: sowing
answer: Ridge planting: for potato, sugarcane, some vegetables. Better drainage and earthing up. Ridge maker or manual.

text: Furrow irrigation how to do
label: irrigation
answer: Furrow irrigation: water in furrows between rows. Less than flood. Level field needed. Saves water.

text: Flood irrigation problem
label: irrigation
answer: Flood irrigation: more water use, some runoff. Where water is plenty. Beds and furrows better where water is less.

text: Deficiency in soil how to know
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Deficiency: soil test and leaf symptoms. Yellow, purple, spots. Extension can help identify. Then add right nutrient.

text: Leaf sample for nutrient test
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Leaf sample: take from same stage plants, healthy and affected. Send to lab or extension. Guides fertilizer.

text: Soil health card what is
label: general_info
answer: Soil health card: record of soil test result and recommendation. From government scheme. Use for fertilizer decision.

text: Organic farming possible for me
label: general_info
answer: Organic farming: possible but needs more labour and time. Compost, green manure, bio pesticide. Market for organic produce.

text: Mixed farming benefit
label: general_info
answer: Mixed farming: crop and livestock together. Fodder from crop; manure for field. Income from both.

text: Livestock with crop farming
label: general_info
answer: Livestock with crop: cattle, goat, poultry. Manure for field. Crop residue as fodder. Balanced plan.

text: Pesticide safety how to spray
label: pest
answer: Spray safety: wear mask and gloves. Do not eat or smoke. Wash after. Keep away from children and animals. Follow label.

text: Waiting period after pesticide spray
label: pest
answer: Waiting period: days between last spray and harvest. On pesticide label. Do not harvest before that. Safe for consumer.

text: Harvest after spray how many days
label: pest
answer: Harvest after spray: wait for waiting period on label. 7–21 days common. Depends on pesticide and crop.

text: Bio pesticide what is
label: pest
answer: Bio pesticide: from plant or microbe. Safer than chemical. Neem, Bt, etc. Use as per recommendation.

text: Neem oil for insect control
label: pest
answer: Neem oil: mix and spray as per dose. Repels and kills some insects. Safe. Repeat after 7–10 days if needed.

text: mujy fasal kab kasht karni chahiye
label: sowing
answer: Fasal kasht ka waqt crop aur mausam par depend karta hai. Rabi faslen Oct–Nov; kharif May–July. Apne ilaqe ki tarikh agri office ya extension se puchen.

text: meri zameen ke liye kaun si fasal achi hai
label: general_info
answer: Zameen ki qisam, pani aur mausam dekh kar fasal chunein. Reti zameen: dalen makki. Chikni: chawal gandum. Zameen test karwain; extension se mutabiq variety len.

text: bone se pehle zameen ki tayari kaise karein
label: general_info
answer: Bone se 1–2 haftay pehle 1–2 jot, 2–3 sulah, phir level karein. Jhariyan aur purani fasal hataen. Bone ke waqt nami theek ho.

text: kisi bhi fasal ko pehla pani kab den
label: irrigation
answer: Pehla pani aksar bone ke 20–25 din baad jab crown-root stage ho. Crop se farq hota hai. Zyada der mat karein.

text: ek acre mein kitna khaad dalna chahiye
label: fertilizer
answer: Per acre khaad crop aur zameen par; aam 1–2 bag DAP bone par, urea split. Soil test aur local recommendation se miqdar len.

text: meri fasal mein keera lag gaya kya chhidkain
label: pest
answer: Pehle keera pehchanen phir us ke mutabiq extension se recommended insecticide len. Subah ya sham chhidkain; patton par coverage. Zyada mat chhidkain.

text: patte zard ho rahe hain kya masla hai
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Zard patte nitrogen ya zinc kami se ho sakte hain. Purane zard hon to urea topdress; naye par safed lakeeren hon to zinc spray. Pani bhi theek rakhein.

text: fasal kaatne ka sahi waqt kaise pata chale
label: harvest
answer: Jab dana sakht ho naakhun se toot na sake; bhoosa zard; nami kam. Thora jaldi kaatna der se behtar; tootne ka nuqsan na ho.

text: fasal kahan bechein zyada rate mile
label: market_price
answer: Mandi ya procurement center pe bechein. Bechne se pehle rate check karein. Do teen jagah compare karein. Achi quality zyada rate.

text: sarkari support price kya hai faslon ki
label: market_price
answer: Sarkar har saal support price announce karti hai. News ya agri department se check karein. Khareed center ki list food department se.

text: khet mein jhariyan kaise control karein
label: weed_control
answer: Jhariyan chhoti hon to bone ke 25–35 din baad herbicide chhidkain. Ghaas aur chauri alag product. Haath se bhi nikaal sakte hain.

text: zameen sakht hai kaise behtar banayein
label: general_info
answer: Sakht zameen: organic khaad, gehraee jot ek dafa, pani nikasi behtar. Gili zameen par zyada jot na karein. Green manure ya compost faida.

text: nehr ka pani kam hai pani kaise manage karein
label: irrigation
answer: Nehr ka pani kam ho to tube well talaab use karein. Critical stages par hi pani dein. Beds ya furrows se pani bachayein. Gap barhaen.

text: nitrogen kami ke liye kaun sa khaad
label: fertilizer
answer: Nitrogen kami ke liye urea use karein. Kami dikhe to topdress. Pehle pani phir urea. Split dose behtar.

text: patton pe daag bimari hai kaun si spray
label: disease
answer: Patton pe daag fungus bimari ho sakti hai. Us crop ke liye recommend fungicide chhidkain. Pehli nishani par jald. Resistant variety agli bar.

text: urea ki doosri dose kab den
label: fertilizer
answer: Urea doosri dose tillering ya phool se pehle; pehli crown-root par. Crop aur local recommendation dekhein.

text: dana keerey se bach kar kaise store karein
label: harvest
answer: Dana 12–14% nami tak sukhaen. Saaf sukhi boriyon ya bin mein rakhein. Keerey dikhein to fumigation ya dawai. Regular check.

text: aaj mandi rate kaise check karein
label: market_price
answer: Mandi rate SMS, mandi office ya agri app se roz check karein. Bechne se pehle aaj ka rate. Do jagah compare.

text: rabi fasal kab boen behtar waqt
label: sowing
answer: Rabi bone: gandum late Oct–mid Nov; region se farq. Doosri rabi faslen bhi waqt par. Der na karein.

text: kharif fasal kab boen behtar waqt
label: sowing
answer: Kharif bone: May–July chawal kapas makki. Ilaqa aur barish. Jahan mumkin jaldi boen.

text: gandum ke baad kya fasal boen
label: sowing
answer: Gandum ke baad chawal makki kapas ya dalen pani aur mausam ke hisaab se. Rotation zameen behtar rakhti hai. Extension se puchen.

text: chawal ke baad kya fasal boen
label: sowing
answer: Chawal ke baad gandum, sarson, aaloo ya sabziyan. Chawal kattai ke baad jald tayari. Gandum Oct–Nov aam hai.

text: meri zameen reti hai kya ugaen
label: general_info
answer: Reti zameen: dalen, makki, mung, moonghi. Organic matter dalen. Thori zyada pani. Bhari mitti wali faslen avoid.

text: chikni mitti mein kaun si faslen achi
label: general_info
answer: Chikni zameen: chawal gandum ganna suit. Pani nikasi theek rakhein. Zyada pani mat dein. Organic matter faida.

text: fasal ko kitni dafa pani chahiye
label: irrigation
answer: Aksar faslon ko 4–6 pani chahiye. Critical: shuruat, phool, dana bharne. Gap 12–20 din zameen mausam ke hisaab se.

text: do paniyon ke beech kitna gap rakhein
label: irrigation
answer: Do paniyon ka gap 12–20 din aam. Raiti zameen kam gap; bhari zameen zyada. Critical stages mat chhoren.

text: DAP aur urea kab dalen
label: fertilizer
answer: DAP bone par; urea split bone par thora, baqi tillering ya phool se pehle. Pani topdress ke baad. Miqdar recommendation se.

text: gobar khaad chemical ke sath de sakte hain
label: fertilizer
answer: Gobar khaad chemical ke sath de sakte hain. 2–4 ton galay gobar bone se pehle. Chemical kam mat karein; dono balance karein.

text: chust fasal par kaun si dawai
label: pest
answer: Chust ke liye extension se recommended insecticide. Subah ya sham chhidkain. Patton ke niche coverage. 7–10 din baad repeat agar zarurat.

text: keeron ko natural tarike se kaise rokain
label: pest
answer: Keeron ko natural: khet saaf, neem oil lehsun spray, faida mand keerey bachayein. Chemical sirf threshold par.

text: jhariyan spray se mar nahi rahi kya karein
label: weed_control
answer: Jhariyan resistant hon to alag mode wala herbicide use karein. Rotation zaroori. Haath se nikaalen agar ho. Extension se nayi product.

text: pre emergence ya post emergence kaun sa use karein
label: weed_control
answer: Pre emergence bone ke turant baad nami par; post jab jhariyan chhoti hon 25–35 din. Dono kaam; post pre miss ho to zaroor.

text: sardi se fasal nuqsan ho rahi bachayein kaise
label: weather_risk
answer: Sardi: pehle light pani dein. Frost ilaqe mein jaldi bone avoid. Resistant variety. Nuqsan zada crop thora recover ho sakta hai.

text: barish zyada pani bhar gaya kya karein
label: irrigation
answer: Pani bhar gaya turant nikaalen. Naaliyan banaen. Aur pani mat dein. Agli bar drainage behtar karein.

text: sukhe ilaqe ke liye kaun si fasal
label: sowing
answer: Sukha ilaqe: gandum makki jwar ki drought variety. Agri department se list. Seed rate thori zyada.

text: per acre kitna beej dalna chahiye
label: sowing
answer: Beej per acre 40–50 kg gandum; crop se farq. Apni fasal variety ke hisaab se. Der bone ho to thora zyada.

text: beej treatment kyun zaroori hai
label: sowing
answer: Beej treatment beej se bimari aur kuch keerey rokta hai. Fungicide ya insecticide recommend. Treat karke shade mein sukha kar boen.

text: zero tillage ka faida kya hai
label: sowing
answer: Zero tillage: waqt diesel bachta nami bachti. Bina puri jot bone. Chawal ke baad gandum ke liye acha. Drill aur residue theek chahiye.

text: bone ke kitne din baad pehla pani den
label: irrigation
answer: Pehla pani bone ke 20–25 din baad zyada tar faslon ko. Jab crown-root stage. Crop se 2–3 din farq ho sakta hai.

text: tube well ka pani fasal ke liye kaafi hai
label: irrigation
answer: Tube well kaafi hai agar 4–6 pani sahi waqt par de saken. Critical stages par pani zaroor. Supply irregular ho to stored pani rakhein.

text: nitrogen kami ki nishaniyan kya hain
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Nitrogen kami: purane patte zard, growth kam. Urea topdress dalen. Pani dein application ke baad.

text: phosphorus kami kaise pehchanen
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Phosphorus kami: patte gulaabi ya kaale, jaden kamzor. DAP ya SSP bone par. Soil test confirm karega.

text: potash fasal ko kab den
label: fertilizer
answer: Potash bone par DAP ke sath dein agar soil test mein K kam. Kuch faslon ko split. Apni fasal recommendation dekhein.

text: zinc kami patton pe safed lakeeren
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Naye patton pe safed lakeeren zinc kami. Zinc sulphate zameen ya foliar spray. Repeat agar nishaniyan rahein.

text: zameen ka test kaise karwain kab
label: general_info
answer: Soil test: khet se sample, lab ya extension ko. Har mausam se pehle behtar. Har 2–3 saal test.

text: fasal ka karz kahan se milega
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Fasal ka karz bank Kisan scheme se. Zameen aur CNIC. Agri office mein scheme aur eligibility ki list.

text: beej subsidy kaise len
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Beej subsidy agri department se apply karein. Form aur quota har mausam. Waqt par apply. Eligibility agri office se.

text: fasal insurance claim kaise karein
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Fasal insurance claim: nuqsan jald report karein photos ke sath. Survey hogi. Policy mutabiq form. Documents rakhein.

text: combine se kaatne ka sahi waqt kab
label: harvest
answer: Combine jab dana bilkul pakka sakht ho. Drum concave setting theek. Subah sham kaatain loss kam.

text: threshing mein nuqsan kam kaise karein
label: harvest
answer: Threshing loss kam: dana pakka hone dein, combine setting theek, speed zyada na. Manual ho to dheere.

text: store ke liye nami kitni honi chahiye
label: harvest
answer: Store ke liye safe nami 12–14% ya kam. Zyada se keerey fungus. Dhoop mein patli layer sukhaen phir store.

text: bechne ke tips zyada rate ke liye
label: market_price
answer: Zyada rate: dana saaf grading test weight theek. Bechne se pehle rate. Group mein bechein agar ho. Bhagdar bechne se bachein.

text: procurement center kahan hai
label: market_price
answer: Procurement center ki list food department ya agri office se. Kisan helpline par bhi. Apne zone ke liye check karein.

text: achi quality ka dana zyada rate kaise mile
label: market_price
answer: Premium rate: dana saaf uniform test weight acha. Sukha store theek. Grading achi. Kuch mills quality par zyada dete hain.

text: khet mein termite ka control kaise karein
label: pest
answer: Termite: bone par soil insecticide ya seed treatment. Pani nikasi theek. Purani stubble hataen. Extension se product.

text: cutworm nuqsan kar raha kaun si spray
label: pest
answer: Cutworm: bone par soil insecticide ya jaldi spray. Paudon ke paas zameen bhi cover. Nuqsan pehli dafa dikhe to control.

text: patton pe daag ke liye kaun si fungicide
label: disease
answer: Patton pe daag: us crop ke liye recommend fungicide. Pehli daag par chhidkain. Coverage achha. Resistant variety agli bar.

text: root rot kaise pehchanen aur control karein
label: disease
answer: Root rot: jaden galti brown kaali, pauda nikal jata. Pani nikasi theek karein; waterlogging na ho. Resistant variety rotation.

text: zyada pani fasal ko nuqsan karti hai kya
label: irrigation
answer: Haan zyada pani waterlogging root rot lodging. Gap 12–20 din. Sirf zarurat par critical stages par pani.

text: sprinkler faslon ke liye theek hai kya
label: irrigation
answer: Sprinkler pani uniform aur bachav ke liye theek. Subah sham use karein. Pressure nozzle theek. 20–30% pani bachta hai.

text: drip irrigation kheti ke liye
label: irrigation
answer: Drip pani bachata hai uniform nami. Sabzi aur kuch faslon ke liye acha. Lagat aur dekhbhal.

text: bed planting se pani kaise bachta hai
label: irrigation
answer: Bed planting: pani furrows mein kam zaya. Hawa achi. Bed planter chahiye. Pani 20–30% bachta hai.

text: gobar khaad kitna per acre dalen
label: fertilizer
answer: Gobar 2–4 ton per acre galay. Bone se pehle chemical ke sath. Chemical miqdar zyada kam mat karein. Zameen mein milayein.

text: compost kaise banayein aur use karein
label: fertilizer
answer: Compost: fasal residue patte gobar pile; nami rakhein; paltein. 2–3 mahine mein tayar. Bone se pehle 2–4 ton.

text: bone se pehle green manure kaun si fasal
label: fertilizer
answer: Green manure: mung mash ya sesbania main fasal se pehle. 3–4 haftay pehle kaat kar milayein. Nitrogen aur organic matter.

text: micronutrient spray kab chhidkain
label: fertilizer
answer: Micronutrient spray jab kami dikhe: zinc boron. Tillering ya phool se pehle foliar. Dose label par. Subah sham.

text: weedicide rotation kyun zaroori hai
label: weed_control
answer: Herbicide rotation se jhariyan resistant nahi hoti. Har mausam alag mode use karein. Wahi bar bar se resistant ho jati hain.

text: ghaas aur chauri dono jhari ek spray se
label: weed_control
answer: Dono ek spray sirf jab dono ka label us crop ke liye allow kare. Warna ghaas alag chauri alag chhidkain.

text: khet scout kitni dafa karein
label: general_info
answer: Khet scout har 7–10 din mausam mein. Keera bimari jhari pani dekhein. Masla ho to zyada. Record rakhein.

text: zyada paidawar ke liye best tips kya hain
label: general_info
answer: Behtar paidawar: acha beej waqt par bone balanced khaad critical pani jhari keera control. Scout recommendation follow karein.

text: kharif mausam kab shuru hota hai
label: sowing
answer: Kharif May–June barish ke sath shuru. Bone May se July crop aur ilaqe ke hisaab se.

text: rabi mausam kab shuru hota hai
label: sowing
answer: Rabi Oct–Nov shuru. Gandum late Oct–mid Nov. Doosri rabi faslen bhi isi waqt.

text: der se bone ho gaya kya karein
label: sowing
answer: Der bone: seed rate thori zyada, jaldi ya tolerant variety. Khaad pani waqt par. Paidawar thori kam expect.

text: beej kitni gehrayi mein boen
label: sowing
answer: Beej gehrayi 3–5 cm zyada faslon ke liye. Zyada gehraee germination late. Nami is gehrayi par honi chahiye.

text: line sowing broadcast se behtar hai kya
label: sowing
answer: Line sowing behtar: stand uniform kam beej jhari asaan. Broadcast zyada beej aur ghana patla.

text: kisi bhi fasal ko pehla pani kab dena hai
label: irrigation
answer: Pehla pani zyada tar faslon ko 20–25 din baad. Jab 2–3 patte crown-root stage. Recommendation dekhein.

text: critical stages kab fasal ko pani zaroori hai
label: irrigation
answer: Critical stages: shuruat tillering phool dana bharne. In par pani mat chhoren.

text: talaab ka pani kheti ke liye use karein
label: irrigation
answer: Talaab ka pani use kar sakte hain. Barish ka pani store. Critical par dein. Kharab pani ho to check karein.

text: namak wali zameen mein kya uga sakte hain
label: general_info
answer: Namak zameen: jau gandum kuch varieties kapas jwar sah sakte hain. Pani nikasi behtar. Gypsum zarurat ho to. Pehle soil test.

text: zameen ka pH kaise check karein behtar karein
label: general_info
answer: Zameen pH: lab test. 6 se kam ho to chuna; 8 se zyada drainage gypsum. Organic matter faida.

text: pani nikasi kharab hai kaise theek karein
label: general_info
answer: Pani nikasi kharab: naaliyan level karein zyada pani na dein. Organic matter. Laser jahan ho.

text: alag faslon ke liye NPK ratio kya hai
label: fertilizer
answer: Faslon ke hisaab se NPK: gandum 4:2:1 chawal 3:1:1 qareeb. Soil test exact. P K bone par N split.

text: bone par basal kya dalen
label: fertilizer
answer: Basal: DAP ya SSP P ke liye K zarurat ho to. Thora N. Miqdar soil test aur crop.

text: top dressing kab aur kitni
label: fertilizer
answer: Top dressing: pehli tillering doosri phool se pehle. Urea aam. Recommendation se miqdar. Pani application ke baad.

text: keera spray kab karein threshold kya hai
label: pest
answer: Keera spray jab threshold cross ho: maslan 5–10 chust per plant. Extension threshold batata hai. Jaldi mat chhidkain.

text: IPM kya hai kaise karein
label: pest
answer: IPM: scout threshold natural control sirf zarurat par spray. Khet saaf. Resistant variety. Lagat aur mahaul dono bachte hain.

text: selective insecticide matlab kya hai
label: pest
answer: Selective insecticide sirf us keera ko marta hai; faida mand bach jate. Broad sab. Selective jab ho use karein.

text: khet mein chooha control kaise karein
label: pest
answer: Chooha: trap ya zehrili bait safe jagah. Dana khet saaf. Bachon janwar se door. Regular check.

text: leaf blight ke liye kaun si fungicide
label: disease
answer: Leaf blight: triazole ya strobilurin fungicide us crop ke liye. Pehli daag par chhidkain. Coverage achha.

text: powdery mildew ke liye kaun sa spray
label: disease
answer: Powdery mildew: sulphur ya triazole fungicide. Safed powder dikhe to chhidkain. Resistant variety agli fasal.

text: beej se bimari kaise bachain
label: disease
answer: Certified ya treated beej. Bimari wali fasal ka beej na use karein. Fungicide treatment. Saaf storage.

text: resistant variety matlab kya hoti hai
label: disease
answer: Resistant variety us bimari se kam ya nahi hoti. Research station se list. Bimari aam ho to variety badlein.

text: kaatne ka waqt fasal ready kaise pata chale
label: harvest
answer: Fasal tayar: dana sakht bhoosa zard nami kam. Naakhun test. Thora jaldi der se behtar.

text: jaldi kaat lain to nuqsan hota hai kya
label: harvest
answer: Jaldi kaatain: dana bhara nahi paidawar kam. Sirf jab pest ya mausam se bachana ho. Waqt par kaatna behtar.

text: dana sukha kar kaise store karein
label: harvest
answer: Dana patli layer dhoop mein 3–7 din sukhaen. Hilaen. Nami 12–14%. Store se pehle thanda. Store mein condensation na ho.

text: kaatai ke baad bhoosa kya karein
label: harvest
answer: Bhoosa: charay bechein ya mulch. Baler ho to bale. Jalaen mat; compost ya janwar ke liye use karein.

text: rate barhne ka intezar karein ya bech dein
label: market_price
answer: Bechein jab paisa chahiye ya rate acha ho. Store karein agar jagah safe aur rate barhne ka andaza. Market dekhein.

text: forward contract bechne se faida kya hai
label: market_price
answer: Forward contract: kaatne se pehle rate fix. Girne ka risk kam. Barhe to faida nahi. Shartain payment clear.

text: test weight aur rate ka rishta kya hai
label: market_price
answer: Test weight zyada behtar dana; mills zyada dete hain. Achi variety sahi waqt kattai theek store se behtar.

text: weighbridge bechte waqt check karein kya
label: market_price
answer: Bechte waqt weighbridge check: weight sahi ho koi chori na. Weight slip rakhein. Doosri jagah verify karwa sakte hain.

text: oala se fasal nuqsan ho to kya karein
label: weather_risk
answer: Oala nuqsan: insurance ke liye report photos. Extra N mat. Zameen sukhi ho to light pani. Crop thora recover ho sakta hai.

text: garmi flowering par fasal nuqsan
label: weather_risk
answer: Phool par garmi nuqsan dana kam. Waqt par bone last pani grain fill. Garmi sahne wali variety agar ho.

text: barani ilaqe mein kab boen
label: sowing
answer: Barani: jab zameen mein barish se nami enough ho tab boen. Rabi late Oct; kharif May–June. Drought variety.

text: ek saal mein do faslen le sakte hain kya
label: sowing
answer: Ek saal do faslen: maslan gandum chawal ke baad; makki aaloo. Pani aur mausam length par. Extension se plan.

text: intercropping ka faida kya hai
label: general_info
answer: Intercropping: do faslen sath zameen aur nutrients behtar use. Maslan makki lobia. Spacing aur kaatai plan.

text: laser leveler se kya faida
label: general_info
answer: Laser leveler: zameen barabar kam pani zyada paidawar. Rent ya hire. Ek dafa lagat. Pani behtar.

text: zameen tayari ke liye tractor
label: machinery
answer: Tractor: 1–2 jot 2–3 sulah phir level. Zameen zyada gili na ho. Bone se 1–2 haftay pehle tayari.

text: sprayer nozzle kaun sa theek hai
label: machinery
answer: Spray ke liye flat fan nozzle. Pressure 2–3 bar. Height speed barabar. Drift kam coverage achha.

text: drill calibration bone ke liye kaise karein
label: machinery
answer: Drill calibration: seed rate depth set. Sheet par check. Speed barabar. Khet mein test stand dekhein.

text: salam kheti ke bare mein sawal hai
label: greeting
answer: Wa alaikum assalam. Bone pani khaad keera bimari kaatai bechne ke sawal pooch sakte hain. Kya chahiye bataein.

text: salam faslon par mashwara chahiye
label: greeting
answer: Wa alaikum assalam. Apni fasal aur masla bataein: bone pani khaad keera bimari ya mandi. Main rehnumai karunga.

text: kapas kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Kapas April–May jab garmi ho boen. Ilaqa se farq. Bollworm zyada ho to jaldi bone behtar.

text: makki kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Makki kharif May–June; spring Feb–March. Ilaqa. Bahut der bone avoid karein.

text: ganna kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Ganna Feb–March planting. Kattai ke baad ratoon. Pura pani khaad chahiye.

text: aaloo kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Aaloo Oct–Nov maidani; paharon Feb–March. Thanda mausam. Achi zameen pani chahiye.

text: pyaz kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Pyaz Oct–Nov rabi; Feb spring. Dono mausam ho sakte. Beej ya sets.

text: tamatar kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Tamatar Feb–March spring; July–Aug barish. Tez garmi avoid. Staking bimari spray.

text: mirch kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Mirch Feb–March ya July–Aug. Garm fasal. Pani nikasi spray virus ke khilaf.

text: suraj mukhi kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Suraj mukhi Feb–March spring; July kharif. Choti mudat. Rotation ke liye acha.

text: chana kab boen kis mahine
label: sowing
answer: Chana Oct–Nov rabi. Barani ya ek pani. Der bone avoid.

text: kapas ko kitna pani chahiye
label: irrigation
answer: Kapas ko 6–8 pani. Critical: phool aur goli. Gap 10–15 din. Drip ya furrow pani bachata hai.

text: makki ko kitna pani chahiye
label: irrigation
answer: Makki ko 6–8 pani. Critical: ghutne tak tasseling dana. Gap 10–14 din. Phool par sukha nuqsan.

text: gane ko kitna pani chahiye
label: irrigation
answer: Gane ko regular pani chahiye. 15–20 pani. Zyada garmi mein. Kattai se pehle band.

text: kapas ko kitna khaad per acre
label: fertilizer
answer: Kapas: 2–3 bag DAP 3–4 bag urea per acre split. Behtar zameen zyada. Boron zinc kami ho to.

text: makki ko kitna khaad per acre
label: fertilizer
answer: Makki: 1–2 bag DAP 2–3 bag urea. Bone par full topdress ghutne tasseling par.

text: chawal ko kitna khaad per acre
label: fertilizer
answer: Chawal: 1–2 bag DAP 2–3 bag urea. N split tillering aur panicle. Zinc zyada tar jagah.

text: kapas ke khas keerey kaun se hain
label: pest
answer: Kapas keerey: bollworm chust whitefly. Threshold par recommend insecticide. Bt kapas bollworm kam karta hai.

text: makki ke keerey kaun se hain
label: pest
answer: Makki keerey: stem borer chust armyworm. Nuqsan dikhe to spray. Resistant variety khet saaf.

text: chawal ki bimariyan kaun si hain
label: disease
answer: Chawal bimari: blast blight sheath blight. Resistant variety. Fungicide zarurat par. Beej treatment.

text: aaloo ki bimariyan kaun si hain
label: disease
answer: Aaloo bimari: late blight virus. Blight ke liye fungicide. Certified beej. Crop rotation.

text: chawal ke khet mein jhariyan kaise control karein
label: weed_control
answer: Chawal jhari: pre ya post emergence herbicide. 25–35 din haath se. Chara pani practice mutabiq.

text: makki ke khet mein jhariyan kaise control karein
label: weed_control
answer: Makki jhari: atrazine ya post emergence. 25–35 din bone ke baad jhariyan chhoti. Haath se bhi.

text: chawal kab kaatain
label: harvest
answer: Chawal jab 80% dana pakka. Bhoosa zard. Nami 20–25%. Combine ya haath.

text: kapas tootna kab shuru karein
label: harvest
answer: Kapas jab goliyan khulein to tootna shuru. Faasle se totein. Khuli goli zyada din na chhoren. Sukhi jagah store.

text: makki kaatne ka waqt kab hai
label: harvest
answer: Makki jab dana sakht black layer. Aam 90–120 din. Combine ya haath.

text: aaj kapas ka rate kya hai mandi
label: market_price
answer: Kapas rate mandi SMS market. Roz badalta. Quality staple rate par asar.

text: aaj chawal ka rate kya hai mandi
label: market_price
answer: Chawal rate mandi ya procurement. Quality variety. Mausam mein sarkari khareed.

text: aaj makki ka rate kya hai mandi
label: market_price
answer: Makki rate local mandi. Charay industry. Mausam se rate badalta hai.

text: kharif ke liye zameen ki tayari kaise karein
label: general_info
answer: Kharif tayari: rabi kattai ke baad jot sulah level. Jhariyan hataen. May–June tak tayar.

text: rabi ke liye zameen ki tayari kaise karein
label: general_info
answer: Rabi tayari: kharif ke baad 1–2 jot sulah level. Gandum Oct–Nov ke liye waqt par.

text: jot kitni dafa lagani chahiye
label: general_info
answer: Jot 1–2 dafa zyada tar faslon ke liye kaafi. Zameen sakht ho to ek dafa gehraee. Phir sulah.

text: sulah kab karein
label: general_info
answer: Sulah jot ke baad dheere level. 2–3 dafa. Zameen zyada gili na ho.

text: zameen level kyun zaroori hai
label: general_info
answer: Level zameen taake pani barabar. Kam zaya behtar stand. Laser behtar; haath se bhi.

text: certified beej ka faida kya hai
label: sowing
answer: Certified beej: test pure germination achi. Bimari kam. Paidawar quality ke liye lagat kee.

text: apna beej kab use kar sakte hain
label: sowing
answer: Apna beej sehatmand fasal ka use kar sakte; fungicide se treat. Bimari wali fasal ka na use karein.

text: beej ko kaise safe rakhein
label: sowing
answer: Beej sukhi thandi jagah boriyon ya bin. Agle mausam se pehle treat. Keeron se bachayein.

text: germination kam hai kya karein
label: sowing
answer: Germination kam: beej quality gehrayi nami check. Khaliyan zyada hon to dubara boen. Agli bar certified.

text: per acre kitne plants hon chahiye
label: sowing
answer: Plants per acre: gandum 40–50 per sq m; makki 6–7. Crop se farq. Recommendation dekhein.

text: paudon ke beech spacing kitni
label: sowing
answer: Spacing: gandum 20–25 cm line; makki 60–75 cm. Crop variety. Barabar spacing behtar.

text: barish pani se fasal nuqsan recovery kaise karein
label: weather_risk
answer: Barish pani: jald nikaalen. Sukhi hone par light topdress. Agli bar drainage bund.

text: hava se fasal gir gayi lod ho gayi
label: weather_risk
answer: Lodging: ho to jald kaat lain. Agli bar kam N resistant variety. Sahan khet mein mushkil.

text: sardi se naye paude nuqsan
label: weather_risk
answer: Sardi nuqsan: sardi ilaqe mein bahut jaldi bone avoid. Sardi se pehle light pani. Resistant variety agar ho.

text: boron kami ki nishaniyan kya hain
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Boron kami: growth points maren grain kam. Borax boron. Soil test confirm.

text: sulphur kami ki nishaniyan kya hain
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Sulphur: naye patte peele growth kam. Gypsum sulphur. Sarson mein zard aksar sulphur.

text: fasal mein iron kami hai
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Iron kami: naye patton pe peeliyan nas ke beech. Foliar iron ya drainage. High pH mein aam.

text: magnesium kami ki nishaniyan
label: nutrient_deficiency
answer: Magnesium: purane patte kinare se zard. Epsom ya magnesium khaad. Soil test.

text: foliar spray kab chhidkain
label: fertilizer
answer: Foliar jab zameen late ya kami dikhe. Zinc urea micronutrient. Subah sham.

text: patton par urea chhidkain safe hai kya
label: fertilizer
answer: Patton par urea 2% supplement ho sakta. Zameen N ka badal nahi. Dhoop tez avoid.

text: khaad aur weedicide ek sath mix karein
label: weed_control
answer: Tank mix sirf jab dono label allow. Kuch mix crop nuqsan. Alag chhidkana safe. Extension se puchen.

text: post emergence spray kab chhidkain
label: weed_control
answer: Post emergence jab jhariyan chhoti 25–35 din bone ke baad. Product jhari ke hisaab. Hawa calm.

text: chauri jhari ke liye kaun sa herbicide
label: weed_control
answer: Chauri: 2,4-D jaisa us crop ke liye. Crop safety. Dose label. Jhariyan chhoti hon.

text: ghaas jhari ke liye kaun sa herbicide
label: weed_control
answer: Ghaas: us crop ke liye grass herbicide. Clodinafop quizalofop. Dose waqt label.

text: haath se jhariyan kab nikalein
label: weed_control
answer: Haath se jhariyan 25–35 din. Jhariyan beej banayen se pehle. Doosri zarurat ho to. Mazdoori ho to sasta.

text: stale seedbed jhariyon ke liye kaise karein
label: weed_control
answer: Stale seedbed: tayari karein jhariyan ugen maarein spray ya halki jot. Phir boen. Jhari kam.

text: store keerey ka control kaun sa ilaaj
label: harvest
answer: Store keerey: fumigation ya contact insecticide. Dana sukha saaf. Safety. Zarurat ho to repeat.

text: fumigation dane ke liye kab zaroori hai
label: harvest
answer: Fumigation jab keerey andar hon. Store band karein recommend fumigant. Baad hawa. Professional behtar.

text: gandum store ke liye nami kitni safe hai
label: harvest
answer: Gandum store nami 12–14% ya kam. Dhoop sukhaen. Saaf sukhi jagah. Keerey dikhein to fumigate.

text: chawal store ke liye nami kitni safe hai
label: harvest
answer: Chawal store: 12–14% sukhaen. Gandum jaisa. Parboiled zyada der. Nami se bachayein.

text: boriyon mein store karein ya bulk mein
label: harvest
answer: Boriyan: uthana bechna asaan. Bulk: bin chahiye kam mazdoori. Dono sukha pest se bachav.

text: sarkar kis kis fasal ki procurement karti hai
label: market_price
answer: Sarkari khareed: gandum chawal kabhi kapas. Food department list. Quality standard.

text: kisan card se kya faida milega
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Kisan card: pehchan karz subsidy insurance. Bank ya agri office. Documents mutabiq.

text: kisan ke liye sood free qarz kahan se
label: subsidy_loan
answer: Sood free qarz sarkari scheme kisan. Bank agri office. Eligibility limit scheme.

text: khaad par subsidy kaise len
label: subsidy_loan

text: What is fumigation I do not know please explain
label: term_explanation
answer: Fumigation is a way to kill insects inside stored grain or in a closed place. A fumigant is a gas or chemical that is released in the closed store; the gas fills the space and kills insects that are inside the grain or bags. It is used when insects are already inside and spray cannot reach them. The store must be closed properly so the gas does not leak; after some days the store is opened and aired. Always use fumigation as per label and keep children and animals away.

text: What is tillering stage in crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Tillering is the stage when a wheat or rice plant grows extra stems from the base. One seed gives one main stem first; then small branches called tillers grow from the bottom. More tillers usually mean more grain later because each tiller can have an ear or panicle. This stage comes after crown-root stage and before booting. First irrigation and first top dress of urea are often given at tillering for good number of tillers.

text: What is DAP fertilizer
label: term_explanation
answer: DAP stands for Di-Ammonium Phosphate. It is a chemical fertilizer that gives two main nutrients: nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P). Phosphorus helps roots grow strong and early growth; nitrogen helps green leaves and growth. Farmers use DAP at sowing time as basal dose; it is spread or drilled with the seed. In Pakistan one bag is often 50 kg; per acre 1–2 bags are common for wheat and many crops. It is not used for top dressing; urea is used for that.

text: What is urea and when to use
label: term_explanation
answer: Urea is a white granule fertilizer that gives nitrogen (N) to the crop. Nitrogen makes leaves green and helps the plant grow and give more yield. Urea is not put in large amount at sowing; it is given in splits: a little at sowing and then as top dressing at tillering and sometimes at booting. It is spread on the soil and then irrigation is given so it dissolves and goes to the roots. If too much is given at once, some can be lost; so split dose is better.

text: What is herbicide and weedicide same or different
label: term_explanation
answer: Herbicide and weedicide mean the same thing: a chemical that kills or stops weeds (unwanted plants in the field). Herbicide is the common English word; weedicide is also used in India and Pakistan. Both are sprays used in the crop to control weeds so that the crop gets more space, light and food. You must use the right product for your crop and type of weed (grass or broad leaf). Dose and timing are on the label; wrong use can damage the crop.

text: What is fungicide explain simply
label: term_explanation
answer: A fungicide is a chemical that kills or stops fungus. Fungus causes many crop diseases like rust (zang), blight, powdery mildew, and smut. The fungicide is mixed in water and sprayed on leaves or applied to seed. Some fungicides work on the surface; others go inside the plant (systemic) and protect new growth too. You must use the one recommended for your crop and disease. Spray when disease is first seen; repeat as per label to protect the crop.

text: What is foliar spray meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Foliar spray means spraying fertilizer or medicine on the leaves of the plant instead of putting it in the soil. The leaves take in the nutrient or chemical through their surface. It is used when the crop needs a nutrient quickly (e.g. zinc, urea) or when soil application is late. The mix is made as per dose (e.g. 2% urea in water) and sprayed with a sprayer in morning or evening. Hot sun and strong wind are avoided so that leaves do not burn and spray does not drift.

text: What is zero tillage in farming
label: term_explanation
answer: Zero tillage means sowing the next crop without ploughing or turning the soil. The field is not ploughed; a special drill puts seed and fertilizer directly into the soil through the leftover straw and stubble of the previous crop. It saves time, diesel and labour; it also keeps soil moisture and improves soil over time. It is common for wheat after rice when there is little time. You need a zero-till drill or happy seeder and the residue should not be burned.

text: What is IPM in crop pest control
label: term_explanation
answer: IPM means Integrated Pest Management. It is a way to control pests (insects, diseases, weeds) by using several methods together instead of only chemical spray. Steps include: (1) Scout the field regularly to see if pest is there and how much. (2) Use threshold—spray only when pest number crosses a limit. (3) Keep field clean and use resistant variety. (4) Use natural or biological control where possible. (5) Use chemical when needed with right dose. This saves cost and is safer for health and environment.

text: What is test weight in grain
label: term_explanation
answer: Test weight is the weight of a fixed volume of grain, usually one litre or one bushel. It is measured in kg per hectolitre or kg per 40 litres. Heavier (denser) grain has higher test weight; it means grain is well filled and mature. Buyers and mills pay more for higher test weight. To get good test weight, use good variety, harvest at right time when grain is hard, and store properly. Low test weight can be due to late sowing, disease or poor filling.

text: What is topdress or top dressing
label: term_explanation
answer: Top dressing means putting fertilizer on the soil surface after the crop has already been sown and is growing. It is not mixed in soil at sowing like basal dose. Urea is the most common top dress: it is spread by hand or machine on the field and then irrigation is given so it dissolves and reaches the roots. It is done at important stages like tillering and booting when the crop needs more nitrogen. Amount per acre is as per recommendation; split in 2–3 times is better than all at once.

text: What is crop residue meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop residue is the part of the plant left in the field after harvest: straw, stubble, leaves and roots. For example after wheat harvest the straw and cut stems are residue; after rice the standing stubble and straw are residue. It can be left on the surface (for zero till), mixed in soil, or removed. Burning residue is not good for soil and air; better is to use it as mulch, compost or sow next crop with happy seeder in the residue. It adds organic matter and saves moisture.

text: What is procurement center
label: term_explanation
answer: Procurement center is a place run by the government (e.g. food department) where farmers can sell their crop (like wheat, rice) at the official support price. The government buys grain for storage and distribution. The list of centers is given by the agriculture or food department; farmers bring grain, it is weighed and tested, and payment is made as per policy. It gives a sure market and fixed price. You need to bring required documents and meet quality standards.

text: What is threshold when to spray insecticide
label: term_explanation
answer: Threshold means the level or number of pest at which you must take action (e.g. spray). Below threshold, the pest is not enough to cause much loss and spray may not be needed. For example aphid threshold in wheat may be 5–10 aphids per tiller; when you see that many, you spray. Extension workers or recommendation guides give threshold for each pest and crop. Spraying before threshold wastes money and can harm beneficial insects; after threshold you may lose yield.

text: What is systemic fungicide
label: term_explanation
answer: Systemic fungicide is a medicine that enters the plant and moves inside it (in sap). So it not only protects the place where you spray but also new leaves and parts that grow later. It is used for diseases like rust and blight where the fungus is inside the leaf. You spray on leaves; the chemical goes in and helps control the disease for some days. Non-systemic (contact) fungicide only stays on the surface. For rust and serious disease, systemic is often recommended.

text: What is seed treatment
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed treatment means putting a chemical (fungicide or insecticide) on the seed before sowing. The seed is mixed with the chemical or dipped in a solution so that the seed is coated. It protects the seed and young plant from seed-borne diseases (like smut, bunt) and some soil pests. It is done a few days before sowing; after treatment seed is dried in shade and then used. Certified seed is often already treated; if you use your own seed, treatment is very important.

text: What is basal dose in fertilizer
label: term_explanation
answer: Basal dose means the fertilizer that you apply at the time of sowing, once at the start. It is put in or on the soil with the seed or just after sowing. Usually it includes phosphorus (e.g. DAP, SSP) and sometimes part of nitrogen and potash. Basal dose helps the young plant and roots to grow well. The rest of nitrogen is given later as top dressing. So basal = first dose at sowing; top dress = later doses when crop is growing.

text: What is crown root stage
label: term_explanation
answer: Crown-root stage is the early growth stage when the wheat or similar crop has 2–3 leaves and the crown (base) and roots are developing. It comes about 20–25 days after sowing. First irrigation is usually given at this stage so that roots go deep and tillers can form. If water is delayed too much, the crop may not tiller well. So crown-root stage is the time for first water and sometimes a little urea.

text: What is grain filling stage
label: term_explanation
answer: Grain filling stage is when the crop has flowered and the grain (seed) is forming and filling with starch. The grain grows in size and weight. For wheat it is after flowering; for rice after panicle comes. This stage needs enough water and no big stress (heat, disease). If water or nutrition is missing at grain filling, yield and test weight go down. Last irrigation is often given during grain filling.

text: What is pre emergence herbicide
label: term_explanation
answer: Pre-emergence herbicide is a weedicide that is applied before the weeds have come out of the soil. It is put on the soil right after sowing (or before) when the crop and weeds have not emerged. The chemical stays in the soil and kills weed seeds when they germinate. So weeds are controlled early. It is used when the label says pre-emergence; you need soil moisture for it to work. If you miss this, you use post-emergence later.

text: What is post emergence herbicide
label: term_explanation
answer: Post-emergence herbicide is a weedicide that is applied after the crop and weeds have come out of the soil. It is sprayed when weeds are small (e.g. 25–35 days after sowing). The product is chosen so it kills the weed but not the crop (selective). You must use the right dose and stage; if weeds are too big, control is poor. Post-emergence is used when you did not use pre-emergence or when pre was not enough.

text: What is tank mix in spraying
label: term_explanation
answer: Tank mix means mixing two or more chemicals (e.g. two pesticides, or pesticide and fertilizer) in the same spray tank and spraying together. It saves time and one round of spray. But you must only mix if both product labels allow it. Some mixes can damage the crop or reduce effect. So check label or ask extension: 'Can I mix this urea with this weedicide?' If not sure, spray separately. Wrong tank mix can burn crop or waste money.

text: What is FYM farmyard manure
label: term_explanation
answer: FYM means Farmyard Manure. It is organic manure made from cattle dung and urine mixed with straw or crop residue, kept in a pit or heap for months until it is rotten (decomposed). It adds organic matter and some nutrients to the soil and improves soil structure. Farmers apply 2–4 ton per acre before sowing, often with chemical fertilizer. It is not a replacement for full chemical dose but is used along with it. Well-rotten FYM is better than fresh dung.

text: What is waterlogging in field
label: term_explanation
answer: Waterlogging is when the field has too much water and the soil is full of water for a long time. Roots cannot get air and may rot; crop turns yellow and can die. It happens when there is heavy rain or too much irrigation and poor drainage. To fix it, drain the water out through drains or pumps. To avoid it, do not over-irrigate and improve drainage (level field, make channels). Waterlogging is a common problem in low or flat areas.

text: What is drainage in agriculture
label: term_explanation
answer: Drainage means the way extra water leaves the field. Good drainage is when rain or irrigation water does not stand on the surface; it goes away through channels, slopes or pipes. Poor drainage means water stays, leading to waterlogging. To improve drainage you make drains (naaliyan), level the field so water flows, and sometimes use pipes or raised beds. Good drainage is important for healthy roots and to avoid root rot and lodging.

text: What is resistant variety
label: term_explanation
answer: Resistant variety is a crop variety that does not get a certain disease or pest easily, or gets it less. For example a rust-resistant wheat variety will have less or no rust even when the disease is in the area. Scientists breed such varieties. You should use resistant variety when that disease or pest is common in your area. It reduces the need for spray and saves cost. Resistant does not mean immune; under heavy pressure some infection may still occur.

text: What is combine harvester
label: term_explanation
answer: Combine harvester (combine) is a machine that does three jobs in one go: it cuts the crop (reaping), threshes it (separates grain from straw), and cleans the grain. So in one pass the crop is harvested and you get grain and straw. It is used for wheat, rice, maize etc. It saves labour and time. You need to set it properly (drum, speed) to reduce loss. It is used when crop is fully ripe and grain is hard.

text: What is threshing meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Threshing means separating the grain from the straw and chaff. After cutting the crop, the ear or panicle has grain; threshing is beating or rubbing so that grain comes out. It can be done by hand (beating with stick), by animal, or by machine (thresher or combine). Threshing loss is the grain that is lost (broken, left in straw) during this. To reduce loss, thresh when grain is fully dry and use correct machine setting.

text: What is support price from government
label: term_explanation
answer: Support price is the minimum price announced by the government for a crop (e.g. wheat, rice). The government says it will buy at least at this price from farmers at procurement centers. It helps farmers get a fair price when market rate is low. Support price is declared before the season. When you sell at procurement center you get this price if your grain meets quality. It is also called minimum support price (MSP) in some countries.

text: What is forward contract in selling crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Forward contract means an agreement to sell your crop at a fixed price at a future date (e.g. after harvest). You and the buyer agree on price and quantity now; you deliver later. Benefit is you know the price and are safe if market price falls. Drawback is you do not get more if price rises. It is used by some traders and mills. Terms (quality, payment, date) should be clear and written. It can reduce risk for the farmer.

text: What is stubble in field
label: term_explanation
answer: Stubble is the lower part of the plant stem left standing in the field after the crop is cut. For example after wheat or rice harvest, the cut stems that remain in the field are stubble. It is a type of residue. In zero tillage, the next crop is sown in the same field without removing stubble; the drill passes through it. Burning stubble is harmful; better to leave it or use happy seeder. Stubble helps keep soil and moisture.

text: What is mulch in farming
label: term_explanation
answer: Mulch is a layer of material spread on the soil surface (e.g. straw, leaves, plastic). It reduces evaporation so soil stays moist longer; it also reduces weeds and keeps soil cool. Organic mulch (straw, residue) later mixes in and adds organic matter. In dry areas mulch helps save water. After sowing you can spread straw as mulch. Plastic mulch is used in some vegetables. Mulch is good for moisture and soil health.

text: What is micronutrient
label: term_explanation
answer: Micronutrient is a nutrient that the crop needs in small amount compared to N, P, K. Examples are zinc, iron, boron, sulphur, manganese. Without them crop can show deficiency (e.g. zinc: white streaks on leaves; boron: poor grain set). They are given in small dose: in soil or as foliar spray. Soil test can tell if soil is low in micronutrient. Using only urea and DAP without micronutrients can limit yield when soil is deficient.

text: What is NPK in fertilizer
label: term_explanation
answer: NPK means the three main nutrients in fertilizer: N = Nitrogen, P = Phosphorus, K = Potash (Potassium). Nitrogen gives green growth and yield; phosphorus helps roots and flowering; potash helps grain quality and strength. Fertilizer bags show NPK ratio e.g. 20-20-0 or 46-0-0 (urea). Soil test tells how much N, P, K to add. Basal dose often has P and K; N is given in splits. Balanced NPK gives better yield than only urea.

text: What is soil pH
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil pH is a number that shows whether soil is acidic, neutral or alkaline. Scale is 0–14: 7 is neutral; below 7 is acidic; above 7 is alkaline. Most crops like 6–7.5. If pH is too low (acidic) or too high (alkaline), nutrients are less available and crop does not grow well. You can test pH in a lab. To correct: add lime if too acidic; add gypsum and improve drainage if too alkaline. pH affects fertilizer use and crop choice.

text: What is saline soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Saline soil is soil that has too much salt (e.g. sodium, chloride). It is common in dry areas and where irrigation water has salt. High salt harms roots and growth; plants may wilt and leaves can burn. You can measure salinity with EC (electrical conductivity). To manage: use good quality water, improve drainage, add gypsum if needed, and grow salt-tolerant crops (e.g. barley, some wheat, cotton). Saline soil is also called namak zameen or kharab zameen.

text: What is crop rotation
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop rotation means growing different crops on the same field in different seasons or years. For example wheat after rice, or maize after wheat. It breaks the cycle of pests and diseases, uses soil nutrients better, and can improve soil (e.g. legume adds nitrogen). Same crop again and again (monocrop) can increase disease and reduce yield. So rotation is a good practice. Choice of next crop depends on water, season and market.

text: What is green manure
label: term_explanation
answer: Green manure is a crop that is grown not for harvest but to be cut and mixed into the soil while green or after a little drying. Legumes like mung, mash, or sesbania are common. They add nitrogen and organic matter when mixed in. You grow them for 1–2 months, then cut and plough in 3–4 weeks before sowing the main crop. It improves soil and reduces need for some chemical N. It is an old and useful practice.

text: What is scouting in field
label: term_explanation
answer: Scouting means going through the field regularly to look at the crop and notice problems. You check for pests (insects, disease), weeds, water stress, and growth. So you see early if something is wrong and can act in time. Scouts do it every 7–10 days or more when there is a problem. You can note what you see (record). It is the first step in IPM. Without scouting you may spray too late or too much.

text: What is booting stage in wheat
label: term_explanation
answer: Booting stage is when the wheat plant has formed the ear (head) inside the stem but it is not yet out. The stem is swollen at the top like a boot; the ear will come out soon. It comes after tillering and before flowering. It is a critical stage for water and sometimes for second dose of urea. If water or nitrogen is missing at booting, number of grains and yield can go down. So irrigation and top dress at booting are important.

text: fumigation kya hai samjhaen mujhe pata nahi
label: term_explanation
answer: Fumigation woh tareeqa hai jis se store kiye hue dane ke andar keerey maare jate hain. Fumigant ek gas ya chemical hota hai jo band godown ya store mein chhoda jata hai; gas puri jagah bhar jati hai aur andar ke keerey mar jate hain. Jab keerey dane ke andar hon aur spray andar tak na pahunche tab fumigation ki zarurat hoti hai. Store bilkul band hona chahiye taake gas bahar na nikle; kuch din baad store khol kar hawa dete hain. Label aur safety follow karein; bachon janwar door rakhein.

text: tillering stage matlab kya hai faslon mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Tillering woh stage hai jab gandum ya chawal ka pauda neeche se extra tane (tillers) nikalta hai. Ek beej se pehle ek main tana; phir neeche se chhoti shaakhein tillers kehlati hain. Zyada tillers ka matlab baad mein zyada dana kyunke har tiller par bal ya panicle aa sakta hai. Ye stage crown-root ke baad aur booting se pehle aata hai. Pehla pani aur pehli urea topdress aksar tillering par diye jate hain taake tillers achey niklein.

text: DAP kya hai khaad ka naam
label: term_explanation
answer: DAP ka matlab Di-Ammonium Phosphate hai. Ye chemical khaad hai jo do ahem nutrients deta hai: nitrogen (N) aur phosphorus (P). Phosphorus jaden mazboot karta hai aur shuruat ki growth; nitrogen hara patta aur growth. Kisan ise bone ke waqt basal dose ke tor par dalte hain; beej ke sath ya turant baad zameen mein milate hain. Pakistan mein ek bag aam 50 kg; per acre gandum aur zyada tar faslon ke liye 1–2 bag. Isse top dressing nahi karte; urea use hoti hai.

text: urea kya hai kab use hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Urea safed dana khaad hai jo fasal ko nitrogen (N) deti hai. Nitrogen patte hara karta hai aur paude ko barhne aur zyada paidawar dene mein madad karta hai. Urea bone par zyada nahi dali jati; split mein di jati hai: thori bone par phir tillering par topdress aur kabhi booting par. Zameen par chirak kar pani dete hain taake ghul kar jaden tak jaye. Ek dafa zyada dene se kuch waste ho sakti hai; is liye split dose behtar.

text: herbicide weedicide kya hai dono same hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Herbicide aur weedicide dono ka matlab same hai: woh chemical jo jhariyan (ghaas chauri waghaira) ko marta hai ya rokta hai. Herbicide English mein zyada; weedicide bhi Pakistan India mein bolte hain. Dono spray hain jo fasal mein jhariyan kam karne ke liye chhidke jate hain taake fasal ko zyada jagah roshni aur khuraak mile. Apni fasal aur jhari ki qism (ghaas ya chauri) ke mutabiq product len. Dose aur waqt label par; ghalat use se fasal nuqsan ho sakti hai.

text: fungicide kya hai simple bataen
label: term_explanation
answer: Fungicide woh chemical hai jo fungus ko marta hai ya rokta hai. Fungus se zang, blight, powdery mildew, smut jaisi bimariyan hoti hain. Fungicide pani mein mila kar patton par chhidka jata hai ya beej par lagaya jata hai. Kuch sirf surface par; kuch andar jate hain (systemic) aur naye patton ko bhi bachate hain. Apni fasal aur bimari ke liye recommend wala use karein. Pehli nishani par chhidkain; label ke mutabiq dohraen.

text: foliar spray ka matlab kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Foliar spray ka matlab patton par khaad ya dawai chhidkana, zameen mein dalne ke bajay. Patton ke zariye nutrient ya chemical andar jata hai. Jab fasal ko jald nutrient chahiye (maslan zinc, urea) ya zameen ki khaad der se di ho tab use karte hain. Dose ke mutabiq mix (maslan 2% urea pani mein) bana kar sprayer se subah ya sham chhidkate hain. Dhoop tez aur tundi hawa avoid karein taake patte na jalein aur spray idhar udhar na ho.

text: zero tillage kya hai kheti mein
label: term_explanation
