answer: Zero tillage ka matlab agli fasal bina jot ke bone. Zameen hilti nahi; khaas drill se beej aur khaad purani fasal ka bhoosa aur stubble ke andar seed drill karta hai. Is se waqt diesel mazdoori bachti hai aur zameen ki nami bhi; waqt ke sath zameen behtar hoti hai. Chawal ke baad gandum ke liye aam hai jab waqt kam ho. Zero-till drill ya happy seeder chahiye; residue jalaen mat.

text: IPM kya hai keeron ke liye
label: term_explanation
answer: IPM ka matlab Integrated Pest Management hai. Ye keeron bimariyon jhariyan ko control karne ka tareeqa hai jismein sirf chemical nahi balke kayi tareeke ek sath use hote hain. (1) Khet scout karein ke pest kitna hai. (2) Threshold use karein—jab hadd cross ho tab spray. (3) Khet saaf resistant variety. (4) Natural ya biological control jahan ho. (5) Chemical jab zarurat ho sahi dose. Is se lagat bachti hai aur sehat mahaul dono behtar.

text: test weight kya hoti hai dane ki
label: term_explanation
answer: Test weight woh weight hai jo ek fixed size (maslan ek litre) dane ka hota hai. Isse kg per hectolitre ya kg per 40 litre mein naapte hain. Bhari (dense) dane ki test weight zyada hoti hai; matlab dana bhara hua aur pakka. Kharedar aur mills zyada test weight par zyada dete hain. Achi test weight ke liye achi variety sahi waqt kaatai aur theek store. Kam test weight der bone bimari ya kam bharne se ho sakti hai.

text: topdress top dressing kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Topdress ya top dressing ka matlab fasal bone ke baad jab pauda ugg aa chuka ho tab zameen ki surface par khaad dalna. Ye basal dose ki tarah bone par ek sath nahi dali jati. Urea sab se aam topdress: haath ya machine se khet par chirak kar phir pani dete hain taake ghul kar jaden tak jaye. Tillering aur booting jaisi ahem stages par di jati hai jab fasal ko zyada nitrogen chahiye. Per acre miqdar recommendation; 2–3 dafa split ek sath se behtar.

text: residue matlab kya hai fasal ka
label: term_explanation
answer: Residue matlab fasal kaatne ke baad khet mein bacha hua hissa: bhoosa, stubble, patte, jaden. Maslan gandum kaatne ke baad bhoosa aur kaate hue tane residue; chawal ke baad khari stubble aur bhoosa. Isse surface par chhora ja sakta hai (zero till), zameen mein milaya ya hataaya. Residue jalaana zameen aur hawa dono ke liye bura; behtar hai mulch compost ya happy seeder se agli fasal bone. Is se organic matter aur nami bachti hai.

text: procurement center kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Procurement center woh jagah hai jahan sarkar (maslan food department) kisan se fasal (gandum chawal) support price par khareedti hai. Sarkar dana store aur taqseem ke liye khareedti hai. Center ki list agriculture ya food department deti hai; kisan dana le kar aate hain, tarazu aur test hota hai, policy ke mutabiq payment. Is se pakka bazar aur fix rate milta hai. Documents aur quality standard poore karne hote hain.

text: threshold kya hai jab spray karna zaroori ho
label: term_explanation
answer: Threshold woh hadd ya number hai jahan pest itna ho gaya ke aapko action (maslan spray) karna zaroori ho. Threshold se neeche nuqsan kam hota hai aur spray ki zarurat nahi. Maslan gandum mein chust ka threshold 5–10 per tiller ho sakta hai; itne dikhein to spray. Extension ya recommendation mein har pest crop ke liye threshold diya hota hai. Pehle spray karna paisa zaya aur faida mand keerey nuqsan; baad mein yield kam.

text: systemic fungicide kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Systemic fungicide woh dawai hai jo paude ke andar chali jati hai aur sap ke sath move karti hai. Is liye sirf jahan spray kiya wahan nahi balke naye patte aur baad ki growth bhi bachti hai. Zang blight jaisi bimariyon ke liye use hoti hai jahan fungus patte ke andar hota hai. Patton par chhidkate hain; chemical andar jata hai aur kuch din bimari control karta hai. Contact fungicide sirf surface par rehta hai. Zang jaisi bimari ke liye aksar systemic recommend hoti hai.

text: seed treatment kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed treatment ka matlab bone se pehle beej par chemical (fungicide ya insecticide) lagana. Beej chemical ke sath milaya jata hai ya solution mein dip kiya jata hai taake coat ho jaye. Is se beej aur chhote paude ko beej se aane wali bimari (smut bunt) aur kuch mitti ke keeron se bachaya jata hai. Bone se kuch din pehle karte hain; treatment ke baad beej shade mein sukha kar use karte hain. Certified beej aksar pehle se treated hota hai; apna beej ho to treatment zaroori hai.

text: basal dose matlab kya hai khaad ki
label: term_explanation
answer: Basal dose matlab woh khaad jo bone ke waqt ek dafa shuruat mein dali jati hai. Beej ke sath ya bone ke turant baad zameen mein ya upar dali jati hai. Aam tor par isme phosphorus (DAP SSP) hota hai aur kabhi nitrogen potash ka hissa. Basal dose chhote paude aur jaden ko barhne mein madad karti hai. Baqi nitrogen baad mein topdress. To basal = bone par pehli dose; topdress = baad ki doseein jab fasal barh rahi ho.

text: crown root stage kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Crown-root stage woh shuruat ki growth stage hai jab gandum jaisi fasal ke 2–3 patte nikle hon aur crown (neeche ka base) aur jaden ban rahi hon. Bone ke lagbhag 20–25 din baad aata hai. Pehla pani aksar isi stage par diya jata hai taake jaden gehraee jayein aur tillers ban saken. Pani zyada der ho to tillering kam ho sakti hai. Is liye crown-root stage pehle pani aur kabhi thori urea ka waqt hai.

text: grain filling stage kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Grain filling stage woh waqt hai jab fasal phool chuki hai aur dana (beej) banna aur bhar raha hai. Dana size aur weight mein barhta hai. Gandum ke liye phool ke baad; chawal ke liye panicle ke baad. Is stage par pani aur koi bada stress (garmi bimari) na ho. Grain filling par pani ya nutrition kami ho to yield aur test weight kam. Last pani aksar grain filling ke dauran diya jata hai.

text: pre emergence herbicide kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Pre-emergence herbicide woh weedicide hai jo jhariyan uggne se pehle chhidki jati hai. Bone ke turant baad (ya pehle) zameen par dali jati hai jab na fasal na jhariyan nikli hon. Chemical zameen mein rehta hai aur jhariyan jab uggen to unhe maarta hai. Is se jaldi control. Jab label par pre-emergence ho tab use karein; kaam ke liye zameen mein nami chahiye. Ye miss ho to baad mein post-emergence use karte hain.

text: post emergence herbicide kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Post-emergence herbicide woh weedicide hai jo tab chhidki jati hai jab fasal aur jhariyan dono ugg chuki hon. Jab jhariyan chhoti hon (maslan bone ke 25–35 din baad) tab spray. Product aisa hota hai ke jhariyan marein fasal na (selective). Dose aur stage sahi rakhein; jhariyan zyada badi hon to control kam. Post-emergence tab use karte hain jab pre use na kiya ho ya kaafi na ho.

text: tank mix kya hai chhidkai mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Tank mix ka matlab do ya zyada chemicals (maslan do pesticides ya pesticide aur khaad) ko ek hi spray tank mein mila kar ek sath chhidkana. Is se ek round bachta hai. Lekin sirf tab mix karein jab dono products ka label allow kare. Kuch mix se fasal nuqsan ya effect kam ho sakta hai. Label ya extension se puchen: ye urea is weedicide ke sath mix kar sakte hain? Pakka na ho to alag chhidkain. Ghalat tank mix se fasal jal sakti hai.

text: FYM gobar khaad kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: FYM ka matlab Farmyard Manure hai. Ye organic khaad gaay bhais ke gobar aur peshab ko straw ya fasal residue ke sath mila kar pit ya dher mein rakhte hain jab tak galay na ho jaye. Zameen ko organic matter aur kuch nutrients milte hain aur structure behtar hota hai. Kisan bone se pehle 2–4 ton per acre dalte hain, aksar chemical khaad ke sath. Ye poori chemical ki jagah nahi lekin sath use hota hai. Galay FYM taza gobar se behtar.

text: waterlogging kya hoti hai khet mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Waterlogging ka matlab khet mein pani zyada bhar jata hai aur zameen lambe waqt tak pani se bhari rehti hai. Jaden ko hawa nahi milti aur galti ho sakti hain; fasal zard ho kar mar sakti hai. Zyada barish ya zyada pani aur kam drainage se hota hai. Theek karne ke liye naaliyon ya pump se pani nikaalen. Bachne ke liye zyada pani na dein aur drainage behtar karein (level naaliyan). Neechi ya flat jagah mein aam masla hai.

text: drainage kya hai kheti mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Drainage ka matlab extra pani khet se bahar nikalne ka tareeqa. Achi drainage jab barish ya pani surface par nahi rukta; naaliyon dhal ya pipes se nikal jata hai. Kharab drainage mein pani rukta hai aur waterlogging. Behtar karne ke liye naaliyan banaen, zameen level karein taake pani beh jaye, kabhi pipes ya raised beds. Jaden sehatmand aur root rot lodging se bachne ke liye drainage zaroori hai.

text: resistant variety kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Resistant variety woh fasal ki qism hai jo kisi bimari ya keere se aasani se nahi lagti ya kam lagti hai. Maslan zang resistant gandum variety zang se kam ya bilkul bach jati hai. Scientists aisi varieties banate hain. Jab woh bimari ya keera aapke ilaqe mein aam ho to resistant variety len. Is se spray ki zarurat kam aur lagat bachti hai. Resistant ka matlab immune nahi; zyada pressure par thora infection ho sakta hai.

text: combine harvester kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Combine harvester (combine) woh machine hai jo teen kaam ek sath karti hai: fasal kaatna (reaping), dana alag karna (threshing), aur dana saaf karna. Ek pass mein fasal kaat kar aapko dana aur bhoosa mil jata hai. Gandum chawal makki waghaira ke liye. Mazdoori aur waqt bachta hai. Loss kam karne ke liye setting (drum speed) theek karni parti hai. Jab fasal bilkul pakki aur dana sakht ho tab use karte hain.

text: threshing ka matlab kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Threshing ka matlab dana bhoosa aur bhoosi se alag karna. Fasal kaatne ke baad bal ya panicle mein dana hota hai; threshing peetna ya ragarna hai taake dana nikal jaye. Haath se (chhari se), janwar se ya machine (thresher ya combine) se ho sakta hai. Threshing loss woh dana jo is dauran kho jata hai (tootna bhoose mein rehna). Loss kam karne ke liye dana pakka sukha hone par threshing karein aur machine setting sahi.

text: support price sarkari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Support price woh kam az kam rate hai jo sarkar fasal (gandum chawal) ke liye announce karti hai. Sarkar procurement centers par is rate se kisan se khareedegi. Jab bazar rate kam ho to kisan ko theek rate milta hai. Mausam se pehle announce hoti hai. Procurement center par bechne par quality mutabiq ye rate milta hai. Kuch mulkon mein ise minimum support price (MSP) bhi kehte hain.

text: forward contract bechne mein kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Forward contract ka matlab aap aur kharedar abhi fix rate par baad mein (maslan kaatai ke baad) fasal bechne ka agreement karte hain. Abhi rate aur miqdar fix; baad mein delivery. Faida ye ke aapko rate pata aur rate girne ka risk kam. Nuqsan ye ke rate barhe to zyada nahi milta. Kuch beopari mills use karte hain. Shartain (quality payment date) clear aur likhi honi chahiye. Kisan ke liye risk kam ho sakta hai.

text: stubble kya hoti hai khet mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Stubble woh neeche ka tana hai jo fasal kaatne ke baad khet mein khada reh jata hai. Maslan gandum ya chawal kaatne ke baad kaate hue tane jo zameen mein reh jate hain woh stubble. Ye residue ki ek qism hai. Zero tillage mein agli fasal bina stubble hatae bone; drill isi ke andar se guzarti hai. Stubble jalaana nuqsan deh; behtar chhorna ya happy seeder. Stubble zameen aur nami bachane mein madad karti hai.

text: mulch kya hota hai kheti mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Mulch woh layer hai jo zameen ki surface par failayi jati hai (maslan bhoosa patte plastic). Is se evaporation kam aur zameen zyada der nami mein rehti hai; jhariyan bhi kam hoti hain aur zameen thandi. Organic mulch (bhoosa residue) baad mein zameen mein mil jati hai aur organic matter banati hai. Sukhe ilaqe mein mulch pani bachati hai. Bone ke baad bhoosa mulch kar sakte hain. Plastic mulch kuch sabziyon mein. Mulch nami aur zameen ke liye acha.

text: micronutrient kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Micronutrient woh nutrient hai jo fasal ko N P K se kam miqdar mein chahiye. Maslan zinc iron boron sulphur manganese. In ke bina kami dikh sakti hai (zinc: patton pe safed lakeeren; boron: dana kam). Inhe chhoti dose mein dete hain: zameen mein ya foliar spray. Soil test bata sakta hai zameen mein kami. Sirf urea DAP bina micronutrient se jab zameen kami wali ho to paidawar limit ho sakti hai.

text: NPK kya hai khaad mein
label: term_explanation
answer: NPK matlab khaad mein teen ahem nutrients: N = Nitrogen, P = Phosphorus, K = Potash. Nitrogen hara growth aur yield; phosphorus jaden aur phool; potash dane ki quality aur mazbooti. Khaad ki bori par NPK ratio hota hai maslan 20-20-0 ya 46-0-0 (urea). Soil test batata hai kitna N P K dena. Basal mein aksar P K; N split mein. Balanced NPK sirf urea se behtar yield deti hai.

text: soil pH kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil pH woh number hai jo batata hai zameen tezabi (acidic) neutral ya alkaline hai. Scale 0–14: 7 neutral; 7 se neeche acidic; 7 se upar alkaline. Zyada tar faslen 6–7.5 pasand karti hain. pH zyada kam ya zyada zyada ho to nutrients kam milte aur fasal kam barhti. Lab mein pH test. Theek karne ke liye: acidic ho to chuna; alkaline ho to gypsum aur drainage. pH khaad aur fasal choice dono par asar.

text: saline zameen namak wali kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Saline zameen woh zameen hai jismein namak (sodium chloride waghaira) zyada ho. Sukhe ilaqe aur jahan pani namak wala ho wahan aam. Zyada namak jaden aur growth nuqsan; paude murjha sakte patte jal sakte. EC (electrical conductivity) se salinity naap sakte hain. Theek karne ke liye: acha pani drainage gypsum zarurat ho to namak sahne wali faslen (jau kuch gandum kapas). Saline zameen ko namak zameen bhi kehte hain.

text: crop rotation fasal badalna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop rotation ka matlab same khet mein alag alag mausam ya saal mein alag faslen ugaina. Maslan chawal ke baad gandum ya gandum ke baad makki. Is se pest aur bimari ka chakkar toot jata hai aur zameen ka istemal behtar; legume nitrogen bhi add karta hai. Wahi fasal bar bar (monocrop) bimari aur kam yield. Is liye rotation acha amal hai. Agli fasal pani mausam bazar ke hisaab se.

text: green manure kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Green manure woh fasal hai jo kaatne ke liye nahi balke kaat kar zameen mein milane ke liye ugayi jati hai. Mung mash sesbania jaisi dalen aam. Galne par nitrogen aur organic matter milta hai. 1–2 mahine ugate hain phir main fasal bone se 3–4 haftay pehle kaat kar jot mein milate hain. Zameen behtar hoti hai aur chemical N ki thori kami ho sakti hai. Purana aur mufeed amal hai.

text: scouting khet ki kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Scouting ka matlab khet mein regular ja kar fasal dekhna aur masle notice karna. Keera bimari jhari pani ki kami growth check karte hain. Is se jald pata chal jata hai kuch galat hai to waqt par ilaaj. Har 7–10 din ya masla ho to zyada. Jo dekhein note kar sakte hain. IPM ka pehla step. Bina scouting ke spray der ya zyada ho sakti hai.

text: booting stage gandum mein kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Booting stage woh waqt hai jab gandum ka pauda andar se bal bana chuka hai lekin abhi bahar nahi aaya. Tane ka upar wala hissa boot jaisa phula hota hai; jald bal niklega. Tillering ke baad aur phool se pehle. Pani aur kabhi doosri urea ke liye critical stage. Booting par pani ya nitrogen kami ho to danon ki tadad aur yield kam. Is liye booting par pani aur topdress zaroori hain.

text: broad leaf weed chauri jhari kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Broad leaf weed (chauri jhari) woh jhari hai jinke patte chaur hote hain jaise saag makkai ke patte. Ghaas se different; ghaas ki pattiyan patli hoti hain. Chauri jhariyon ke liye alag herbicide (maslan 2,4-D) use hota hai; ghaas wale alag. Dono ek saath sirf jab product allow kare. Pehchan kar sahi spray len; dose label par. Choti jhariyan hon to control acha.

text: grass weed ghaas wali jhari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Grass weed (ghaas wali jhari) woh jhari hai jo ghaas jaisi dikhti hai—patli lambi pattiyan. Chauri (broad leaf) se different. In ke liye grass-selective herbicide use hota hai (clodinafop waghaira). Wheat chawal mein ghaas jhari alag product se control. 25–35 din bone ke baad jab chhoti hon spray. Pehchan: patti patli nas parallel. Label par crop aur dose check karein.

text: seed borne disease beej se bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed borne disease matlab woh bimari jo beej ke zariye agli fasal tak jati hai. Smut bunt jaisi bimariyan beej ke andar ya surface par hoti hain. Bina treat beej boen to agli fasal mein bimari nikal aati hai. Bachne ke liye certified beej ya apne beej ko fungicide se treat karein. Bimari wali fasal ka beej reuse na karein. Seed treatment isi liye zaroori hai.

text: waiting period spray ke baad kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Waiting period woh din hain jo spray ke baad aur fasal kaatne ke beech zaroori hote hain. Pesticide label par likha hota hai maslan 7 din 14 din 21 din. Is period ke andar agar aap kaat lain to dana mein chemical ki remnant reh sakti hai jo khane wale ke liye nuqsan deh ho. Is liye label follow karein; itne din baad hi kaatain. Consumer safety ke liye zaroori hai.

text: calibration drill ki kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Calibration ka matlab machine (drill sprayer) ko set karna taake sahi miqdar nikale. Drill calibration: seed rate aur depth set karte hain; ek sheet par check karte hain kitna beej nikal raha; speed barabar. Sprayer: nozzle pressure height se flow check. Galat calibration se beej zyada kam ya spray ghalat ho sakta hai. Bone ya spray se pehle calibrate karein taake stand aur coverage theek ho.

text: herbicide rotation badal badal spray kyun
label: term_explanation
answer: Herbicide rotation ka matlab har mausam ya bar alag qism ka herbicide use karna. Agar wahi product bar bar use karein to jhariyan us ke khilaf resistant ho jati hain—phir woh spray kaam nahi karti. Alag mode of action wale products badal badal use karne se resistance kam hoti hai. Is liye rotation zaroori hai. Extension se puchen kaun sa product kis mausam; label par bhi rotation likha hota hai.

text: loose smut gandum ki bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Loose smut gandum ki woh bimari hai jismein bal (ear) ki jagah kaala powder (fungus ke spores) nikalta hai. Beej ke andar fungus rehta hai; jab fasal ugti hai to fungus bhi sath barhta hai aur phool ki jagah smut banta hai. Bachne ke liye certified beej ya beej ko fungicide se treat karein. Smut wali fasal ka beej kabhi reuse na karein. Seed treatment is bimari ko rokta hai.

text: rust zang bimari kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Rust (zang) woh bimari hai jismein patton ya tanon par powder jaisi pustulen (chotay dane) nikalte hain—peeli zang (stripe) kali zang (stem) patte pe (leaf). Fungus se hoti hai. Nami aur garmi mein failti hai. Pehli nishani par systemic fungicide chhidkain. Resistant variety agle saal. Teen qismen: leaf stripe stem; sab ke liye fungicide coverage achha rakhein.

text: basal khaad bone par kya dalte hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Basal khaad woh hai jo bone par ek sath dali jati hai—shuruat ki dose. Isme aam tor par DAP (P aur thora N) hota hai; kabhi potash bhi. Ye jaden aur shuruat ki growth ke liye. Baqi nitrogen baad mein topdress (tillering booting par). Basal = pehli dose bone par; topdress = baad ki. Soil test se total miqdar; us ka hissa basal hissa topdress.

text: critical stage pani kab zaroori hai matlab
label: term_explanation
answer: Critical stage ka matlab woh stage jahan fasal ko pani (ya khaad) na milne se yield zyada nuqsan hota hai. Gandum ke liye aam critical stages: crown-root tillering booting flowering grain filling. In par pani na chhoren. Agar pani kam ho to inhi stages par dein. Har fasal ke liye thora farq; extension ya recommendation mein list hoti hai. Critical par pani dene se paidawar bachti hai.

text: moisture level nami store ke liye kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Moisture level (nami) store ke liye woh percentage hai jitni nami tak dana sukha hona chahiye taake keerey fungus na lagain. Safe level aam 12–14% ya kam. Zyada nami (15–16%+) se keerey aur fungus. Dhoop mein patli layer sukha kar moisture meter ya weight se check kar sakte hain. Store se pehle sukha kar lain; store dry jagah. Nami theek ho to dana mahino tak safe rehta hai.

text: certified beej kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Certified beej woh beej hai jo sarkari ya authorized agency test karke certify karti hai—purity germination disease-free. Is se paidawar aur uniformity achi; bimari kam. Bazar se certified bag len; packet par certification likhi hoti hai. Apna beej bhi use kar sakte hain lekin treat karein; certified se risk thora kam hota hai. Har saal certified lena behtar amal hai.

text: drill sowing line bone kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Drill sowing (line bone) ka matlab beej ko machine (drill) se khadon mein ek line mein dalna. Faasla aur gehrayi barabar hoti hai; stand uniform. Broadcast se kam beej lagta hai aur jhariyan control asaan. Zyada tar faslon ke liye recommend. Drill ki calibration karein taake seed rate depth theek. Line sowing paidawar ke liye behtar.

text: broadcast bone kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Broadcast bone ka matlab beej ko haath ya machine se khet par idhar udhar chirakna bina khadon ke. Line nahi hoti; beej har jagah girta hai. Is se beej zyada lagta hai aur stand ghana patla ho sakta hai. Drill (line) bone se kam behtar. Jahan drill na ho wahan broadcast karte hain. Uniformity kam; jhariyan aur kaatai thori mushkil. Line sowing recommend hai.

text: selective insecticide kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Selective insecticide woh dawai hai jo sirf kisi khas keera ko marta hai; doosre faida mand keerey (jo keeron ko khate hain) zyada bach jate hain. Broad spectrum insecticide sab keerey marta hai. Selective use se mahaul aur balance behtar; IPM mein prefer. Maslan chust ke liye selective; label par likha hota hai selective ya broad spectrum. Jab option ho selective len.

text: root rot jaden galti bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Root rot woh bimari hai jismein jaden galti brown ya kaali ho kar saad jati hain; pauda kamzor ho kar nikal jata hai ya mar jata hai. Fungus ya waterlogging se. Pani bhar jane se zyada hota hai. Bachav: drainage theek waterlogging na hone dein; resistant variety rotation; seed treatment. Pehchan: paude ukharte waqt jaden naqli dikhein. Root rot mein pani nikasi zaroori hai.

text: leaf blight patton pe daag bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Leaf blight woh bimari hai jismein patton par daag ya lakeeren (brown grey) ban jati hain; patta sookh sakta hai. Fungus se hoti hai. Gandum chawal dono mein. Pehli nishani par fungicide (triazole strobilurin) chhidkain; coverage achha. Resistant variety agli fasal. Septoria tan spot bhi leaf spot hi hain. Extension se product; do spray 10–14 din gap.

text: aphid chust keera kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Aphid (chust) chhota hara ya kaala keera hai jo patton ki nas aur bal ke niche chipka rehta hai; ras chusta hai. Patton pe chipchipa honeydew chhodta hai. Zyada hon to patte murjha jate growth kam. Threshold (maslan 5–10 per tiller) par insecticide chhidkain. Subah sham patton ke niche coverage. Natural enemies bhi inhe khate hain; is liye IPM mein threshold follow karein.

text: termite deewar keera khet mein kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Termite (deewar keera) chhota safed keera hai jo mitti mein rehta hai aur jaden taiz patte lakdi khata hai. Khet mein jaden kaat kar nuqsan karta hai. Bachav: bone se pehle soil insecticide ya seed treatment; pani nikasi theek; purani stubble hataen. Extension se termite product; jaden ke paas nuqsan dikhe to jald control. Waterlogging wali jagah zyada hota hai.

text: armyworm fasal ka keera kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Armyworm (army worm) larva hai jo patte kaat kar kha jata hai; raat ko zyada nikalta hai. Rang hara ya gora; badan par lakeeren. Zyada hon to puri fasal nuqsan. Pehchan kar recommended insecticide chhidkain; subah sham coverage. Nuqsan jald dikhe to control karein. Maize gandum dono mein aa sakta hai. Field clean rakhein; threshold par spray.

text: What is lodging when crop falls
label: term_explanation
answer: Lodging is when the crop (wheat, rice, etc.) falls or bends over instead of standing straight. It happens when stem is weak due to too much nitrogen, heavy rain, wind, or over irrigation. Once lodged, harvest is difficult and grain quality can drop. To reduce lodging use balanced nitrogen (not too much), choose lodging-resistant variety, and avoid excess water at grain filling. Lodging is also called 'girna' or 'lethna' in local language.

text: What is panicle in rice crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Panicle is the flower head of rice, sorghum, or similar crops. It is the branch at the top that holds the grains; in rice it is the part that emerges after booting and on which grains (spikelets) form. In wheat we say ear or spike; in rice we say panicle because it is more branched. Grain filling happens in the panicle. Good panicle size and number mean better yield; water and nitrogen at booting and flowering affect panicle.

text: What is DAS days after sowing
label: term_explanation
answer: DAS means Days After Sowing. It is the number of days counted from the day you sowed the crop. For example 25 DAS means 25 days after sowing. Recommendations often say 'spray at 25–35 DAS' or 'first irrigation at 20–25 DAS' so farmers know the right time without remembering exact dates. You count from sowing day; it is same for everyone regardless of calendar date. DAS helps in timing herbicide, irrigation and fertilizer.

text: What is SSP fertilizer
label: term_explanation
answer: SSP stands for Single Super Phosphate. It is a phosphorus fertilizer like DAP but it has only phosphorus (P) and some sulphur and calcium; it does not have nitrogen. It is used as basal dose at sowing when you want to add P without adding more N, or when soil needs sulphur. In Pakistan DAP is more common; SSP is an alternative. Per acre dose depends on soil test. SSP is sometimes cheaper where available.

text: What is contact fungicide
label: term_explanation
answer: Contact fungicide is a fungicide that stays on the surface of the leaf or seed and kills fungus only where it is applied. It does not enter the plant or move to new leaves. So you must spray well so that all infected parts are covered. It is used for some diseases; for rust and blight that spread inside the plant, systemic fungicide is often better. Contact fungicide needs good coverage; rain can wash it off so repeat may be needed.

text: What is beneficial insect
label: term_explanation
answer: Beneficial insect is an insect that helps the crop by eating pest insects or by pollinating. For example ladybird eats aphids; some wasps lay eggs in pest larvae. So they are friends of the farmer. When you spray broad-spectrum insecticide you kill these too; then pests can come back faster. In IPM we try to save beneficial insects by using selective spray and threshold. Keeping some weeds or flowering plants can attract beneficials.

text: What is Bt cotton
label: term_explanation
answer: Bt cotton is cotton that has a gene from a bacterium (Bacillus thuringiensis) put into it. This gene makes the plant produce a protein that kills bollworm larvae when they eat the leaf or boll. So Bt cotton needs less insecticide for bollworm. It does not kill other insects. Not all cotton is Bt; buy Bt seed if bollworm is a problem. Resistance to Bt can develop if same area grows Bt every year; follow recommendation.

text: What is bollworm in cotton
label: term_explanation
answer: Bollworm is the larva (caterpillar) of a moth that attacks cotton. It eats flowers and bolls (fruit) and bores inside; damaged bolls open badly or rot. It is a major pest of cotton. Control by Bt cotton or insecticide when larvae are small. Spray at recommended stage; once inside the boll it is hard to kill. Scout for eggs and small larvae; threshold-based spray saves cost. In non-Bt cotton several sprays may be needed.

text: What is laser leveling
label: term_explanation
answer: Laser leveling means leveling the field with a machine that uses a laser to guide a scraper or blade so the field surface becomes very even. Water then spreads evenly and there is no waterlogging in low spots or dry patches in high spots. It saves water and improves yield. It is done once; cost can be shared by hiring. Laser leveling is best before laying beds or before sowing; it helps in irrigation and drainage.

text: What is bed planting
label: term_explanation
answer: Bed planting means growing the crop on raised beds (long raised strips) with furrows (channels) between them. Water is given in the furrows so it goes to the roots with less waste. Beds improve aeration and drainage; less waterlogging. It is used in wheat, cotton, vegetables. You need a bed planter or bed former. Bed planting saves 20–30% water compared to flood irrigation and often gives better yield.

text: What is furrow irrigation
label: term_explanation
answer: Furrow irrigation means applying water in small channels (furrows) between the crop rows. Water runs along the furrow and seeps into the soil to the roots. It uses less water than flooding the whole field. The field must be leveled and rows made. It is common in maize, cotton, sugarcane. Furrow irrigation is better than flood where water is scarce; it reduces runoff and evaporation compared to flood.

text: What is evaporation in field
label: term_explanation
answer: Evaporation is when water turns from liquid to vapour and goes into the air. From the field, water evaporates from the soil surface and from the leaves (transpiration). In hot and windy weather evaporation is high so soil dries fast and you may need more irrigation. Mulch (straw on soil) reduces evaporation. Saving water means reducing evaporation and runoff; drip and furrow lose less to evaporation than flood.

text: What is EC electrical conductivity in soil
label: term_explanation
answer: EC means Electrical Conductivity. It is a measure of how much salt is in the soil or water. High EC means more salt (saline soil or brackish water). Salt harms roots and growth. EC is measured with a meter; units are dS/m or mS/cm. For most crops EC should be low; if high, improve drainage, use good water, add gypsum if needed. Soil test report often gives EC; it helps decide crop and irrigation water.

text: What is organic matter in soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Organic matter is the part of soil that comes from dead plants and animals: roots, leaves, dung, compost. It is not mineral; it is carbon-based. Organic matter makes soil soft, holds water and nutrients, and feeds soil organisms. More organic matter means better soil and better crop. Adding FYM, compost, green manure or residue increases organic matter. Burning residue or too much tillage reduces it. Good soil has 2–5% or more organic matter.

text: What is legume crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Legume is a type of crop whose roots have nodules with bacteria (rhizobium) that fix nitrogen from the air into the soil. So legume adds nitrogen without fertilizer. Examples: mung, mash, chana, lentil, groundnut, alfalfa. After legume the next crop gets some free N. Legumes are used as grain, pulse, fodder or green manure. Rotating with legume improves soil and reduces need for urea in the next crop.

text: What is nitrogen fixation
label: term_explanation
answer: Nitrogen fixation is when nitrogen gas from the air is converted into a form plants can use (ammonia, then nitrate). In farming it is done by rhizobium bacteria in legume roots; the plant gives them food and gets nitrogen. So legume crop 'fixes' nitrogen without fertilizer. Some blue-green algae also fix nitrogen in rice field. Chemical fertilizer (urea) is another source of N but not called fixation. Rotation with legume uses natural nitrogen fixation.

text: What is intercrop or intercropping
label: term_explanation
answer: Intercropping means growing two or more crops in the same field at the same time, usually in alternate rows or strips. For example maize with bean, or wheat with mustard. It uses space and light better; sometimes one crop helps the other (e.g. legume adds N). Planning is needed for spacing, harvest time and spray. Intercropping can give more total yield and reduce risk. It is different from rotation where one crop follows another in time.

text: What is sowing window
label: term_explanation
answer: Sowing window is the period of days or weeks when it is best to sow a crop. For example wheat sowing window in Punjab may be late October to mid November. Outside this window (too early or too late) yield can drop. The window depends on variety, region and weather. Extension and recommendation give the window for each crop. Sowing within the window is important for good yield; late sowing often needs higher seed rate and gives less yield.

text: What is seed rate meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed rate is the amount of seed used per unit area, usually per acre or per hectare. For example wheat seed rate may be 40–50 kg per acre. It is chosen so that after germination you get the right plant population—not too few (low yield) and not too many (competition, lodging). Seed rate depends on crop, variety, sowing time and method. Late sowing often needs slightly higher seed rate. Recommendation gives the range for your crop.

text: What is germination
label: term_explanation
answer: Germination is when the seed wakes up and starts to grow: the root (radicle) and shoot (plumule) come out of the seed. For germination the seed needs water, right temperature and air. Good seed germinates in a few days; poor or old seed may not germinate or germinate late. Germination percentage is how many seeds out of 100 grow; certified seed has high germination. If germination is poor in field, check seed quality, depth and moisture.

text: What is seedling stage
label: term_explanation
answer: Seedling stage is the early growth stage just after germination when the plant has only a few leaves and is still small. It is before tillering or branching. The plant is delicate; damage by pest, frost or waterlogging at this stage can reduce stand. First irrigation and weeding are often done when crop is at seedling or early growth. Good seedling stand is the base for good yield; protect from pests and stress.

text: What is maturity in crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Maturity is the stage when the crop is fully developed and ready for harvest. For grain crops it is when grain is hard and has reached its full size and weight; straw may turn yellow. Physiological maturity is when grain stops filling; harvest maturity is when it is dry enough to cut and store. Harvesting too early (before maturity) gives less yield; too late may cause shattering and loss. Each crop has signs of maturity (e.g. grain hard, moisture down).

text: What is shattering in harvest
label: term_explanation
answer: Shattering is when ripe grain falls from the ear or panicle before or during harvest. It happens when harvest is too late, or in wind and rain, or in some varieties that shatter easily. Shattering causes loss of yield. To reduce it harvest at right time when grain is hard but not over-dry; use combine with correct setting; avoid delay and strong wind. Some varieties are more shatter-resistant; choose them where shattering is common.

text: What is drought tolerant variety
label: term_explanation
answer: Drought tolerant variety is a variety that can give reasonable yield even when water is less or there are dry spells. It may have deeper roots or better water use. Such varieties are used in rainfed or low-irrigation areas. Government and research stations release drought tolerant varieties for different crops (wheat, maize, sorghum). They are not magic—under severe drought yield still drops—but they suffer less than normal varieties. Ask extension for list for your area.

text: What is heat stress in crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Heat stress is when high temperature harms the crop. At flowering and grain filling, too much heat can reduce grain number and size. Leaves may burn; pollen may not work. In Pakistan terminal heat (late season heat) often affects wheat. To reduce impact sow at right time so flowering and grain fill are not in peak heat; give last irrigation on time; use heat-tolerant variety if available. Shade and water help in nursery or vegetables.

text: What is pesticide meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Pesticide is a general word for any chemical used to kill or control pests: insects (insecticide), fungus (fungicide), weeds (herbicide), rats (rodenticide), etc. So insecticide and fungicide are types of pesticide. Pesticide is sprayed or applied as per label; wrong use can harm crop, health and environment. Always use recommended dose and wear protection. IPM reduces need for pesticide by using other methods first.

text: What is dose in spray
label: term_explanation
answer: Dose is the amount of chemical (fertilizer or pesticide) to use per unit area (per acre, per litre of water) or per unit (per kg seed). For example 'urea dose 50 kg per acre' or 'spray dose 2 ml per litre'. The right dose is on the product label; too little may not work, too much wastes money and can damage crop or cause residue in grain. Measure dose carefully; do not guess. Dose is also called 'miqdar' or 'dawa ki amount'.

text: What is spray drift
label: term_explanation
answer: Spray drift is when spray droplets are carried by wind away from the target area to another field, crop or place. So the chemical goes where you did not want it and can damage other crops, water or people. To reduce drift use correct nozzle (e.g. flat fan), low pressure, spray when wind is calm (morning or evening), and keep the sprayer close to the crop. Do not spray in strong wind. Drift can also waste your chemical.

text: What is nozzle in sprayer
label: term_explanation
answer: Nozzle is the small tip at the end of the sprayer pipe where the liquid comes out as droplets. Nozzle type and size decide droplet size and pattern (e.g. flat fan, cone). Wrong nozzle can give too fine droplets (more drift) or too coarse (poor coverage). Pressure also affects spray. For most field sprays flat fan nozzle is used; pressure 2–3 bar. Nozzles wear out; change when flow increases. Clean nozzle after use.

text: What is weighbridge
label: term_explanation
answer: Weighbridge is a large scale on which a truck or trolley full of grain can be weighed. When you sell grain, the buyer weighs the loaded vehicle on weighbridge, then after unloading the empty vehicle is weighed again; the difference is the weight of your grain. So weighbridge tells how many kg or maund you sold. Check that the weighbridge is correct; keep the weight slip. Some cheating can happen so verify if possible.

text: What is grading in grain
label: term_explanation
answer: Grading is sorting grain by quality: size, colour, purity, test weight. Grade A may be clean, bold, high test weight; lower grades have more broken grain, dirt or small grain. Better grade gets better price. Grading is done by hand or machine at home or at mandi. Before selling, clean and grade your grain to get better rate. Government procurement often has minimum grade; reject if below standard.

text: What is happy seeder
label: term_explanation
answer: Happy seeder is a machine that sows the next crop (e.g. wheat) directly into the standing stubble and residue of the previous crop (e.g. rice) without burning or removing the residue. It cuts a slot, places seed and fertilizer, and covers. So it combines zero tillage with residue retention. It saves time, saves moisture and improves soil. It is used for wheat after rice in Punjab and elsewhere. You need to set it for seed rate and depth.

text: What is ploughing
label: term_explanation
answer: Ploughing (jot) is turning the soil with a plough so that the top layer goes down and the lower layer comes up. It breaks hard soil, buries weeds and residue, and prepares for sowing. Usually done 1–2 times before sowing. Deep ploughing once a year can help in hard soil. Too much ploughing can harm soil structure. Plough when soil is not too wet; then harrow and level.

text: What is harrowing
label: term_explanation
answer: Harrowing (sulah) is breaking the ploughed soil into smaller pieces and leveling the surface with a harrow. Harrow has discs or tines that cut the clods. It is done after ploughing, 2–3 times often. Harrowing makes the seedbed fine so seed can be placed well and germination is good. It also helps mix residue and level the field. Do not harrow when soil is too wet or too dry.

text: What is minimum tillage
label: term_explanation
answer: Minimum tillage means reducing the number of tillage operations (ploughing, harrowing). Instead of 2–3 ploughing and 2–3 harrowing, you do one pass or use a cultivator. It saves cost, time and fuel; it also keeps soil structure and moisture. Zero tillage is the least tillage (no plough). Minimum tillage is between full tillage and zero till. It is used in conservation agriculture; need suitable drill or equipment.

text: What is fertigation
label: term_explanation
answer: Fertigation means applying fertilizer through irrigation water. Soluble fertilizer (e.g. urea, some NPK) is dissolved in water and the water is given to the crop through drip or sprinkler. So crop gets water and nutrient together. It is used in drip-irrigated crops (vegetables, orchards). It allows small frequent doses and efficient use. Not all fertilizers are suitable for fertigation; use soluble ones and avoid clogging the system.

text: What is soil test for
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil test is when you take a sample of soil from your field and send it to a lab to find out what nutrients are in the soil (N, P, K, pH, organic matter, micronutrients). The lab gives a report and often a recommendation for how much fertilizer to use. So you add only what is needed and do not waste money. Soil test every 2–3 years or when starting on a new field. Extension or dealer can tell you how to take sample and where to send.

text: What is hybrid variety
label: term_explanation
answer: Hybrid variety is a variety made by crossing two different parent lines; the first-generation (F1) seed is the hybrid. It often has higher yield or vigour than open-pollinated varieties. But you cannot save seed from hybrid for next year because the next generation is not uniform. So you have to buy new hybrid seed each time. Maize, rice, vegetables often use hybrids. Hybrid seed is costlier but can give more yield.

text: What is sowing depth
label: term_explanation
answer: Sowing depth is how deep the seed is placed in the soil, usually in cm. Too shallow and seed may not get moisture or may be eaten; too deep and germination is delayed or weak. For most crops 3–5 cm is common. Small seed is sown shallower. Depth depends on soil moisture and type. Drill calibration sets the depth; check that it is even across the field. Right depth gives good and uniform germination.

text: What is weed pressure
label: term_explanation
answer: Weed pressure means how many weeds are in the field and how much they are competing with the crop. High weed pressure means many weeds; they take light, water and nutrients and reduce yield. Low pressure means fewer weeds. Control weeds when they are small (25–35 DAS) before pressure gets high. Herbicide, hand weeding and clean seed reduce weed pressure. Same field with same weeds every year can build up pressure; rotate and use clean practices.

text: What is infestation meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Infestation means a large number of pest (insects or disease) in the field or on the crop. For example 'aphid infestation' means too many aphids. When infestation is high, damage and loss are high. Scout to see infestation level; if it is above threshold, take action (spray). Early control prevents heavy infestation. Field sanitation and resistant variety reduce chance of infestation. The word is used for both insects and disease.

text: lodging kya hota hai fasal gir jati hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Lodging woh waqt hai jab fasal (gandum chawal) sidhi khari ki jagah gir jati hai ya jhuk jati hai. Zyada nitrogen bhari barish hawa ya zyada pani se tana kamzor ho kar hota hai. Girne ke baad kaatai mushkil aur dane ki quality kam. Lodging kam karne ke liye nitrogen balance karein (zyada na) lodging resistant variety len aur grain filling par zyada pani na dein. Is ko girmna ya lethna bhi kehte hain.

text: panicle kya hoti hai chawal mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Panicle chawal jwar jaisi fasal ka phool ka upar wala hissa hai. Wo shaakh jo upar hoti hai jis par danay lagte hain; chawal mein booting ke baad jo nikalti hai us par spikelets bante hain. Gandum mein ear ya spike kehte hain; chawal mein panicle kyunke zyada shaakhi. Grain filling panicle mein hoti hai. Achi panicle size aur tadad behtar yield; booting aur phool par pani nitrogen asar karte hain.

text: DAS matlab kya bone ke kitne din baad
label: term_explanation
answer: DAS ka matlab Days After Sowing hai—bone ke din se ginne wale din. Maslan 25 DAS matlab bone ke 25 din baad. Recommendation mein aksar '25–35 DAS par chhidkain' ya '20–25 DAS pehla pani' is liye ke kisan ko sahi waqt pata ho. Bone wale din se ginte hain; calendar date se farq nahi. Herbicide pani khaad ka waqt DAS se fix hota hai.

text: SSP khaad kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: SSP ka matlab Single Super Phosphate. Ye DAP jaisa phosphorus khaad hai lekin isme sirf P aur thori sulphur calcium; nitrogen nahi. Jab P chahiye zyada N ke bina ya zameen ko sulphur chahiye tab basal dose ke tor par use karte hain. Pakistan mein DAP zyada; SSP alternative. Per acre dose soil test par. Kabhi SSP sasti milti hai.

text: contact fungicide kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Contact fungicide woh fungicide hai jo patte ya beej ki surface par rehti hai aur fungus sirf jahan laga wahan marti hai. Paude ke andar nahi jati. Is liye achhi coverage chahiye. Kuch bimariyon ke liye; zang blight ke liye jo andar failti hai systemic zyada behtar. Contact ko coverage achha chahiye; barish dho sakti hai to repeat.

text: faida mand keera beneficial insect kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Faida mand keera (beneficial insect) woh keera hai jo pest keeron ko kha kar ya pollination karke fasal ki madad karta hai. Maslan ladybird chust khati hai; kuch wasp pest larvae mein ande dete hain. Broad spectrum spray se ye bhi mar jate hain; phir pest jaldi wapas. IPM mein selective spray aur threshold se inhe bachate hain. Kuch jhariyan phool inhe kheenchti hain.

text: Bt kapas kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Bt kapas woh kapas hai jismein ek bacterium (Bacillus thuringiensis) ka gene daala gaya hota hai. Ye gene paude ko aisa protein banata hai jo bollworm larvae ko kha kar maarta hai. Is liye Bt kapas par bollworm ke liye kam insecticide. Doosre keeron ko nahi marta. Saari kapas Bt nahi; bollworm ho to Bt beej len. Bar bar Bt ugayne se resistance ho sakti hai; recommendation follow karein.

text: bollworm kapas ka keera kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Bollworm kapas ke boll (phal) aur phool ko khaane wala larva (caterpillar) hai. Andar ghus kar nuqsan karta hai; boll kharab khulte hain. Kapas ka bara pest. Bt kapas ya insecticide chhote larvae par. Recommend stage par chhidkain; andar ghusne ke baad marna mushkil. Ande chhote larvae scout; threshold spray lagat bachati hai.

text: laser leveler se kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Laser leveler ek machine hai jo laser se guide karke zameen ko itna barabar karti hai ke pani har jagah barabar phail jata hai. Neechi jagah pani bhar nahi upar sukhi nahi. Pani bachta yield behtar. Ek dafa karte hain; rent se hissa. Beds ya bone se pehle behtar. Irrigation drainage dono ke liye faida.

text: bed planting kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Bed planting matlab pauday unchaee par banayi hui pattiyon (beds) par ugaye jate hain; beech mein khadde (furrows). Pani khadon mein de kar jaden tak jata hai kam zaya. Beds hawa aur drainage behtar. Gandum kapas sabziyon mein. Bed planter chahiye. Flood se 20–30% pani bachta hai; yield bhi acha.

text: furrow irrigation kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Furrow irrigation matlab paudon ki lineon ke beech chhoti naaliyon (furrows) mein pani dena. Pani furrow mein beh kar zameen mein jaden tak. Puri khet bharne se kam pani. Zameen level khadde banane. Makki kapas ganne mein aam. Pani kam ho to flood se behtar; behav aur evaporation kam.

text: evaporation kya hoti hai khet mein
label: term_explanation
answer: Evaporation woh hota hai jab pani bhaap ban kar hawa mein chala jata hai. Khet se zameen aur patton se pani ugalta hai (transpiration). Garm tundi hawa mein zyada; zameen jaldi sukhti hai. Mulch (bhoosa) evaporation kam karti hai. Pani bachane ka matlab evaporation aur runoff kam; drip furrow flood se kam evaporation.

text: EC electrical conductivity zameen ki kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: EC ka matlab Electrical Conductivity—zameen ya pani mein kitna namak hai uska naap. Zyada EC matlab zyada namak (saline zameen kharab pani). Namak jaden aur growth nuqsan. EC meter se naapte hain; unit dS/m. Zyada tar faslen kam EC chahiye; zyada ho to drainage acha pani gypsum. Soil test report mein EC; crop aur pani decide karne mein madad.

text: organic matter zameen mein kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Organic matter zameen ka woh hissa jo murde paudon janwaron se aata hai: jaden patte gobar compost. Mineral nahi carbon base. Zameen narm pani nutrients pakadti hai; soil organisms ko khana. Zyada organic matter behtar zameen. FYM compost green manure residue se barhti hai. Residue jalaana zyada jot kam karti hai. Achi zameen mein 2–5% ya zyada.

text: legume fasal kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Legume woh fasal hai jis ki jaden mein rhizobium bacteria wale nodules hote hain jo hawa se nitrogen fix karte hain. Is liye legume beej bina nitrogen add karti hai. Mung mash chana masoor moonghi alfalfa. Legume ke baad agli fasal ko free N. Legume grain pulse charay green manure. Legume rotation zameen behtar aur agli fasal ko urea kam.

text: nitrogen fixation kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Nitrogen fixation ka matlab hawa ki nitrogen gas ko paudon ke istemal wale form (ammonia phir nitrate) mein badalna. Kheti mein legume ki jaden mein rhizobium karta hai; pauda unhe khana deta nitrogen leta. To legume 'fix' karti hai bina khaad. Chemical urea bhi N ka source lekin use fixation nahi kehte. Legume rotation natural nitrogen fixation.

text: intercropping kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Intercropping ka matlab do ya zyada faslen same khet mein same waqt alag lineon ya strips mein ugaina. Maslan makki lobia sath ya gandum sarson. Jagah roshni behtar; kabhi ek dusri ki madad (legume N). Spacing kaatai spray ka plan. Total yield zyada risk kam. Rotation se farq—rotation mein waqt se ek ke baad ek.

text: sowing window bone ka waqt kya matlab
label: term_explanation
answer: Sowing window woh muddat hai jis mein fasal bone behtar hoti hai. Maslan Punjab mein gandum late Oct–mid Nov. Is ke bahar (jaldi ya der) yield kam. Variety ilaqa mausam par. Extension recommendation har fasal ki window dete hain. Window ke andar bone paidawar ke liye zaroori; der bone seed zyada yield kam.

text: seed rate matlab kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed rate matlab ek unit area (per acre) par kitna beej use kiya. Maslan gandum 40–50 kg per acre. Is se germination ke baad sahi plant population—na kam na zyada. Crop variety bone waqt tareeqe par. Der bone thori zyada. Recommendation mein range.

text: germination ugalna kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Germination woh waqt hai jab beej jagta hai aur barhna shuru: jad (radicle) aur shoot (plumule) beej se bahar. Beej ko pani sahi garmi hawa chahiye. Acha beej kuch din mein; kharab purana late ya nahi. Germination percentage 100 mein kitne ugen; certified high. Field mein kam ho to beej quality gehrayi nami check karein.

text: seedling stage kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seedling stage germination ke turant baad woh stage jab paude mein kuch hi patte chhota. Tillering branching se pehle. Pauda nazuk; is stage par pest sardi waterlogging nuqsan. Pehla pani jhariyan aksar seedling par. Acha seedling stand yield ki buniyad; pest stress se bachayein.

text: maturity puknai kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Maturity woh stage jab fasal mukammal tayar kaatai ke liye. Grain faslon ke liye jab dana sakht full size weight; bhoosa zard. Physiological maturity jab dana bharna band; harvest maturity jab kaat kar store karne layak. Jaldi kaatne se yield kam; der se tootna. Har fasal ki nishaniyan (dana sakht nami kam).

text: shattering dana tootna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Shattering ka matlab pakka dana bal ya panicle se kaatne se pehle ya dauran gir jata hai. Der kaatai hawa barish ya aisi variety jismein aasaan. Yield ka nuqsan. Kam karne ke liye sahi waqt par kaatain dana sakht lekin zyada sukha na; combine setting; der tundi hawa avoid. Kuch varieties shatter resistant.

text: drought tolerant variety sukha sahne wali kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Drought tolerant variety woh variety jo kam pani ya sukhe dauron mein bhi theek yield de sakti hai. Gehri jaden ya behtar pani use. Barani kam pani wale ilaqe. Sarkar research station sukha sahne wali varieties nikalte hain. Sakht sukhe mein phir bhi yield kam lekin normal se kam nuqsan. Apne ilaqe ki list extension se.

text: heat stress garmi se nuqsan kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Heat stress ka matlab garmi se fasal nuqsan. Phool aur grain filling par zyada garmi danon ki tadad size kam. Patton jal sakte. Pakistan mein terminal heat gandum par. Kam karne ke liye sahi waqt bone taake phool grain fill peak garmi mein na; last pani waqt par; heat tolerant variety. Nursery sabziyon mein chaan pani.

text: pesticide dawai kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Pesticide aam lafz hai keera bimari jhariyan ko marne rokne wali chemical ka: insecticide fungicide herbicide rodenticide. To insecticide fungicide pesticide ki qismein. Label mutabiq chhidkain; ghalat use nuqsan. Dose protection. IPM se pesticide ki zarurat kam.

text: dose chhidkai mein matlab kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Dose matlab chemical (khaad ya pesticide) ki miqdar per unit area (per acre per litre pani) ya per unit (per kg beej). Maslan 'urea 50 kg per acre' ya '2 ml per litre'. Sahi dose product label par; kam kaam na zyada zaya nuqsan. Theek napein. Miqdar dawa ki amount.

text: spray drift chhidkai udna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Spray drift ka matlab chhidkai ki boonden hawa ke sath target se ud kar doosri jagah chali jati hain. Chemical jahan nahi chahiye wahan nuqsan. Kam karne ke liye sahi nozzle kam pressure hawa calm (subah sham) sprayer paude ke kareeb. Tundi hawa mein na chhidkain. Drift se chemical bhi zaya.

text: nozzle sprayer ki kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Nozzle sprayer ki pipe ke aakhir mein woh nok jahan se pani boondon mein nikalta hai. Nozzle type size droplet size pattern (flat fan cone). Ghalat nozzle zyada bareek (drift) ya zyada mota (coverage kam). Pressure bhi asar. Field spray ke liye flat fan 2–3 bar. Nozzle ghis jati hai; flow barhe to badlein. Baad saaf.

text: weighbridge tarazu kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Weighbridge woh bari tarazu hai jis par bhari gari trolley ka weight hota hai. Bechte waqt bhari gari ka weight phir khali ka; farq aapke dane ka weight. Is se kg maund pata. Tarazu sahi ho slip rakhein. Verify karwa sakte hain.

text: grading dane ki kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Grading dane ko quality se alag karna: size colour purity test weight. Grade A saaf mote zyada test weight; neeche grade toota ganda chhota. Behtar grade zyada rate. Haath ya machine ghar ya mandi. Bechne se pehle saaf grade karein. Sarkari khareed minimum grade; neeche reject.

text: happy seeder kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Happy seeder woh machine hai jo agli fasal (gandum) ko purani fasal (chawal) ki khari stubble residue mein bina jalae bina hatae direct booti hai. Slot kaat kar beej khaad dalti hai. Zero tillage aur residue dono. Waqt nami zameen bachti hai. Chawal ke baad gandum Punjab waghaira. Seed rate depth set karein.

text: jot ploughing kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Jot (ploughing) zameen ko halka kar ke upar wali layer neeche neeche wali upar lana. Sakht zameen jhariyan residue daba deti hai. Bone se pehle 1–2 dafa. Gehraee ki jot saal mein ek dafa. Zyada jot nuqsan. Gili zameen par na; phir sulah level.

text: sulah harrowing kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Sulah (harrowing) jot ki hui zameen ko chhote hisson mein tor kar barabar karna. Harrow mein disc ya tine. Jot ke baad 2–3 dafa. Seedbed fine taake beej achha uggay. Residue mix level. Zyada gili ya zyada sukhi par na karein.

text: minimum tillage kam jot kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Minimum tillage matlab jot (ploughing harrowing) kam karna. 2–3 jot 2–3 sulah ki jagah ek pass ya cultivator. Lagat waqt diesel bachta; zameen structure nami. Zero till sab se kam. Full aur zero ke beech. Conservation agriculture; suitable drill.

text: fertigation pani ke sath khaad kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Fertigation ka matlab pani ke zariye khaad dena. Soluble khaad (urea kuch NPK) pani mein ghula kar drip ya sprinkler se fasal ko. Pani aur nutrient sath. Drip wali faslon (sabziyan bagh) mein. Chhoti bar bar dose. Har khaad fertigation ke liye nahi; soluble use system band na ho.

text: zameen ka test soil test kyun karein
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil test ka matlab khet se zameen ka sample le kar lab bhejna taake pata chale zameen mein kya nutrients hain (N P K pH organic matter micronutrient). Report aur aksar recommendation kitni khaad. Sirf zarurat jitni; paisa zaya nahi. Har 2–3 saal ya naye khet par. Sample kaise len kahan bhejen extension dealer.

text: hybrid variety kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Hybrid variety do alag parent lines cross karke banayi hoti hai; pehli generation (F1) ka beej hybrid. Yield ya vigour zyada. Lekin hybrid ka beej agle saal bachaya nahi ja sakta kyunke next generation uniform nahi. Har bar naya hybrid beej. Makki chawal sabziyan. Hybrid mehenga lekin zyada yield.

text: sowing depth beej ki gehrayi kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Sowing depth beej zameen mein kitni gehraee par dala—cm mein. Zyada unchai par nami nahi khana; zyada gehraee par germination der kamzor. Zyada tar 3–5 cm. Chhota beej kam gehraee. Nami zameen par. Drill calibration depth set; khet mein barabar. Sahi depth germination.

text: weed pressure jhariyon ka zor kya matlab
label: term_explanation
answer: Weed pressure matlab khet mein kitni jhariyan hain aur fasal se kitni compete. Zyada pressure matlab zyada jhariyan; roshni pani khuraak; yield kam. Chhoti jhariyan 25–35 DAS control; pressure barhne se pehle. Herbicide haath saaf beej. Same jhariyan bar bar pressure barha sakti hai; rotation saaf amal.

text: infestation keera bimari ka zor kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Infestation ka matlab pest (keera ya bimari) ki zyada tadad khet ya fasal par. Maslan 'chust infestation' matlab bahut chust. Infestation zyada ho to nuqsan zyada. Scout karein threshold se upar ho to action (spray). Jaldi control bhari infestation rokta hai. Saaf resistant variety.

text: spray interval do chhidkaiyon ke beech gap kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Spray interval matlab do chhidkaiyon ke beech kitne din ka farq. Fungicide insecticide label par likha hota hai maslan 10–14 din. Is interval se bimari keera control rehta hai aur resistance kam. Interval chhota matlab zyada chhidkaina; bara matlab beech mein nuqsan. Recommendation follow karein.

text: mode of action dawai kaise kaam karti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Mode of action matlab dawai andar kaise kaam karti hai—kaun sa enzyme ya system target karti hai. Alag chemicals ka alag mode; is liye rotation zaroori—wahi bar bar use se pest resistant. Label par mode of action group likha hota hai. Rotation mein alag group ki dawai use karein taake resistance na ho.

text: mandi kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Mandi woh jagah hai jahan kisan apni fasal (gandum chawal kapas) bechte hain. Beopari ya mills khareedte hain; rate roz badalta hai. Mandi mein weighbridge grading rate hota hai. Rate check karne ke liye mandi office SMS app. Do teen mandi compare karein. Mandi ko bazar bhi kehte hain.

text: Kisan card kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Kisan card sarkari card hai jisse kisan ki pehchan hoti hai aur is se karz subsidy insurance scheme judte hain. Bank ya agri office se banwate hain. Documents zameen CNIC. Card se loan scheme mein aasani; subsidy direct. List aur form agri office bank.

text: seed viability beej ki umr kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed viability matlab beej kitne din tak ugalne ki taqat rakhta hai. Purana beej kam viable; germination kam ya nil. Certified beej par expiry ya test date. Beej ko sukhi thandi jagah rakhein taake viability bani rahe. 1–2 saal ke baad test karwa len; kam ho to naya beej.

text: ratoon ratoonni kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Ratoon (ratoonni) matlab fasal kaatne ke baad same jaden se dubara shoot nikalna aur doosri fasal leni. Ganna mein aam: pehli kaatai ke baad ratoon crop bina nayi planting. 1–2 ratoon le sakte hain. Waqt paisa bachta. Har fasal ratoon nahi deti; ganna bajra jaisi deti hain. Ratoon ko proper khaad pani.

text: dough stage dana bharne ka stage kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Dough stage woh stage hai jab dana bhar raha hai aur andar soft dough jaisa—abhi sakht nahi. Grain filling ke dauran; milk stage ke baad. Is stage par pani zaroori; kami se dana chhota. Physiological maturity tak dough hard hota hai. Kaatai dough stage ke baad jab grain sakht ho.

text: yield paidawar kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Yield (paidawar) matlab ek area (per acre per hectare) par kitna fasal (grain ya total) nikla. Zyada yield matlab zyada production. Variety khaad pani keera bimari jhari sab asar. Yield ko maund per acre ya kg per hectare mein naapte hain. Behtar amal se yield barhti hai.

text: Karnal bunt gandum ki bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Karnal bunt gandum ki woh bimari hai jismein danon par kaala daag aur badboo aati hai; andar ka hissa kala. Fungus se; beej se agli fasal. Certified beej seed treatment; bimari wala beej na use. Next crop safe beej. Nuqsan danon ki quality; ilaaj pehle se.

text: stripe rust peeli zang kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Stripe rust (peeli zang) gandum ki woh rust hai jo patton par peeli lakeeron (stripes) mein pustulen banati hai. Leaf rust bhi patte pe; stripe rust nas ke sath. Fungus nami garmi. Pehli nishani par systemic fungicide. Resistant variety. Teen rust: leaf stripe stem; peeli stripe.

text: stem borer tane ka keera kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Stem borer woh keera hai jo tane (stem) ke andar ghus kar khaata hai; pauda sookh ya toot jata hai. Chawal makki dono mein. Andar rehne se spray mushkil. Ande chhote larvae par insecticide; jald. Resistant variety field clean. Chawal mein dead heart white ear.

text: whitefly safed makhi kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Whitefly chhota safed par rang ka keera hai jo patton ke niche chipka rehta hai; ras chusta hai. Kapas sabziyon mein. Virus bhi phailata hai. Honeydew se patte chipchip. Threshold par insecticide; niche coverage. Yellow sticky trap bhi. Zyada garmi mein zyada.

text: bhoosa straw kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Bhoosa (straw) fasal kaatne ke baad bacha hua tana aur patta—jis par bal ya panicle tha. Gandum chawal ka bhoosa charay ke liye bikhrane mulch ya bechne ke kaam. Jalaen mat; residue management. Bhoosa se compost bale. Test weight grain ki; bhoosa alag.

text: vegetative stage patte barhne ka stage kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Vegetative stage woh stage jab pauda sirf patte aur tane bana raha hai—phool ya dana nahi. Tillering branching isi mein. Is stage par pani khaad se patte tane mazboot. Reproductive (phool dana) se pehle. Wheat mein vegetative tillering tak; phir booting flowering.

text: reproductive stage phool dana stage kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Reproductive stage woh stage jab fasal phool aur dana bana rahi hai. Flowering grain setting grain filling isi mein. Vegetative (sirf patte) ke baad. Is stage par pani khaad zaroori; nuqsan yield par. Booting heading flowering grain fill sab reproductive. Critical stages zyada tar isi mein.

text: split application khaad do dafa dena kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Split application ka matlab khaad (aam urea) ko ek dafa ki jagah 2–3 dafa dena. Maslan urea bone par thori tillering par doosri booting par. Is se nitrogen zyada absorb kam waste. Ek sath zyada dene se leaching loss. Topdress bhi split application hi. Recommendation mein split diya hota hai.

text: band placement khaad line mein dalna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Band placement ka matlab khaad ko khet mein line ya band mein dalna—sirf khadon ya jagah par—bina pure khet par chirakne ke. Seed ke paas band se efficiency behtar. Drill band bana kar dalta hai. Broadcast placement se band zyada efficient; khaad jaden ke kareeb. P K aksar band; N kabhi.

text: runoff pani behna kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Runoff ka matlab pani zameen soak na karke surface se beh kar bahar chala jata hai. Zyada pani tez barish slope se runoff. Is se pani zaya khad bhi beh sakti hai. Kam karne ke liye zameen level bund; pani thora thora; mulch. Runoff erosion bhi la sakta hai.

text: leaching khaad pani mein neeche chala jana kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Leaching ka matlab khaad (aam nitrogen) pani ke sath zameen mein neeche chala jata hai jahan jaden tak nahi. Gehri zameen barish zyada pani se. N ka nuqsan zyada. Kam karne ke liye split dose zyada pani na; drip se control. Leaching se groundwater bhi affect; is liye balance zaroori.

text: What is Septoria or tan spot in wheat
label: term_explanation
answer: Septoria and tan spot are two leaf spot diseases of wheat caused by fungus. Brown or tan spots and blotches appear on leaves; leaves can dry and die. They spread in wet weather. Control with fungicide when first spots appear; good coverage. Resistant variety and crop rotation help. Septoria is also called leaf blotch; tan spot has lens-shaped tan spots. Both reduce yield if not controlled.

text: What is powdery mildew
label: term_explanation
answer: Powdery mildew is a fungal disease where white or grey powder-like growth appears on leaves and stems. It looks like flour dust. It grows in humid weather. It weakens the plant and can reduce yield. Control with sulphur or triazole fungicide when you see the powder. Resistant variety helps. Keep crop not too dense; good air flow reduces mildew. Common in wheat and many crops.

text: What is ear or spike in wheat
label: term_explanation
answer: Ear (or spike in wheat) is the top part of the wheat plant that holds the grains. It is the head that comes out after booting; each small part (spikelet) can produce grains. In wheat we say ear or spike; in rice we say panicle. Grain filling happens in the ear. Number and size of ears affect yield. Good nitrogen and water at booting and flowering give more and bigger ears.

text: What is heading stage
label: term_explanation
answer: Heading stage is when the ear or panicle first comes out from the leaf sheath (emerges). Before heading the ear was inside the stem (booting). So heading = ear visible outside. It is a critical stage for water; missing water at heading can reduce grain number. In wheat heading is when the head is out; in rice when panicle emerges. Irrigation at heading is important.

text: What is milk stage in grain
label: term_explanation
answer: Milk stage is the grain filling stage when the inside of the grain is still soft and milky (liquid). If you press the grain, white milk-like liquid comes. It comes after flowering and before dough stage. At milk stage the crop needs water; stress here reduces grain size. Do not harvest at milk stage; grain is not ready. Next stage is dough (soft solid) then hard grain.

text: What is physiological maturity
label: term_explanation
answer: Physiological maturity is the stage when the grain has stopped filling and has reached its maximum dry weight. No more nutrients go into the grain. In wheat you can see a black layer at the base of the grain. After physiological maturity the grain only dries; it does not grow. Harvest can be done after some drying. It is different from harvest maturity when grain is dry enough to store.

text: What is plant population per acre
label: term_explanation
answer: Plant population means how many plants (or tillers in wheat) are there per unit area, usually per acre or per square metre. For wheat it may be 40–50 plants per sq m; for maize 6–7 per sq m. Right population gives good yield; too few means waste of land; too many means competition and lodging. Seed rate and germination decide population. Check stand after emergence; replant if too many gaps.

text: What is spacing between rows
label: term_explanation
answer: Spacing is the distance between rows and sometimes between plants in a row. For wheat row spacing may be 20–25 cm; for maize 60–75 cm between rows. Uniform spacing gives even stand and less competition. It is set by the drill or by hand. Too narrow spacing can cause lodging and disease; too wide wastes land. Recommendation gives spacing for each crop and variety.

text: What is residue burning
label: term_explanation
answer: Residue burning means setting fire to the leftover straw and stubble in the field after harvest. It clears the field quickly but is bad for soil and air. Burning kills organic matter and soil organisms; air pollution harms health. Government discourages it; penalty in some areas. Better options: use happy seeder in residue, or remove for fodder, or incorporate. Zero burn is the recommended practice.

text: What is bale and baler
label: term_explanation
answer: A bale is a compact block of straw or hay tied with rope or wire. A baler is the machine that makes bales: it picks up straw, compresses it and ties it. Bales are easy to transport and sell for fodder or bedding. After wheat or rice harvest you can bale the straw and sell. Baler can be owned or hired. Baling is better than leaving straw loose or burning.

text: What is chaff
label: term_explanation
answer: Chaff is the thin dry cover (husk, glumes) around the grain that is left after threshing. When you separate grain from straw, the light broken pieces and husk are chaff. It is not grain; it is removed by winnowing or by combine cleaning. Chaff can be used as mulch or animal bedding. Dockage in grain includes chaff; clean grain has less chaff. Chaff is also called bhoosi or bhussi.

text: What is compost how to make
label: term_explanation
answer: Compost is organic manure made by piling crop residue, leaves, dung, kitchen waste and letting them rot (decompose) for weeks or months. You keep the pile moist and turn it sometimes. When it is dark and crumbly it is ready. Use 2–4 ton per acre before sowing. Compost adds organic matter and some nutrients; it improves soil. It is different from FYM which is mainly dung and straw.

text: What is vermicompost
label: term_explanation
answer: Vermicompost is compost made with the help of earthworms. You put organic waste in a pit or bin and add worms; they eat and digest the waste and their castings become rich compost. It is better than normal compost in nutrients and soil health. Use like compost: 1–2 ton per acre or in nursery. It is organic; no chemical. Worm population must be kept moist and fed.

text: What is biofertilizer
label: term_explanation
answer: Biofertilizer is a product that has living organisms (bacteria, fungus) that help the plant get nutrients. For example rhizobium inoculant for legumes fixes nitrogen; phosphate-solubilizing bacteria help in P. You apply it to seed or soil; not a chemical. It is used in organic farming and along with chemical. It does not replace full fertilizer but can reduce need. Store in cool place; check expiry.

text: What is rhizobium inoculant
label: term_explanation
answer: Rhizobium inoculant is a powder or liquid that has Rhizobium bacteria. You mix it with legume seed before sowing. The bacteria enter the root and form nodules; they fix nitrogen from the air for the plant. So the legume gets free nitrogen. Use for mung, mash, chana, lentil etc. Do not use with chemical seed treatment; use after or with compatible treatment. One packet per recommended area.

text: What is MOP muriate of potash
label: term_explanation
answer: MOP means Muriate of Potash. It is a fertilizer that gives potassium (K). The chemical name is potassium chloride. It is used when soil test shows low K. Apply at sowing or in splits as per recommendation. It helps in grain quality, stem strength and disease tolerance. Do not use too much in crops sensitive to chloride. MOP is common and relatively cheap. One bag is often 50 kg.

text: What is gypsum used for in soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Gypsum is calcium sulphate. It is used in soil when soil is alkaline (high pH) or has too much sodium (sodic soil). Gypsum adds calcium and helps replace sodium so soil structure improves and water can enter. It does not change pH quickly like lime. Apply as per soil test; often 1–2 ton per acre in problem soils. It also gives sulphur. Use in combination with good drainage.

text: What is lime used for in soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Lime is calcium carbonate (or similar) used when soil is too acidic (low pH). Acidic soil locks up nutrients and harms roots. Lime raises pH so nutrients become available. Apply as per soil test; it can take months to act. Do not mix with urea or phosphate in same application. Lime is used before sowing; mix in soil. In Pakistan less common than gypsum; use when lab recommends.

text: What is chlorosis in leaves
label: term_explanation
answer: Chlorosis is when leaves turn yellow or pale because of lack of chlorophyll (green colour). It can be due to nitrogen deficiency (old leaves yellow), iron or zinc (new leaves yellow or white streaks), or other nutrients. So chlorosis is a symptom, not a disease; you must find which nutrient is missing. Soil test and leaf symptoms help. Correct by adding the right nutrient (urea, zinc, iron etc).

text: What is necrosis in plant
label: term_explanation
answer: Necrosis is when plant tissue dies and turns brown or black. It can be spots on leaves, dead leaf tips, or dead roots. It is caused by disease, toxin, salt, or severe deficiency. So necrosis is a symptom of damage. For example root rot causes root necrosis; some fungi cause leaf necrosis. To control find the cause: improve drainage, reduce salt, spray fungicide, or correct nutrient.

text: What is wilting
label: term_explanation
answer: Wilting is when leaves and stems droop and become limp because they lose water. The plant is not getting enough water or the roots cannot take it (root rot, waterlogging). Hot sun can cause temporary wilting; if soil is dry, irrigate. If roots are damaged, fix drainage and avoid over irrigation. Wilting can also be due to disease (e.g. wilt disease). So wilting is a sign of water or root problem.

text: What is soil structure
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil structure is how soil particles are grouped into lumps (aggregates) and how they hold together. Good structure has small lumps and pores so air and water can move; roots grow well. Bad structure is hard, dense or sticky. Organic matter and less tillage improve structure. Waterlogging and too much tillage damage it. Structure affects drainage, aeration and root growth. It is different from texture (sand, clay).

text: What is soil texture sandy clay loam
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil texture means the proportion of sand, silt and clay in the soil. Sandy soil has more sand; it drains fast and holds less water and nutrients. Clay soil has more clay; it holds water but can be heavy and waterlogged. Loam is a mix of all three and is often best for crops. You cannot change texture easily but you can improve structure with organic matter. Texture affects irrigation and fertilizer practice.

text: What is erosion in field
label: term_explanation
answer: Erosion is when soil is carried away by water or wind. Water erosion: rain or irrigation washes soil away; gullies can form. Wind erosion: wind blows soil in dry areas. Erosion removes topsoil (the best part) and reduces yield. To reduce: keep soil covered (residue, cover crop), reduce tillage, make bunds and contours, plant trees. Erosion is a serious problem on slopes and in rainfed areas.

text: What is transpiration
label: term_explanation
answer: Transpiration is when plants lose water as vapour from the leaves (through small openings called stomata). It is like evaporation from the plant. It helps pull water and nutrients from roots. In hot and windy weather transpiration is high so crop needs more water. You cannot stop it but you can reduce evaporation from soil by mulch. Transpiration plus soil evaporation is total water loss from the field.

text: What is flood irrigation
label: term_explanation
answer: Flood irrigation means applying water by letting it flow over the whole field so the surface is covered. It is the old and simple method. It uses more water than drip or furrow because some water runs off or evaporates. Where water is plenty it is still used. Problem: uneven level causes some areas waterlogged and some dry. Leveling and beds can improve flood irrigation.

text: What is sprinkler irrigation
label: term_explanation
answer: Sprinkler irrigation means applying water through pipes and nozzles that spray water in the air so it falls like rain on the crop. It can be movable or fixed. It gives uniform water and can save water compared to flood. Use in morning or evening to reduce evaporation. Good for vegetables and some field crops. You need pump and pipes; cost and maintenance to be considered. It can also be used for fertigation.

text: What is drip irrigation
label: term_explanation
answer: Drip irrigation means giving water through pipes and small outlets (drippers) directly to the root zone of each plant or row. Water drips slowly so almost no runoff or evaporation. It saves 30–50% water compared to flood. It is used in vegetables, orchards and some field crops. You need filters and maintenance so drippers do not clog. Fertilizer can be dissolved in water (fertigation). Initial cost is higher.

text: What is cover crop
label: term_explanation
