answer: Cover crop is a crop grown not mainly for harvest but to cover the soil. It is grown between main crops or when land would be empty. It reduces erosion, adds organic matter, and can fix nitrogen (if legume). Examples: mung, mash, clover, grasses. You cut or plough it in before sowing the main crop. It is like green manure. Cover crop keeps soil and improves next crop.

text: What is seed bed
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed bed is the prepared soil where seed will be sown. A good seed bed is loose, level and has enough moisture so seed can germinate and roots can grow. It is made by ploughing, harrowing and leveling. Clods should be broken; not too wet or too dry. Seed bed quality affects germination and stand. 'Seed bed preparation' means all the tillage and leveling before sowing.

text: What is storage pest weevil
label: term_explanation
answer: Storage pest is an insect that damages stored grain. Common ones are weevil, moth, beetle. They lay eggs in grain; larvae eat inside so grain is lost or spoiled. Control by keeping grain dry (below 12–14% moisture), clean and in sealed place. Use fumigation or contact insecticide if insects appear. Check regularly. Weevil is a small beetle that bores into grain; it is very common in wheat and rice.

text: What is dockage in grain
label: term_explanation
answer: Dockage is any material in the grain that is not the grain itself: dirt, stones, chaff, broken grain, other seeds. Buyers deduct dockage from weight or pay less. So clean grain has less dockage and gets better price. Clean and grade your grain before selling; remove straw, dirt and foreign matter. Government standards set maximum dockage for procurement. Dockage is also called foreign matter or impurity.

text: What is extension worker
label: term_explanation
answer: Extension worker is a person who works for the agriculture department or an NGO and gives farmers advice on crops, pest, fertilizer, new practices. He or she visits fields, runs training and answers questions. Extension worker is the link between research and farmer. You can get his or her contact from agriculture office or helpline. In Urdu sometimes called 'extension officer' or 'mashwarati'.

text: What is crop recommendation
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop recommendation is the advised practice for a crop: which variety, when to sow, how much fertilizer, when to irrigate, which pesticide, when to harvest. It is based on research and local conditions. You get it from extension, bulletins, or apps. Following recommendation gives better yield and saves cost. Recommendation can be general or for your soil (after soil test). It is not a rule but best practice.

text: What is pathogen in disease
label: term_explanation
answer: Pathogen is the organism that causes disease: fungus, bacteria, virus, or others. For example the rust fungus is the pathogen of wheat rust. Pathogen enters the plant, grows and damages tissue. Control aims to stop the pathogen: resistant variety, fungicide, clean seed, field hygiene. Different diseases have different pathogens. Knowing the pathogen helps choose the right medicine and practice.

text: What is disease incidence
label: term_explanation
answer: Disease incidence means how much of the crop or field is affected by the disease. It can be expressed as percentage of plants with disease or percentage of leaf area affected. High incidence means disease is widespread; low means only a few plants or leaves. Incidence helps decide if you need to spray and how bad the loss is. It is different from severity which is how severe the damage is on each plant.

text: What is predator insect
label: term_explanation
answer: Predator is an insect (or animal) that kills and eats other insects (prey). For example ladybird eats aphids; so ladybird is a predator. Predators are beneficial insects; they help control pests naturally. When you spray broad-spectrum insecticide you kill predators too; then pests can increase. In IPM we protect predators by using selective spray and threshold. Predator is a natural enemy of pest.

text: What is biological control
label: term_explanation
answer: Biological control means controlling pests (insects or diseases) by using their natural enemies or other living things instead of only chemical. For example use ladybird to eat aphids, or use a virus that kills the pest. It is part of IPM. It can reduce cost and is safer. It does not always give full control so sometimes chemical is still needed. Research and extension can tell what is available for your pest.

text: What is re-entry interval after spray
label: term_explanation
answer: Re-entry interval (REI) is the time after spraying during which you should not enter the field without protection (or at all). It is on the pesticide label, e.g. 12 hours or 24 hours. It is for safety so you do not breathe or touch the chemical. After REI you can enter but still avoid touching crop if harvest is near. Follow the label; re-entry too early can cause poisoning.

text: What is pre-harvest interval
label: term_explanation
answer: Pre-harvest interval (PHI) or waiting period is the minimum number of days between the last spray and harvest. It is on the pesticide label. During this time the chemical breaks down so the grain or fruit is safe to eat. Harvesting before PHI can leave residue in food. So PHI is for consumer safety. For example PHI may be 14 days for wheat; then you can harvest only after 14 days from last spray.

text: Septoria tan spot gandum ki bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Septoria aur tan spot gandum ki do patton wali bimariyan hain jo fungus se hoti hain. Patton par brown ya tan daag lakeeren; patte sookh sakte hain. Nami mausam mein failti hain. Pehli daag par fungicide; coverage achha. Resistant variety rotation. Septoria ko leaf blotch bhi kehte hain; tan spot lens jaisa tan daag. Dono control na hon to yield kam.

text: powdery mildew safed powder bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Powdery mildew woh fungus bimari hai jismein patton aur tanon par safed ya grey powder jaisi growth. Maida jaisa dikhta hai. Nami mausam. Pauda kamzor yield kam. Powder dikhe to sulphur ya triazole fungicide. Resistant variety. Fasal zyada ghana na ho hawa. Gandum aur zyada tar faslon mein.

text: ear spike gandum ka bal kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Ear (spike) gandum ka upar wala hissa hai jis par danay lagte hain. Booting ke baad jo sar nikalta hai; har spikelet se dana. Chawal mein panicle kehte hain. Grain filling ear mein. Earon ki tadad size yield par. Booting flowering par N pani zyada barey ear.

text: heading stage kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Heading stage woh waqt hai jab bal ya panicle pehli dafa patte ki sheath se bahar nikalta hai. Heading se pehle andar (booting). To heading = bal bahar. Pani ke liye critical; heading par pani na milne se danon ki tadad kam. Gandum mein bal nikalna; chawal mein panicle. Heading par pani zaroori.

text: milk stage dane ka kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Milk stage grain filling ka woh hissa jab dane ke andar abhi naram doodh jaisa (liquid). Dane ko dabayein to safed doodh jaisa. Phool ke baad dough se pehle. Milk stage par pani zaroori; stress se dana chhota. Is stage par na kaatein; dana tayar nahi. Agla dough phir sakht.

text: physiological maturity kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Physiological maturity woh stage jab dana bharna band ho chuka aur apni maximum dry weight par. Ab aur nutrient andar nahi jate. Gandum mein dane ke neeche black layer. Is ke baad dana sirf sukhta hai. Kuch sukha kar kaat sakte hain. Harvest maturity se farq jab dana itna sukha ke store ho.

text: plant population per acre kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Plant population matlab ek area (per acre ya per sq m) par kitne paude (gandum mein tillers). Gandum 40–50 per sq m; makki 6–7. Sahi population yield; kam zyada dono nuqsan. Seed rate germination se decide. Emergence ke baad stand check; khaliyan zyada hon to dubara boen.

text: spacing lineon ke beech kitni
label: term_explanation
answer: Spacing lineon ke beech (aur kabhi paudon ke beech) ki doori. Gandum 20–25 cm; makki 60–75 cm. Barabar spacing stand aur kam competition. Drill ya haath se set. Tang lodging bimari; chauri zameen zaya. Har fasal variety ke liye recommendation.

text: residue jalaana kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Residue jalaana kaatne ke baad bhoosa stubble ko aag laga kar jalana. Khet jaldi saaf lekin zameen aur hawa dono ke liye bura. Organic matter soil organisms mar jate hain. Sarkar hata rahi hai; kuch jagah penalty. Behtar: happy seeder residue mein ya hata kar chara ya mix. Zero burn recommend.

text: bale baler kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Bale bhoosa ya charay ka dabaya hua block jo rassi ya wire se banda. Baler woh machine jo bale banati hai: bhoosa utha kar dabati aur bandti. Bale uthana bechna aasan. Gandum chawal ke baad bhoosa bale bana kar bech sakte. Baler apni ya rent. Baling chhorna ya jalaane se behtar.

text: chaff bhoosi kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Chaff (bhoosi) kaatne ke baad dane ka patla sukha cover (husk glumes). Grain alag karte waqt halke tootay hisse chaff. Ye grain nahi; winnowing ya combine se alag. Chaff mulch ya bedding. Dockage mein chaff; saaf dana kam chaff. Bhoosi bhussi.

text: compost kaise banti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Compost organic khaad hai jo residue patte gobar kitchen waste ko dher karke galane se banti hai. Nami rakhein paltein. Jab kali bhoomi jaisi ho jaye tayar. Bone se pehle 2–4 ton. Organic matter aur kuch nutrients; zameen behtar. FYM se farq jo gobar straw.

text: vermicompost kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Vermicompost woh compost hai jo kechwayon ki madad se banti hai. Waste pit ya bin mein kechwe daalein; woh khate hain aur unki castings rich compost. Normal compost se behtar. Compost jaisa 1–2 ton ya nursery. Organic. Kechwe nami aur khana.

text: biofertilizer kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Biofertilizer woh cheez hai jismein zinda organisms (bacteria fungus) jo paude ko nutrients dilwate hain. Maslan rhizobium legume ke liye N fix; phosphate solubilizing P. Beej ya zameen par; chemical nahi. Organic ya chemical ke sath. Poori khaad ki jagah nahi. Thandi jagah expiry.

text: rhizobium inoculant kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Rhizobium inoculant powder ya liquid jismein Rhizobium bacteria. Legume beej ke sath mila kar bone se pehle. Bacteria jad mein nodule banate N fix. Legume ko free N. Mung mash chana masoor. Chemical seed treatment ke sath na; baad ya compatible. Ek packet recommendation.

text: MOP potash khaad kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: MOP ka matlab Muriate of Potash—potassium (K) dene wala khaad. Chemical potassium chloride. Soil test mein K kam ho to. Bone par ya split recommendation. Grain quality tana mazbooti bimari tolerance. Chloride sensitive faslon mein zyada na. Aam sasta. 50 kg bag.

text: gypsum zameen mein kyun dalte hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Gypsum calcium sulphate. Zameen alkaline (pH zyada) ya sodium zyada (sodic) ho to use karte hain. Calcium milta sodium replace structure behtar pani andar. Lime jaisa turant pH nahi. Soil test 1–2 ton problem zameen. Sulphur bhi. Drainage ke sath.

text: chuna lime zameen mein kyun dalte hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Chuna (lime) calcium carbonate jab zameen acidic (pH kam). Acidic nutrients lock roots nuqsan. Lime pH barhati nutrients available. Soil test; mahine lagte hain. Urea phosphate sath na. Bone se pehle zameen mein. Pakistan mein gypsum se kam; lab recommend kare to.

text: chlorosis patte zard kyun hote hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Chlorosis patton ka zard ya peela hona chlorophyll kami. N kami (purane zard) iron zinc (naye zard safed lakeeren) ya aur nutrient. To chlorosis nishani hai; bimari nahi; kaun nutrient kami. Soil test patte. Sahi nutrient (urea zinc iron) dalen.

text: necrosis patte kaala sookhna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Necrosis paude ka tissue mar kar brown kaala. Patton pe daag patte ki nok jaden. Bimari zehr namak kami. Nuqsan ki nishani. Root rot jad necrosis; fungus patte. Wajah pehchanen: drainage namak fungicide nutrient.

text: wilting pauda murjhana kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Wilting patte tane jhuk kar naram—pani loss. Pauda pani nahi le pa raha ya jaden nahi (root rot waterlogging). Dhoop temporary wilting; zameen sukhi ho to pani. Jaden nuqsan to drainage zyada pani na. Wilt bimari bhi. Pani ya jad ka masla.

text: soil structure zameen ki saakht kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil structure zameen ke particles ka dheron (aggregates) mein jorna aur pores. Achi structure chhote dhere pores hawa pani; jaden. Kharab sakht chipchip. Organic matter kam tillage. Waterlogging zyada tillage nuqsan. Drainage aeration. Texture (ret chikni) se farq.

text: soil texture reti chikni mitti kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil texture zameen mein ret (sand) silt mitti (clay) ka hissa. Raiti zyada ret; tez drain kam pani khuraak. Chikni zyada mitti; pani pakad lekin bhari waterlog. Loam teeno ka mix aam behtar. Texture aasaan nahi badalti; structure organic matter se. Texture pani khaad par asar.

text: erosion zameen ka behna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Erosion zameen ka pani ya hawa se behna udna. Pani: barish pani dharti beha le; naaliyan. Hawa: sukhe ilaqe. Upar wali zameen (behtar) chali jati yield kam. Kam karne: residue cover crop kam tillage bund contour ped. Dhal aur barani ilaqe mein masla.

text: transpiration patton se pani ugalna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Transpiration paudon ka pani patton se bhaap (stomata) ke zariye. Paude se evaporation jaisa. Pani nutrients jaden se. Garm tundi mein zyada; fasal ko zyada pani. Rok nahi sakte lekin mulch se zameen evaporation kam. Transpiration + zameen evaporation total pani zaya.

text: flood irrigation chara pani kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Flood irrigation (chara pani) pure khet par pani bhar kar dena. Purana aasan tareeqa. Drip furrow se zyada pani—behav evaporation. Pani plenty ho to. Level na ho to kahi bhari kahi sukhi. Leveling beds se behtar.

text: sprinkler irrigation kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Sprinkler irrigation pipe nozzle se pani hawa mein chhidkana taake barish jaisa crop par. Movable ya fixed. Barabar pani bachav. Subah sham evaporation kam. Sabziyan kuch faslen. Pump pipe lagat. Fertigation bhi.

text: drip irrigation kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Drip irrigation pipe aur chhotay outlets (dripper) se pani seedha jad tak. Drip se kam runoff evaporation. Flood se 30–50% bachav. Sabziyan bagh kuch faslen. Filter dekhbhal taake band na hon. Khaad pani mein (fertigation). Shuruat mein mehenga.

text: cover crop kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Cover crop woh fasal jo kaatne ke liye nahi balke zameen dhakne ke liye. Main faslon ke beech ya khaali zameen par. Erosion kam organic matter legume N. Mung mash clover ghaas. Main fasal bone se pehle kaat kar milayein. Green manure jaisi. Zameen bachati agli fasal behtar.

text: seed bed beej ki tayari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed bed woh tayar zameen jahan beej daalenge. Achi seed bed narm barabar nami taake germination jaden. Jot sulah level. Clod tootay na gili na sukhi. Seed bed germination stand. Seed bed preparation bone se pehle tillage leveling.

text: storage pest store ke keerey kya hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Storage pest woh keera jo store grain nuqsan karta hai. Weevil moth beetle. Ande grain mein larve andar khate. Grain sukha (12–14% se kam) saaf band jagah. Keerey dikhein to fumigation contact. Regular check. Weevil chhota beetle jo grain mein; gandum chawal mein aam.

text: dockage dane mein gandagi kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Dockage grain mein woh cheez jo grain nahi: gandagi pathar chaff toota dana doosri faslen. Kharedar weight se kata dete ya kam rate. Saaf grain kam dockage zyada rate. Bechne se pehle saaf grade. Sarkari standard max dockage. Foreign matter impurity.

text: extension worker kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Extension worker agriculture department ya NGO ka wo shaks jo kisan ko fasal keera khaad naye tareeqe par mashwara deta hai. Khet training sawal. Research aur kisan ka link. Agri office helpline se number. Extension officer mashwarati.

text: recommendation mashwara kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Recommendation (mashwara) woh amal jo fasal ke liye advise: variety kab boen kitna khaad kab pani kaunsi dawai kab kaatein. Research aur local hisaab se. Extension bulletin app. Recommendation se yield bachat. General ya soil test ke baad. Rule nahi best practice.

text: pathogen bimari ka keeda kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Pathogen bimari ka woh organism: fungus bacteria virus. Maslan zang ka fungus wheat rust ka pathogen. Pathogen paude mein barhta nuqsan. Control: resistant fungicide saaf beej hygiene. Alag bimari alag pathogen. Pathogen jaan kar sahi dawai.

text: disease incidence bimari kitni faili kya matlab
label: term_explanation
answer: Disease incidence matlab fasal ya khet ka kitna hissa bimari se. Paudon ka percentage ya patte ka area. Zyada incidence matlab bimari faili; kam matlab thode. Spray zaroori ya nuqsan kitna. Severity se farq jo har paude par kitna nuqsan.

text: predator keera kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Predator woh keera jo doosre keeron (prey) ko marta khata hai. Ladybird chust; to ladybird predator. Faida mand. Broad spectrum spray se predator bhi mar jate pest barh jate. IPM mein selective threshold se bachate. Pest ka natural enemy.

text: biological control natural ilaaj kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Biological control matlab pest ko un ke natural dushman ya zinda cheezon se control—sirf chemical nahi. Ladybird chust; virus pest. IPM ka hissa. Lagat kam safe. Hamesha full control nahi kabhi chemical. Research extension aapke pest ke liye.

text: re-entry interval spray ke baad khet mein kab aayein
label: term_explanation
answer: Re-entry interval (REI) chhidkai ke baad woh waqt jis ke andar bina protection khet mein na aayein. Pesticide label par maslan 12 ya 24 ghante. Safety—chemical na saans na chhuein. REI ke baad aa sakte lekin kaatai kareeb ho to crop na chhuein. Label follow.

text: pre-harvest interval kaatne se pehle kitne din
label: term_explanation
answer: Pre-harvest interval (PHI) ya waiting period last spray aur kaatai ke beech kam az kam din. Label par. Is dauran chemical toot jati grain safe. PHI se pehle kaatne se residue. Consumer safety. Maslan gandum 14 din; 14 din baad kaatein.

text: seed drill bone wali machine kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed drill woh machine jo beej (aur kabhi khaad) khet mein khadon mein dalati hai. Seed rate depth spacing set. Line sowing uniform. Hand broadcast se kam beej zyada control. Calibration karein. Zero till drill alag jo residue mein booti hai.

text: cultivator machine kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Cultivator woh machine jo zameen hilti hai lekin plough jitni gehraee nahi. Clods tootay weeds kaatay. Jot aur sulah ke beech. Minimum tillage mein use. Seed bed banane ya jhariyan katne. Tines ya blades.

text: land leveling zameen barabar karna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Land leveling zameen ko barabar karna taake pani har jagah barabar phile. Uneven se kahi pani zyada kahi kam. Leveling se irrigation behtar yield. Haath se ya laser leveler. Bone se pehle. Bund contour bhi.

text: bund band khet ki kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Bund (band) khet ke kinare ya andar mitti ki unchaee jo pani rok kar behne se bachaye. Chhota pani store. Erosion kam. Neechi jagah bund. Contour bund dhal ke sath. Band banana khet ki deewar.

text: brackish water kharab pani kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Brackish water woh pani jismein namak (salt) thora zyada ho. Tube well ya kuch wells brackish. EC zyada. Zyada brackish nuqsan. Limit se kam ho to use; achhe pani mix gypsum drainage. Pani test karein.

text: crop stand fasal ka khara hona kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop stand matlab khet mein paudon ka khara hona—kitne uge kitne zinda. Acha stand uniform kam khaliyan. Germination seed rate depth. Stand kharab ho to yield kam; replant ya agli bar behtar beej. Stand check emergence ke baad.

text: replanting dubara bone kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Replanting matlab ugalne ke baad agar stand bahut kam ho to dubara beej dena. Khaliyan zyada hon to. Naya beej same jagah. Waqt aur beej zaya. Is liye pehli bone theek karein; germination check. Kabhi partial replant.

text: weevil dane ka keera kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Weevil chhota beetle jo store grain ke andar ghus kar khaata hai. Larva andar; grain kho jata. Storage pest. Sukha (12–14%) saaf fumigation. Gandum chawal dono. Check karein. Weevil ka larva andar se grain khaata hai.

text: foreign matter dane mein gandagi kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Foreign matter grain mein woh cheez jo grain nahi: gandagi pathar doosri faslen ka beej toota. Dockage jaisa. Kam foreign matter behtar rate. Bechne se pehle saaf karein. Quality parameter. Reject zyada hon to.

text: subsidy sarkari madad kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Subsidy sarkari madad jo kisan ko kisi cheez (beej khaad machinery insurance) par milti hai taake lagat kam ho. Apply karna parta; eligibility. Beej khaad tractor par scheme. Agri office bank se list form. Quota limit.

text: crop insurance fasal ka insurance kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop insurance fasal ka nuqsan (oala barish bimari) hone par claim se paisa lene ka scheme. Premium hoti; sarkar hissa deti. Nuqsan par report survey claim. Policy terms. Bank company agri. Bachav ke liye.

text: soil health card zameen ka card kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil health card sarkari card jismein aapki zameen ka test result aur khaad recommendation likhi hoti. Scheme se milta. Is se khaad decision. Har 2–3 saal test. Lab se report. Zameen ki sehat ka record.

text: symptom bimari ki nishani kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Symptom bimari ki woh nishani jo paude par dikhti hai—zard daag sookhna murjhana. Symptom se bimari pehchante hain. Sign pathogen khud (fungus pustule). Symptom = paude ka reaction. Pehchan kar ilaaj.

text: blight bimari patte sookhna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Blight bimari jismein patte jaldi sookh mar jate hain; daag bade. Fungus bacteria. Leaf blight wheat chawal. Pehli nishani fungicide. Resistant. Blight tez failti hai.

text: blast chawal ki bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Blast chawal ki bimari jismein patte bal par daag; bal sookh sakta. Fungus. Nami. Resistant variety fungicide. Critical flowering. Rice blast aam; nuqsan zyada.

text: larva keerey ka bachha kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Larva keerey ka bachha (caterpillar grub) stage—ande se nikla jo khata barhta hai. Phir pupa phir adult. Armyworm cutworm bollworm sab larva. Larva stage par insecticide zyada asar. Pehchan karein.

text: lifecycle keerey ka chakkar kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Lifecycle keerey ka woh chakkar jismein anda larva pupa adult hota hai. Har stage ki umr. Is se pata kab control behtar. Maslan ande ya chhote larva par spray. Lifecycle jaan kar timing.

text: maund weight kitna hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Maund weight ki ek unit; Pakistan India mein aam. Kuch jagah 40 kg kuch 37 kg. Gandum chawal maund mein bechte hain. 40 maund = 1 ton (40 kg wala). Apne ilaqe ka maund check karein.

text: per acre matlab kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Per acre matlab ek acre zameen par. Seed rate fertilizer yield sab per acre naapte hain. 1 acre = 4 kanal (kuch ilaqon mein) ya 0.4 hectare. Recommendation per acre dete hain. Apne khet ka area jaan kar total nikalein.

text: zinc sulphate zinc ki dawai kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Zinc sulphate zinc ka woh khaad ya dawai jo zinc kami ke liye use hoti hai. Safed dana ya powder. Zameen mein ya foliar spray. Patton pe safed lakeeren (zinc kami) hon to foliar. Dose label extension. Repeat agar rahein. Zinc wheat chawal dono ke liye zaroori.

text: What is volunteer plant in field
label: term_explanation
answer: Volunteer plant is a plant that grows from seed that fell or was left from the previous crop, not from seed you sowed this season. For example volunteer wheat or rice comes from grain that dropped at harvest. It acts like a weed in the next crop and can host disease (e.g. rust) and pests. Remove or kill volunteer plants before sowing the next crop. They also use water and nutrients. Timely destruction of volunteers helps reduce pest and disease pressure.

text: What is terminal heat in wheat
label: term_explanation
answer: Terminal heat is the high temperature that comes at the end of the wheat season, during grain filling and ripening. When it comes too early or too strong, grain does not fill well and yield drops. It is a common problem in Pakistan. To reduce impact: sow at the right time so grain fill is not in peak heat, give last irrigation on time, and use heat-tolerant or earlier-maturing varieties. You cannot control the weather but you can reduce loss with these steps.

text: What is seed priming
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed priming means soaking or treating seed in water or a solution for a few hours before sowing, then drying it back so it does not germinate yet. When you sow, it germinates faster and more evenly. It helps in dry areas or when soil moisture is low. Do not soak too long or seed can be damaged. It is different from seed treatment with fungicide; you can do both. Extension can tell the right method for your crop.

text: What is sodic soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Sodic soil is soil that has too much sodium (not only salt). The soil becomes sticky when wet and hard when dry; water does not enter well. It is different from only saline soil. To improve sodic soil use gypsum (calcium sulphate) and good drainage; avoid poor-quality water. Crop choice: grow tolerant crops. Soil test tells if your soil is sodic (high ESP or SAR). Gypsum replaces sodium with calcium and improves structure.

text: What is neem oil for pest control
label: term_explanation
answer: Neem oil is oil pressed from the neem tree seed. It is used in farming to repel or kill some insects (e.g. aphids) and to reduce fungus. It is a natural or bio pesticide; safer than many chemicals. You mix a small amount in water and spray; dose is on the product. It works best when pest is low; for heavy infestation chemical may be needed. Neem does not kill all insects; it is part of IPM. Repeat spray after 7–10 days if needed.

text: What is susceptible variety
label: term_explanation
answer: Susceptible variety is a variety that gets a disease or pest easily—the opposite of resistant. For example a rust-susceptible wheat variety will get rust when the disease is present. Under the same conditions a resistant variety stays healthy. So susceptible means the plant cannot defend itself well. You should avoid susceptible varieties where that disease is common; use resistant or tolerant ones. Susceptible is also called 'sensitive'.

text: What is stem fly pest
label: term_explanation
answer: Stem fly is a small fly whose larva (maggot) goes inside the stem of the crop and feeds there. The stem can break or the plant dies (dead heart in rice). It attacks rice, wheat and other cereals. Control by destroying volunteer plants and crop residue, and by spraying when adults or young larvae are present. Resistant variety and timely sowing help. It is different from stem borer (a moth larva); both bore inside the stem.

text: What is downy mildew
label: term_explanation
answer: Downy mildew is a disease caused by a fungus-like organism that makes yellow patches on the upper leaf and grey or white fuzzy growth on the lower leaf. It likes cool and wet weather. It is different from powdery mildew (white on top). Crops like onion, maize, bajra can get it. Reduce by good drainage, less humidity, and resistant variety. Fungicide (e.g. metalaxyl) can be used; ask extension for the right product for your crop.

text: What is sheath blight in rice
label: term_explanation
answer: Sheath blight is a disease of rice caused by fungus. It attacks the leaf sheath (the part that wraps the stem) and the leaf; you see oval or irregular grey-green spots. It spreads in wet, humid conditions and dense crop. It can reduce yield. Control with resistant variety, less nitrogen, good spacing, and fungicide when needed. Residue and water management also help. It is common in irrigated rice.

text: What is winnowing grain
label: term_explanation
answer: Winnowing is the way to separate grain from chaff (husk and broken bits) using wind or air. After threshing you have grain mixed with chaff; you pour or toss it and the wind blows the light chaff away while the heavier grain falls. It is an old method; combine does cleaning by fan. Winnowing can be done by hand with a tray or by machine. Clean grain has less dockage and gets better price.

text: What is harvest index
label: term_explanation
answer: Harvest index is the share of the total plant weight that is the useful part (grain or fruit). For example if the plant weighs 100 units and grain is 40, harvest index is 40%. Higher harvest index means the crop puts more into grain and less into straw—so better yield for the same total growth. It is a term used in research and recommendation. Good variety and management (water, nitrogen at right time) improve harvest index.

text: What is hectare in land measurement
label: term_explanation
answer: Hectare is a unit of land area used in many countries. 1 hectare = 10,000 square metres. In Pakistan and India acre and kanal are also used. Roughly 1 hectare = 2.47 acres, or 1 acre = 0.4 hectare. When recommendation says kg per hectare, you can convert: multiply per-hectare dose by 0.4 for per acre. Seed rate and fertilizer are often given per hectare or per acre.

text: What is quintal weight
label: term_explanation
answer: Quintal is a unit of weight. In metric system 1 quintal = 100 kg. So 10 quintals = 1 ton (1000 kg). In some areas people use quintal for grain; in Pakistan maund (about 40 kg) is more common. When you see 'quintal per hectare' it means 100 kg per hectare. It is used in yield and recommendation in many countries.

text: What is ergot disease in cereals
label: term_explanation
answer: Ergot is a disease of cereals (wheat, rye, bajra) where the grain is replaced by a dark purple or black horn-like structure (sclerotium) containing poison. It is caused by a fungus. It is harmful to humans and animals if eaten. Control by clean seed, crop rotation, and mowing grass around the field. There is no good chemical for ergot; use clean seed and avoid flowering in wet weather. Infected heads should be removed.

text: What is mosaic virus in crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Mosaic is a viral disease that makes leaves show yellow and green patches or streaks (mosaic pattern). The plant may be stunted. Virus is spread by insects (e.g. aphid) or by touch. There is no cure for the virus in the plant; control by resistant variety, control the insect vector, and remove infected plants. Mosaic is common in potato, tomato, chilli, and some other crops. Once virus is in the field it is hard to remove.

text: What is vector in plant disease
label: term_explanation
answer: Vector in plant disease means the carrier that spreads the disease from one plant to another. Often it is an insect: for example aphid can carry virus, so aphid is the vector. Controlling the vector (e.g. with insecticide or oil) can slow the spread of disease. Not all diseases have a vector; some spread by wind, seed or soil. Knowing the vector helps in control strategy.

text: What is roguing in field
label: term_explanation
answer: Roguing means walking through the field and removing (rogue) plants that are not like the rest—off-types, diseased plants, or weeds. It is done to keep the crop pure, especially in seed production. You pull or cut the bad plants. Roguing improves seed quality and reduces disease spread. It is done at flowering or when difference is clear. It is a cultural practice, not chemical.

text: What is off-type plant
label: term_explanation
answer: Off-type plant is a plant that is different from the variety you sowed—different height, colour, ear shape, or other trait. It may be from mixed seed, from volunteer seed, or from natural crossing. In seed production off-types are removed (roguing) so the seed stays pure. Off-types can reduce yield and quality. If you see many off-types, your seed may be impure; use certified seed next time.

text: What is thousand grain weight
label: term_explanation
answer: Thousand grain weight (TGW) is the weight in grams of 1000 grains. It tells how big and heavy the grains are. Higher TGW usually means better filling and often better milling. It is related to test weight. You measure it by counting 1000 grains and weighing them. Research and variety description often give TGW. Good management (right harvest time, no stress at grain fill) helps get good TGW.

text: What is boom sprayer
label: term_explanation
answer: Boom sprayer is a sprayer that has a long bar (boom) with several nozzles along it, so you spray a wide strip in one pass. It is pulled by tractor or carried. It gives even coverage if height and speed are correct. To reduce drift use correct nozzle type and pressure, and spray when wind is calm. Boom sprayer is common for field crops; it is faster than single-nozzle sprayer.

text: What is economic threshold for pest
label: term_explanation
answer: Economic threshold is the pest number or damage level at which the cost of control (spray) equals the crop loss you would have without control. In practice it is the level at which you should spray to avoid loss. Extension gives threshold for each pest, e.g. 5–10 aphids per tiller. Below threshold, spray is not worth it; above threshold, you may lose money if you do not spray. It is like 'threshold' but stresses the economic reason.

text: What is cultivar meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Cultivar means a cultivated variety—a variety that humans have selected or bred. It is almost the same as 'variety'. Each cultivar has a name (e.g. Galaxy-2013, Faisalabad-2008). When we say 'resistant cultivar' we mean a named variety that is resistant. So cultivar = variety in everyday use. Scientists use the word cultivar for the formal name.

text: What is inter-row hoeing
label: term_explanation
answer: Inter-row hoeing means removing weeds and loosening soil between the crop rows using a hoe or implement. It is done after the crop is up; it cuts weeds between rows and gives aeration. It is a cultural weed control; it does not replace herbicide but can reduce weed pressure. You need enough space between rows to run the hoe. It is common in maize, cotton, and row crops.

text: What is residue retention
label: term_explanation
answer: Residue retention means keeping the crop residue (straw, stubble) on the field instead of removing or burning it. The residue stays on the surface or is partly mixed. It saves moisture, reduces erosion, and adds organic matter over time. It is used in conservation agriculture and with zero tillage. Happy seeder sows into retained residue. Do not burn; retain for soil and water benefit.

text: What is earlier-maturing variety
label: term_explanation
answer: Earlier-maturing variety is a variety that reaches harvest in fewer days than a normal variety. So it 'matures earlier'. It helps when you have a short season, or when you want to escape terminal heat or drought at the end. For example early wheat is harvested before peak heat. Yield may be a bit less than full-season variety but you save the crop. Choose as per your sowing date and climate.

text: What is mixed cropping
label: term_explanation
answer: Mixed cropping means growing two or more crops in the same field at the same time without strict rows—often mixed together. It is similar to intercropping but the mix can be more random. It spreads risk and can use space and nutrients better. For example wheat with mustard, or maize with bean. Plan for harvest and labour. It is an old practice; still used in many areas.

text: What is nutrient deficiency symptom
label: term_explanation
answer: Nutrient deficiency symptom is the sign the plant shows when a nutrient is missing. For example nitrogen deficiency: old leaves yellow; zinc: white streaks on new leaves; potassium: brown leaf edges. So the symptom helps you guess which nutrient is lacking. Then you can add that nutrient (fertilizer or foliar). Soil test and leaf analysis can confirm. Correcting deficiency in time improves yield.

text: What is soil-borne disease
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil-borne disease is a disease whose pathogen (fungus, bacteria, etc.) lives in the soil and attacks from there. It can enter through roots or stem base. Examples: root rot, wilt, some blights. Control by crop rotation, resistant variety, clean seed, and sometimes soil treatment. It is different from airborne or insect-borne. Once in soil it can stay for years; so rotation and resistance are important.

text: What is stale seedbed
label: term_explanation
answer: Stale seedbed is a way to reduce weeds: you prepare the field and irrigate so weed seeds germinate, then you kill the weeds (by light tillage or herbicide) before sowing the crop. So when you sow, there are fewer weed seeds left to come up. It is done 1–2 weeks before sowing. It is a cultural method; it can reduce the need for post-emergence herbicide. Use when you have time before sowing.

text: What is plant density
label: term_explanation
answer: Plant density means how many plants (or tillers) are in a unit area, e.g. per square metre or per acre. High density = many plants; low density = few. Right density gives good yield; too high can cause lodging and disease; too low wastes land. Density depends on seed rate, germination, and spacing. Recommendation gives the target density for each crop and variety.

text: What is irrigation schedule
label: term_explanation
answer: Irrigation schedule is the plan of when to give how much water to the crop. It says how many irrigations and at what stages (e.g. crown root, tillering, booting, grain fill). It depends on crop, soil, and weather. A schedule helps you not miss critical stages and not over-irrigate. Extension or recommendation gives a typical schedule; you adjust for rain and your water supply.

text: What is pest pressure
label: term_explanation
answer: Pest pressure means how much the pest (insect or disease) is present and how much damage it can cause. High pest pressure = many pests or fast spread; you need to act. Low pressure = few pests; maybe no spray. Pressure builds with weather, volunteer plants, and same crop every year. Scout to see pressure; use threshold to decide when to spray. Resistant variety and clean practice reduce pressure.

text: What is crop canopy
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop canopy is the top layer of leaves and stems that covers the ground when the crop is full. It is like a 'roof' of the crop. Dense canopy shades the soil (less weed, less evaporation) but can favour some diseases (e.g. in humid weather). Canopy size affects how much light the crop catches and how much it produces. Management (spacing, nitrogen) affects canopy.

text: What is tasseling stage in maize
label: term_explanation
answer: Tasseling is the stage in maize when the tassel (male flower at the top) comes out. Pollen is shed from the tassel. It is a critical stage for water; stress here can reduce grain number. Silking is when the female part (silks) appears; pollination happens then. So tasseling and silking are the flowering stage of maize. Irrigation and no stress at this time are important for yield.

text: What is seed dressing
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed dressing means applying a chemical (fungicide or insecticide) to the seed surface before sowing—same as seed treatment. The seed is coated or mixed with the product. It protects against seed-borne and some soil-borne pests and diseases. 'Dressing' is another word for 'treatment'. Use recommended product and dose; dry seed after dressing before sowing. Certified seed is often already dressed.

text: What is fodder crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Fodder crop is a crop grown mainly to feed animals—for example maize for green fodder, sorghum, oats, berseem. You cut the plant (whole or top) and give to cattle, goats, etc. It is not mainly for grain. Fodder crops can be grown alone or with grain. Good fodder has high protein and yield. Rotating with fodder can improve soil and give income from livestock.

text: What is grain moisture content
label: term_explanation
answer: Grain moisture content is the percentage of water in the grain. It is measured with a meter or by weight loss on drying. For safe storage moisture should be 12–14% or less; higher moisture leads to insects and fungus. At harvest grain may have 20–25% moisture; you dry it before storing. Moisture affects test weight, storage life, and price. Buyers often check moisture.

text: What is black layer in maize grain
label: term_explanation
answer: Black layer in maize is a dark layer that forms at the base of the grain when the grain has reached physiological maturity. Once black layer is there, the grain does not take more dry matter. So it is used to decide when to harvest maize. You can see it by cutting a kernel; it is at the tip where it was attached. After black layer you can harvest when moisture is right for storage or combine.

text: What is dead heart in rice
label: term_explanation
answer: Dead heart in rice is when the central shoot (tiller) dies and can be pulled out easily—it is yellow and dry inside. It is caused by stem borer larva that feeds inside the stem. So the tiller does not produce a panicle. Control stem borer with insecticide at the right time and remove infested plants. Resistant variety and field sanitation help. Dead heart is a symptom of stem borer damage.

text: What is white ear in rice pest
label: term_explanation
answer: White ear in rice is when the ear (panicle) stays white or pale and has no or few grains. It can be caused by stem borer (larva feeds inside) or by other stress. The panicle is empty or chaffy. It is a type of damage that reduces yield. Control by managing stem borer and ensuring good nutrition and water at flowering and grain fill. Scout for stem borer and spray when needed.

text: volunteer plant khet mein kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Volunteer plant woh pauda hai jo purani fasal ke giray ya rehne wale beej se ugta hai; is mausam ka beej aapne nahi dala. Maslan volunteer gandum ya chawal kaatai mein giray dane se. Agli fasal mein jhari jaisa; bimari (zang) ka host. Agli fasal bone se pehle volunteer hataen ya maaren. Pani khuraak bhi leta hai. Volunteer jald hataane se keera bimari kam.

text: terminal heat gandum mein kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Terminal heat gandum mausam ke aakhir mein aane wali tez garmi hai—grain filling aur pakai ke dauran. Jaldi ya zyada aaye to dana nahi bharta yield kam. Pakistan mein aam masla. Kam karne ke liye sahi waqt bone taake grain fill peak garmi mein na; last pani waqt par; heat tolerant ya jaldi pakne wali variety. Mausam control nahi lekin in se nuqsan kam.

text: seed priming kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed priming ka matlab bone se pehle beej ko kuch ghante pani ya solution mein bhigona phir sukha lena taake abhi ugalna na ho. Jab boen to jaldi aur barabar ugalta. Sukhe ilaqe ya kam nami mein faida. Zyada der na bhigayein nuqsan. Seed treatment (fungicide) se alag; dono kar sakte. Extension crop ke mutabiq batayega.

text: sodic soil namak zameen kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Sodic soil woh zameen hai jismein sodium zyada ho (sirf namak nahi). Gili mein chipchip sukhi mein sakht; pani andar nahi jata. Sirf saline se farq. Behtar karne ke liye gypsum (calcium sulphate) aur drainage; kharab pani na. Tolerant faslen. Soil test sodic (ESP SAR) batata hai. Gypsum sodium ki jagah calcium structure behtar.

text: neem oil keeron ke liye kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Neem oil neem ke beej se nikala hua tel hai. Keeron (chust waghaira) ko rokne ya marne aur fungus kam karne ke liye. Natural ya bio pesticide; chemical se safe. Thora pani mein mila kar chhidkain; dose product par. Keera kam ho to behtar; zyada ho to chemical. Neem sab keerey nahi marta; IPM ka hissa. 7–10 din baad repeat.

text: susceptible variety kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Susceptible variety woh variety hai jo bimari ya keere se aasani se lag jati hai—resistant ka ulta. Maslan zang susceptible gandum zang aate hi lag jati hai. Resistant wahi par sehatmand. To susceptible matlab pauda apna bachav kam kar pata. Jahan woh bimari aam ho susceptible na len; resistant tolerant len. Sensitive bhi kehte hain.

text: stem fly keera kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Stem fly chhoti makhi hai jis ka larva (maggot) tane ke andar ghus kar khata hai. Tana toot sakta pauda mar sakta (chawal mein dead heart). Chawal gandum cereals. Volunteer aur residue hataen; jab adult ya chhote larva hon spray. Resistant waqt par bone. Stem borer (moth larva) se farq; dono andar.

text: downy mildew bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Downy mildew fungus jaisa organism se bimari; upar peela neeche grey safed fuzzy growth. Thanda nami mausam. Powdery mildew se farq (safed upar). Pyaz makki bajra. Drainage kam nami resistant. Fungicide (metalaxyl); extension crop ke mutabiq.

text: sheath blight chawal ki bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Sheath blight chawal ki fungus bimari. Leaf sheath (tane ko lapetne wala) aur patta; oval irregular grey-green daag. Nami ghana fasal. Yield kam. Resistant kam N spacing fungicide. Residue pani. Chara chawal mein aam.

text: winnowing dana alag karna kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Winnowing dane ko chaff (bhoosi toota) se hawa se alag karne ka tareeqa. Threshing ke baad grain chaff mix; hawa halka chaff uda deti bhari grain girta. Purana tareeqa; combine fan se saaf karta. Haath tray ya machine. Saaf dana kam dockage zyada rate.

text: harvest index paidawar ka index kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Harvest index total paude ka wazan ka woh hissa jo kaam ka (dana phal). Maslan pauda 100 unit dana 40 to index 40%. Zyada index matlab zyada dana kam bhoosa—same growth par behtar yield. Research recommendation mein. Achi variety management (pani N sahi waqt) index behtar.

text: hectare zameen ka naap kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Hectare zameen ka naap; 1 hectare = 10,000 sq m. Pakistan India mein acre kanal bhi. 1 hectare = 2.47 acre ya 1 acre = 0.4 hectare. Recommendation kg per hectare ho to 0.4 se per acre. Seed rate khaad per hectare ya per acre.

text: quintal weight kitna hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Quintal weight ki unit; 1 quintal = 100 kg. 10 quintal = 1 ton. Kuch jagah dane ke liye; Pakistan mein maund (40 kg) zyada. 'Quintal per hectare' matlab 100 kg per hectare. Yield recommendation mein.

text: ergot bimari anaj mein kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Ergot anaj (gandum rye bajra) ki bimari jismein dane ki jagah kaala bada structure (sclerotium) zehr. Fungus. Insan janwar ke liye nuqsan. Saaf beej rotation khet ke gird ghaas kaat. Ergot ki chemical nahi; saaf beej nami mein phool na. Infected sar hataen.

text: mosaic virus fasal ki bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Mosaic virus bimari jismein patte peela hara patch streak (mosaic). Pauda chhota. Virus keera (chust) ya chhune se. Virus ka ilaaj paude mein nahi; resistant vector control infected hataen. Aaloo tamatar mirch. Virus field mein aaye to hataana mushkil.

text: vector bimari phailane wala kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Vector bimari phailane wala carrier—aksar keera: chust virus; to chust vector. Vector control (insecticide oil) se bimari failne kam. Har bimari ka vector nahi; hawa beej mitti. Vector jaan kar control.

text: roguing khet mein kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Roguing khet mein chal kar alag (off-type bimari jhari) paude nikaalna. Fasal ko pure rakne ke liye khass tor par beej. Paude ukharte ya kaat te. Beej quality bimari kam. Phool ya farq dikhe tab. Cultural practice.

text: off-type pauda kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Off-type pauda woh jo aapki variety se alag—length rang bal shape. Mixed beej volunteer ya cross. Beej production mein roguing se pure. Yield quality kam. Zyada off-type to beej impure; agli bar certified.

text: thousand grain weight kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Thousand grain weight (TGW) 1000 danon ka gram mein weight. Dane kitne barey bhari. Zyada TGW behtar bharai milling. Test weight se related. 1000 grain gin kar napein. Research variety TGW dete. Sahi kaatai grain fill stress na—achha TGW.

text: boom sprayer kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Boom sprayer mein lambi bar (boom) par kayi nozzle; ek pass mein chauri strip. Tractor se. Height speed theek ho to barabar coverage. Drift kam nozzle pressure hawa calm. Field crops ke liye aam.

text: economic threshold keera spray ki had kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Economic threshold woh hadd jahan control (spray) ki lagat bachne wali loss ke barabar. Practice mein jahan spray karna chahiye. Extension har pest ke liye deta (maslan 5–10 chust per tiller). Neeche spray faida nahi; upar na chhidkain to nuqsan. Threshold jaisa lekin economic wajah.

text: cultivar variety ka matlab kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Cultivar cultivated variety—naam wali variety jo insan ne chuni ya banayi. Variety jaisa. Har cultivar ka naam (Galaxy-2013 Faisalabad-2008). Resistant cultivar = resistant variety. Scientist formal naam ke liye cultivar.

text: inter-row hoeing lineon ke beech godai kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Inter-row hoeing lineon ke beech jhariyan kaatna aur zameen dheela karna hoe se. Fasal ke baad; jhariyan kaat aeration. Cultural weed control. Herbicide replace nahi lekin pressure kam. Lineon ke beech jagah chahiye. Makki kapas row crops.

text: residue retention bhoosa rehne dena kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Residue retention bhoosa stubble khet par rehne dena hataana jalaana nahi. Surface par ya thora mix. Nami bachati erosion kam organic matter. Conservation agriculture zero till. Happy seeder retained residue mein. Jalaen mat.

text: earlier-maturing variety jaldi pakne wali kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Earlier-maturing variety kam din mein pakne wali. Mausam chhota ho ya aakhir ki garmi sukha se bachna ho. Jaldi gandum peak garmi se pehle. Yield thori kam lekin fasal bachti. Bone date mausam ke hisaab.

text: mixed cropping dono faslen sath kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Mixed cropping do ya zyada faslen same khet same waqt bina strict lineon—aksar mix. Intercropping jaisi. Risk kam jagah khuraak. Gandum sarson makki lobia. Kaatai mazdoori plan. Purana amal.

text: nutrient deficiency symptom kami ki nishani kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Nutrient deficiency symptom paude ki woh nishani jab koi nutrient kam. N kami purane zard; zinc naye pe safed; K kinare brown. Symptom se andaaza kaun nutrient; phir woh khaad. Soil test patta confirm. Waqt par kami theek yield.

text: soil-borne disease mitti se bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil-borne disease woh bimari jiska pathogen mitti mein rehta jaden stem base se. Root rot wilt kuch blight. Rotation resistant saaf beej kabhi soil treatment. Hawa ya keere se farq. Mitti mein saalon tak; rotation resistance.

text: stale seedbed jhariyon ke liye kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Stale seedbed jhariyan kam karne ka tareeqa: tayari karein pani dein jhariyan ugen phir maaren (halki jot ya herbicide) bone se pehle. Jab boen kam beej. Bone se 1–2 haftay pehle. Cultural; post-emergence kam. Waqt ho to.

text: plant density paudon ki ghanai kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Plant density unit area (sq m acre) par kitne paude (tillers). Zyada density = zyada paude. Sahi density yield; zyada lodging bimari kam zameen zaya. Seed rate germination spacing. Recommendation target density.

text: irrigation schedule pani dene ka program kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Irrigation schedule pani kab kitna dene ka plan. Kitni dafa kaun se stage (crown root tillering booting grain fill). Crop zameen mausam. Critical miss na zyada na. Extension recommendation schedule; barish pani adjust.

text: pest pressure keeron ka zor kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Pest pressure keera bimari kitna maujood nuqsan kitna. Zyada pressure = zyada pest; action. Kam = spray shayad nahi. Mausam volunteer same crop se pressure. Scout threshold. Resistant saaf pressure kam.

text: crop canopy fasal ki chhaan kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop canopy fasal ki upar patton tanon ki layer jo zameen dhakti hai. Chhaan jaisa. Ghana canopy zameen shade (jhari evaporation kam) lekin kuch bimari (nami). Canopy size roshni yield. Spacing N.

text: tasseling makki ka stage kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Tasseling makki ka stage jab tassel (upar male phool) nikalta. Pollen tassel se. Pani critical; stress danon kam. Silking jab female (silks); pollination. Tasseling silking = makki ka phool. Is waqt pani stress na.

text: seed dressing beej treatment kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed dressing beej par chemical (fungicide insecticide) bone se pehle—seed treatment jaisa. Coat ya mix. Beej aur mitti se bachav. Dressing = treatment. Recommend product dose; sukha kar boen. Certified aksar dressed.

text: fodder charay wali fasal kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Fodder crop janwar ke charay ke liye—makki hara chara jwar oats berseem. Kaat kar gaay bakri. Grain main nahi. Fodder alag ya grain sath. Acha fodder protein yield. Fodder rotation zameen livestock.

text: grain moisture content dane ki nami kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Grain moisture content dane mein pani ka percentage. Meter ya sukha kar weight se. Store ke liye 12–14% ya kam; zyada keerey fungus. Kaatai par 20–25%; sukha kar store. Test weight storage rate. Kharedar check.

text: black layer makki ke dane mein kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Black layer makki ke dane ke base par kaali layer jab grain physiological maturity. Black layer ke baad dana aur dry matter nahi leta. Kaatai ka waqt. Kernel kaat kar dekhein; jahan jad thi. Black layer ke baad nami theek to kaatein.

text: dead heart chawal mein kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Dead heart chawal mein jab andar wala shoot (tiller) mar jata aur aasaan nikalta—andar zard sukha. Stem borer larva andar khata. Panicle nahi banta. Stem borer waqt par insecticide infested hataen. Resistant sanitation. Dead heart stem borer ki nishani.

text: white ear chawal ka nuqsan kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: White ear chawal mein jab bal (panicle) safed peela reh jata danay nahi ya kam. Stem borer (andar larva) ya stress. Panicle khaali. Yield kam. Stem borer theek karein phool grain fill par nutrition pani. Scout spray.

text: kanal zameen ka naap kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Kanal zameen ka naap Pakistan India mein. 1 acre = 8 kanal (Punjab); 1 kanal = 20 marla. Kuch ilaqe alag. Recommendation acre ya hectare; kanal se acre 8 se divide. 4 kanal = 0.5 acre.

text: acre zameen kitni hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Acre zameen ki ek unit; 1 acre = 4840 sq yard ya 0.4 hectare. Pakistan mein 1 acre = 8 kanal (Punjab). Per acre seed rate khaad yield. Recommendation per acre. Khet ka area acre ya kanal mein.

text: water stress pani ki kami kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Water stress pani ki kami ya zameen sukhi hone se paude ko jo nuqsan. Patton murjhana growth kam. Critical stage par zyada nuqsan. Pani dein mulch. Stress = pauda pani nahi le pa raha.

text: frost sardi se nuqsan kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Frost sardi se zameen aur hawa 0°C se neeche; pani jam jata. Naye paude nuqsan. Pehle light pani sardi se pehle. Frost ilaqe jaldi bone avoid. Resistant. Nuqsan zyada to insurance.

text: hail oala nuqsan kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Hail (oala) barf ke goley jo barish ke sath girte hain. Patton tanon nuqsan. Control nahi; report insurance. Photos. Nuqsan ke baad extra N na light pani. Hail forecast se thori tayari.

text: seed certification beej certificate kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed certification sarkari ya authorized agency beej test karke certify karti hai—purity germination disease-free. Certified beej packet par certification. Beej quality ka pakka. Apply karke certified len; quota. Truthfully labeled bhi ek level.

text: germination percentage ugalne ka percentage kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Germination percentage 100 beej mein se kitne ugte hain. 80% matlab 100 mein 80. Certified beej high germination. Purana beej kam. Stand ke liye important. Test karwa sakte hain.

text: bio pesticide natural dawai kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Bio pesticide natural source (pauda microbe) se bani dawai. Neem Bt. Chemical se safe. Keeron par; IPM. Zyada infestation mein chemical bhi. Expiry store.

text: contact insecticide surface par marni wali kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Contact insecticide woh jo sirf jahan lage wahan marta hai; paude ke andar nahi jati. Surface par coverage achha chahiye. Systemic se farq. Kuch keeron patte par; contact kaam. Rain dho sakti repeat.

text: broad spectrum insecticide sab keerey marni wali kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Broad spectrum insecticide woh jo kayi qism ke keeron ko marta hai—faida mand bhi. Selective se farq. Jab specific pest pehchan na ho ya zyada hon. IPM mein selective prefer; broad spectrum faida mand nuqsan.

text: spray coverage chhidkai ka cover kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Spray coverage matlab chhidkai kitni achhi tarah patton tanon par lagi. Achha coverage = har hissa bheega. Nozzle pressure height speed. Kam coverage bimari keera bach jate. Niche patte bhi. Coverage dekh kar spray.

text: label dawai ki bori par kya likha hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Label dawai ya khaad ki bori bottle par likhi instructions: dose kaise kab mixing waiting period re-entry. Label zaroor parhen follow karein. Ghalat dose nuqsan. Safety bhi label par.

text: fertilizer recommendation khaad ka mashwara kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Fertilizer recommendation khaad ka mashwara: kitni kab kaun si crop soil ke hisaab. Extension bulletin soil test. Recommendation follow yield bachat. Per acre per stage. General ya test ke baad.

text: disease severity bimari ki sakhti kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Disease severity har paude par bimari kitni sakht—kitna area nuqsan. Incidence se farq jo kitne paude. Severity zyada = zyada nuqsan per plant. Dono dekh kar spray decision.

text: host plant bimari ka pauda kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Host plant woh pauda jis par pathogen (bimari) rehta aur failta. Maslan gandum rust ka host. Volunteer host ban sakta. Host hataen ya resistant host len. Vector host se dusre tak.

text: secondary infection doosri bimari kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Secondary infection woh infection jo pehli (primary) ke baad hoti—jaise purane daag se naye daag. Fungus spread. Primary pehli jagah; secondary fail kar. Control jaldi primary par; secondary kam.

text: natural enemy keerey ka dushman kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Natural enemy keera ya bimari ka woh dushman jo use khata ya kam karta—predator parasitoid. Ladybird chust. Inhe bachayein selective spray threshold. Chemical inhe bhi marta.

text: pollinator phool se phool rangne wala kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Pollinator woh keera (machhi) jo phool se phool rang (pollen) le jata taake dana banay. Bee main. Phalon sabziyon ke liye zaroori. Pollinator nuqsan mat karein spray. Natural enemy jaisa.

text: soil fertility zameen ki mumi ki kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil fertility zameen ki woh taqat jo fasal ugaye aur paidawar de. Nutrients organic matter structure. Zyada fertility = behtar yield. FYM compost rotation fertility. Test se pata. Fertility barhane = zameen behtar.

text: nutrient uptake pauda khuraak kaise leta hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Nutrient uptake pauda ka jaden aur patton se khuraak lena. Jaden N P K pani ke sath; patte foliar. Uptake kam = kami. pH drainage moisture uptake par asar. Sahi khaad sahi waqt = uptake behtar.

text: What is silking stage in maize
label: term_explanation
answer: Silking is the stage in maize when the silks (long threads from the ear) appear and receive pollen from the tassel. It is the female flowering stage. Pollination happens when pollen falls on silks. Stress (drought, heat) at silking greatly reduces grain number. So silking is a critical stage for water. It comes after tasseling; both together are the flowering period of maize.

text: What is spikelet in wheat or rice
label: term_explanation
answer: Spikelet is the small unit that holds one or more florets (flowers) in wheat, rice, or sorghum. In wheat the ear is made of many spikelets in two rows; each spikelet can produce 2–5 grains. In rice the panicle has many spikelets. So spikelet is the small branch that bears the grain. More and bigger spikelets mean more grain. Good nutrition and water at booting and flowering improve spikelet number.

text: What is emergence in crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Emergence is when the young plant (seedling) first comes out of the soil and is visible. So it is the end of germination: the shoot has pushed through the soil. Days to emergence depend on depth, moisture, and temperature. Good emergence means uniform stand. If emergence is poor or patchy, check seed quality, depth, moisture, and soil crust. Emergence is counted in days after sowing (DAS).

text: What is borax for crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Borax is a source of boron used when soil or crop has boron deficiency. Boron is needed in small amount for flowering and grain set. You apply borax to soil or as foliar spray. Dose is small (e.g. 1–2 kg borax per acre); too much can be toxic. Soil test can confirm boron need. Boron deficiency is common in some soils; symptoms include poor grain set and dying growth points.

text: What is tillage meaning
label: term_explanation
answer: Tillage means preparing the soil by digging, turning, or breaking it—ploughing, harrowing, cultivating. It loosens soil, buries weeds and residue, and prepares seedbed. Full tillage = several ploughing and harrowing. Minimum tillage = fewer operations. Zero tillage = no tillage. Tillage affects soil structure, moisture, and cost. Too much tillage can harm soil; conservation agriculture reduces tillage.

text: What is parasitoid insect
label: term_explanation
answer: Parasitoid is an insect (e.g. small wasp) that lays its egg in or on another insect (the host); the young parasitoid feeds on the host and kills it. So it is a natural enemy of pests—like a parasite but it kills the host. Parasitoids help control pests without chemical. Broad-spectrum insecticide kills parasitoids too. In IPM we protect parasitoids by using selective spray and threshold. Parasitoid is a type of natural enemy.

text: What is weed resistance
label: term_explanation
answer: Weed resistance (or herbicide resistance) means that weeds no longer die from a herbicide that used to kill them. It happens when the same herbicide is used again and again; some weed plants survive and multiply. So the weed population becomes resistant. To avoid or manage: rotate herbicides with different mode of action, use other methods (hand weeding, crop rotation), and do not rely on one product only. Resistance is a growing problem.

text: What is infiltration in soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Infiltration is when water enters the soil from the surface and moves downward. Good infiltration means water soaks in instead of running off. It depends on soil structure, moisture, and cover. Hard or compacted soil has slow infiltration; water may run off. Organic matter and less tillage improve infiltration. If infiltration is poor, improve structure and avoid working soil when wet. Infiltration is the opposite of runoff.

text: What is water table
label: term_explanation
answer: Water table is the level below which the soil or rock is full of water (groundwater). Above the water table the soil has air in pores; below it is saturated. Shallow water table can cause waterlogging. Deep water table means you depend on rain or irrigation. Tube well pumps from below water table. In some areas water table is falling due to over-pumping. Water table depth affects crop and irrigation choice.

text: What is field capacity of soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Field capacity is the amount of water the soil can hold after excess has drained away (gravity drainage). It is the 'full' state of soil with water and air. After heavy rain or irrigation, soil reaches field capacity; then water drains. Plants can use water between field capacity and wilting point. It is used in irrigation scheduling. Sandy soil has low field capacity; clay has higher. It is a soil moisture term.

text: What is pollination in crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Pollination is when pollen from the male part (anther) reaches the female part (stigma) of the flower so that fertilisation can happen and grain or fruit can form. In maize wind carries pollen from tassel to silk. In many crops insects (bees) pollinate. Without pollination there is no grain. Stress (heat, rain) at flowering can harm pollination. Some crops self-pollinate; others need cross-pollination.

text: What is grain set
label: term_explanation
answer: Grain set (or grain setting) is when the flower is fertilised and the grain starts to form. So it is the stage right after pollination when the grain (caryopsis) begins to grow. Poor grain set means few grains per ear or panicle—due to stress at flowering, lack of pollination, or disease. Good water and nutrition at flowering improve grain set. It is one of the main yield components.

text: What is inoculum in disease
label: term_explanation
answer: Inoculum is the pathogen (fungus, bacteria, virus) or its spores that can start or spread disease. For example rust inoculum is the spore that lands on a leaf and starts infection. Inoculum can be in seed, soil, residue, or air. Reducing inoculum (clean seed, residue management, rotation) reduces disease. Once inoculum is high in the area, disease can spread fast. So inoculum is the 'source' of infection.

text: What is epidemic in crop disease
label: term_explanation
answer: Epidemic is when a disease spreads quickly and affects a large part of the crop or area. So many plants get diseased in a short time. It happens when there is enough inoculum, susceptible variety, and favourable weather (e.g. wet and warm for rust). To reduce epidemic risk: use resistant variety, reduce inoculum (clean seed, residue), and spray in time. Epidemic can cause big yield loss.

text: What is tolerance vs resistance
label: term_explanation
answer: Tolerance means the crop can bear the disease or stress and still give reasonable yield—it is damaged but not as much as a susceptible one. Resistance means the crop does not get the disease (or gets very little). So tolerant = suffers but yields; resistant = does not get it. For example drought-tolerant variety yields under water stress; resistant variety does not get the disease. Both are useful; resistance is stronger.

text: What is chelate fertilizer
label: term_explanation
answer: Chelate (or chelated) fertilizer is a form of micronutrient (e.g. iron, zinc) where the nutrient is bound to an organic molecule so it stays available in soil longer and is easier for the plant to take. In high-pH or alkaline soil normal micronutrient may get locked; chelate stays available. It is used for foliar or soil application. It is more expensive but useful when deficiency is hard to correct. Check label for crop and dose.

text: What is slow release fertilizer
label: term_explanation
answer: Slow release fertilizer is fertilizer that releases nutrients gradually over weeks or months instead of all at once. So the crop gets a steady supply and less is lost by leaching. It can be coated urea or other forms. It is useful where rain is heavy or irrigation is frequent. It can reduce the number of applications. Cost is often higher. It is also called controlled release or CRF.

text: What is humus in soil
label: term_explanation
answer: Humus is the dark, stable part of organic matter in soil that remains after decomposition. It is not raw plant or dung; it is well broken down. Humus holds water and nutrients, improves structure, and feeds soil life. It is built up by adding compost, FYM, and residue over years. Burning residue or too much tillage reduces humus. Good soil has a few percent humus. Humus is part of soil organic matter.

text: What is decomposition
label: term_explanation
answer: Decomposition is the breakdown of dead plant and animal material (residue, dung, roots) into simpler substances by microbes. The organic matter rots and releases nutrients and becomes humus. It needs moisture and air. Compost making is controlled decomposition. In the field, residue decomposes and feeds the soil. Too dry or too wet slows decomposition. Decomposition is a natural process that recycles nutrients.

text: What is contour farming
label: term_explanation
answer: Contour farming means doing tillage, planting, and rows along the contour (same height line) of the slope instead of up and down. So rows are horizontal on the slope. It reduces runoff and erosion because water does not run straight down. Contour bunds are small walls along the contour. It is used on sloping land. It saves soil and water. Contour is one of the ways to reduce erosion.

text: What is seed vigour
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed vigour means how strong and fast the seed can germinate and produce a healthy seedling. High vigour: quick, uniform emergence and strong early growth. Low vigour: slow or uneven emergence, weak seedlings. Old or poorly stored seed loses vigour. Vigour is different from germination percentage: two lots can have same germination but different vigour. Certified seed has good vigour. It affects stand and early growth.

text: What is seed purity
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed purity means the seed is only of the stated variety with no other crop seeds, weed seeds, or inert matter. Pure seed gives uniform crop. Impure seed has mixed variety or weeds. Seed certification checks purity. If you save your own seed, roguing and clean harvest improve purity. Purity is given as a percentage on the label. High purity is important for yield and quality.

text: What is irrigation efficiency
label: term_explanation
answer: Irrigation efficiency is how much of the water you apply is actually used by the crop (taken up or stored in root zone) and how much is lost (runoff, evaporation, deep drainage). High efficiency means less waste. Drip and sprinkler are often more efficient than flood. Leveling, beds, and good timing also improve efficiency. Efficiency is important when water is scarce or costly.

text: What is biomass in crop
label: term_explanation
answer: Biomass is the total weight of the plant (or crop) — roots, stem, leaves, grain — usually expressed as dry weight (after drying to remove water). So it is all the matter the crop has produced. Grain yield is part of biomass. Harvest index = grain / total biomass. More biomass with good harvest index gives more grain. Biomass is measured in research and sometimes in recommendation.

text: What is dry matter
label: term_explanation
answer: Dry matter is the weight of the plant or grain after all water has been removed (by drying in an oven). So it is the solid part. Fresh weight includes water; dry matter does not. Yield and biomass are often given as dry matter. Grain at harvest has 10–20% water, so 80–90% dry matter. Dry matter is used to compare yield and quality without the effect of moisture.

text: What is growth stage
label: term_explanation
answer: Growth stage is a defined phase in the life of the crop, e.g. seedling, tillering, booting, flowering, grain filling, maturity. Each stage has a number or name (e.g. Zadoks scale in wheat). Knowing growth stage helps in timing irrigation, fertilizer, and spray. Recommendation often says 'at stage X do Y'. Growth stage is also called development stage or phenological stage.

text: What is phenology
label: term_explanation
answer: Phenology is the study of the timing of growth stages (e.g. when does flowering occur). In farming it means the calendar of stages: when the crop emerges, tillers, flowers, and matures. It depends on variety, sowing date, and weather. Phenology helps plan irrigation and harvest. For example 'this variety flowers in 90 days'. So phenology = the sequence and timing of stages.

text: What is herbicide resistance
label: term_explanation
answer: Herbicide resistance is when weeds survive a herbicide that used to kill them—the same as weed resistance. It develops when the same herbicide (or same mode of action) is used repeatedly; resistant weeds multiply. To slow it: rotate herbicides with different mode of action, use non-chemical methods, and follow label. Herbicide resistance is a major problem in many areas. Once present, that herbicide is less useful.

text: What is cultural control of pest
label: term_explanation
answer: Cultural control means controlling pests (insects, diseases, weeds) by farm practices rather than by chemical. Examples: crop rotation, clean seed, removing residue, proper spacing, resistant variety, hand weeding, tillage, destroying volunteer plants. It is part of IPM. It can reduce the need for pesticide. It does not always give full control but it is the first step. Combine with other methods when needed.

text: What is chemical control
label: term_explanation
answer: Chemical control means controlling pests (insects, diseases, weeds) by using pesticides—insecticide, fungicide, herbicide. It is fast and effective but can have cost, resistance, and safety issues. In IPM, chemical is used when needed (after threshold) and with the right product and dose. Chemical control is one of the options; cultural and biological are others. Always follow label for safety and effectiveness.

text: What is crop monitoring
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop monitoring means regularly checking the crop and field for growth, pests, disease, weeds, water stress, and nutrient status. It is the same as scouting. You walk the field, look at plants, and note problems. It is the first step in IPM and good management. Without monitoring you may act too late or spray when not needed. Record what you see. Extension often recommends how often to monitor (e.g. weekly).

text: What is kharif season
label: term_explanation
answer: Kharif season is the rainy or summer cropping season. In South Asia it is roughly April–May to September–October when monsoon rains come. Crops like rice, maize, cotton, mung, sugarcane are kharif. Sowing is often at the start of rains. It is the opposite of rabi (winter season). Exact dates vary by region. Kharif crops need more water and heat.

text: What is rabi season
label: term_explanation
answer: Rabi season is the winter cropping season. In South Asia it is roughly October–November to March–April. Crops like wheat, barley, chickpea, mustard, potato are rabi. Sowing is in autumn after kharif harvest. Cool and often irrigated. It is the opposite of kharif. Rabi is the main wheat season in Pakistan. Timely sowing is important for rabi.

text: What is minimum support price MSP
label: term_explanation
answer: Minimum support price (MSP) is the same as support price: the minimum price the government promises to pay for a crop when farmers sell at procurement centers. So it is the floor price. It is announced before the season. MSP helps farmers when market price is low. In India the term MSP is common; in Pakistan support price or procurement price is used. It is a policy tool to support farmers.

text: What is crop loan
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop loan is a loan given to the farmer for the crop season—to buy seed, fertilizer, pesticide, or meet other crop expenses. The bank or cooperative gives the loan; the farmer repays after harvest. Government schemes sometimes offer low-interest or interest-free crop loans. You need land record and identity. Crop loan helps when the farmer has no cash at sowing time. Agri office and banks have details.

text: What is insurance premium
label: term_explanation
answer: Insurance premium is the amount the farmer (or government on behalf of farmer) pays to the insurance company for crop insurance. So it is the cost of the insurance. If the crop is lost (e.g. flood, drought, hail), the farmer can claim and get compensation. Part of the premium may be paid by the government in some schemes. Premium depends on sum insured and crop. Pay premium on time to keep policy valid.

text: What is seed quota
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed quota is the limit or amount of certified or subsidised seed a farmer can get in a season. The government or scheme sets how much seed per farmer or per acre. So there is a maximum you can buy at subsidised rate or from a scheme. Quota is to make sure more farmers get seed. Apply in time; quota may run out. Agri office or dealer can tell the quota and how to apply.

text: What is fertilizer subsidy
label: term_explanation
answer: Fertilizer subsidy is the financial support the government gives so that fertilizer is sold to farmers at a price lower than the market. So the farmer pays less; the government bears part of the cost. It is to help farmers use enough fertilizer. There may be a limit (quota) per farmer. Get fertilizer from authorised dealers; keep documents. Subsidy policy can change each year.

text: What is node and internode
label: term_explanation
answer: Node is the point on the stem where a leaf or branch is attached. Internode is the part of the stem between two nodes. So the stem is made of nodes and internodes. In wheat, tillers come from the base (lower nodes). In maize, nodes are clearly visible. Length of internode affects plant height. Node is also where some diseases enter. So node = joint; internode = segment between joints.

text: What is floret in wheat
label: term_explanation
answer: Floret is the small individual flower inside the spikelet. In wheat each spikelet has 2–9 florets; each floret can produce one grain. So floret is the unit that becomes a grain after pollination. Not all florets set grain; good conditions at flowering increase grain per spikelet. Floret is the same as 'flower' in the grass crop. In wheat the ear has many spikelets and each spikelet has florets.

text: silking makki ka stage kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
