answer: Silking makki ka woh stage hai jab silks (kaan se nikle lambay baal) dikhte hain aur tassel se pollen lete hain. Female flowering. Pollination jab pollen silks par girta. Silking par stress (sukha garmi) danon ki tadad kam. Is liye silking pani ke liye critical. Tasseling ke baad; dono milkar makki ka phool.

text: spikelet gandum chawal mein kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Spikelet chhota unit hai jismein ek ya zyada florets (phool) gandum chawal jwar mein. Gandum ke bal mein kayi spikelets do line mein; har spikelet 2–5 dane. Chawal ke panicle mein spikelets. To spikelet woh chhoti shaakh jis par dana lagta. Zyada barey spikelets zyada dana. Booting flowering par nutrition pani.

text: emergence ugalna crop mein kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Emergence jab chhota pauda pehli dafa zameen se bahar aata dikhai deta. Germination ka end: shoot zameen se nikla. Gehrayi nami garmi se din. Acha emergence = barabar stand. Emergence kharab to beej quality gehrayi nami crust check. DAS mein ginte hain.

text: borax boron ki dawai kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Borax boron ka source jab boron kami ho. Boron phool aur grain set ke liye chhoti miqdar. Zameen ya foliar. Dose chhoti (1–2 kg borax per acre); zyada zehr. Soil test confirm. Boron kami kuch zameen; grain set kam growth points maren.

text: tillage jot ka matlab kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Tillage zameen ko jotna palatna torna—jot sulah cultivation. Zameen dheeli jhariyan residue daba seedbed. Full tillage kayi jot sulah. Minimum kam. Zero tillage nahi. Tillage structure nami lagat. Zyada tillage nuqsan; conservation agriculture kam tillage.

text: parasitoid keera kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Parasitoid chhota wasp jaisa keera jo doosre keere (host) mein anda deta; bachha host ko kha kar marta. Pest ka natural enemy. Chemical ke bina. Broad spectrum parasitoid bhi marta. IPM mein selective threshold. Natural enemy ki qism.

text: weed resistance jhariyan spray se na marna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Weed resistance (herbicide resistance) jab jhariyan woh herbicide se nahi marti jo pehle marti thi. Wahi bar bar use; kuch jhariyan bach kar barhen. Resistant: alag mode rotate hand rotation. Ek product par na. Resistance barhta masla.

text: infiltration zameen mein pani ka andar jana kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Infiltration pani ka zameen ki surface se andar neeche jana. Achi infiltration = pani soak behav nahi. Structure nami cover. Sakht zameen slow; runoff. Organic matter kam tillage. Infiltration kharab to structure gili zameen par kaam na.

text: water table pani ki teh kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Water table neeche woh level jahan zameen pani se bhari (groundwater). Upar hawa; neeche saturated. Shallow water table waterlogging. Deep = barish irrigation. Tube well water table se. Kuch jagah over-pump se neeche. Water table crop irrigation choice.

text: field capacity zameen kitna pani pakadti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Field capacity zameen ke andar pani ka woh hadd jo drain hone ke baad reh jata hai. Pani aur hawa dono. Barish irrigation ke baad field capacity; phir drain. Pauda field capacity se wilting point tak pani use. Irrigation schedule. Raiti kam chikni zyada.

text: pollination phool se dana kaise banta hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Pollination jab male (anther) ka pollen female (stigma) tak pahunche taake fertilisation ho aur dana banay. Makki mein hawa tassel se silk tak. Kayi faslon mein machhi. Pollination na ho to dana nahi. Phool par stress nuqsan. Kuch self kuch cross.

text: grain set dana kaise lagta hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Grain set jab phool fertilise ho kar dana banna shuru. Pollination ke turant baad. Kam grain set = kam danay—phool par stress pollination kami bimari. Phool par pani nutrition. Yield ka hissa.

text: inoculum bimari ka jarasim kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Inoculum pathogen ya us ke spores jo bimari shuru ya failate hain. Rust inoculum = spore jo patte par. Inoculum beej mitti residue hawa. Inoculum kam (saaf beej residue rotation) bimari kam. Ilaqe mein zyada to tez fail. Inoculum = infection ka source.

text: epidemic bimari ka failna kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Epidemic jab bimari tez fail kar zyada fasal ya ilaqa affect. Kayi paude chhoti mudat mein. Inoculum susceptible variety mausam (nami garmi). Risk kam: resistant inoculum kam (saaf beej residue) jald spray. Epidemic bara nuqsan.

text: tolerance resistant se farq kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Tolerance matlab fasal bimari ya stress sah leti hai phir bhi theek yield—nuqsan lekin susceptible se kam. Resistance = bimari lagti hi nahi. Tolerant = nuqsan lekin yield; resistant = lagti nahi. Drought tolerant sukha mein yield; resistant bimari nahi. Dono mufeed.

text: chelate khaad kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Chelate (chelated) micronutrient (iron zinc) ka woh form jismein nutrient organic molecule se juda taake zameen mein available rahe aur pauda le. High pH mein normal lock; chelate available. Foliar ya soil. Mehenga lekin kami mushkil ho to. Crop dose label.

text: slow release fertilizer kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Slow release fertilizer woh jo nutrients dheere dheere hafton mahine deti hai ek sath nahi. Steady supply leaching kam. Coated urea waghaira. Barish zyada irrigation mein. Applications kam. Lagat zyada. Controlled release CRF.

text: humus zameen mein kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Humus zameen ki organic matter ka woh stable kaala hissa jo decomposition ke baad rehta. Raw plant gobar nahi; gal chuka. Pani nutrients pakadta structure. Compost FYM residue saalon se. Residue jalaana zyada tillage humus kam. Achi zameen mein kuch percent. Organic matter ka hissa.

text: decomposition galna kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Decomposition murde paude janwaron (residue gobar jaden) ka microbes se tootna. Organic matter sada hota nutrients humus. Nami hawa. Compost controlled decomposition. Khet mein residue galta. Zyada sukha gili slow. Natural process jo nutrients recycle.

text: contour farming dhal par kheti kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Contour farming dhal par jot bone lineen contour (same height) ke sath—upar neeche nahi. Rows horizontal. Runoff erosion kam. Contour bund contour par chhoti deewar. Dhal wali zameen. Mitti pani bachta.

text: seed vigour beej ki taqat kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed vigour beej ki woh taqat jo jaldi mazboot germination aur seedling deti. High vigour: jaldi barabar emergence mazboot. Low: der ya kamzor. Purana kharab storage vigour kam. Germination % se farq; dono same ho vigour alag. Certified achha vigour. Stand shuruat.

text: seed purity beej ki safai kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed purity beej sirf us variety ka bina doosri fasal jhari. Pure = uniform. Impure = mix. Certification purity check. Apna beej roguing saaf kaatai. Label par percentage. Purity yield quality.

text: irrigation efficiency pani ka istemal kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Irrigation efficiency kitna pani crop istemal karta kitna zaya (runoff evaporation drainage). Zyada efficiency = kam zaya. Drip sprinkler flood se zyada efficient. Leveling beds timing. Pani kam mehenga ho to.

text: biomass fasal ka total wazan kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Biomass paude (fasal) ka total wazan—jaden tana patta dana—dry weight. Saara matter. Grain yield biomass ka hissa. Harvest index = grain/total biomass. Zyada biomass acha index = zyada grain. Research mein.

text: dry matter sukha hissa kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Dry matter paude ya dane ka wazan pani hata kar (oven). Solid hissa. Fresh weight mein pani. Yield biomass dry matter. Kaatai par 10–20% pani 80–90% dry. Nami ka asar bina compare.

text: growth stage barhne ka stage kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Growth stage fasal ki zindagi ka phase: seedling tillering booting flowering grain fill maturity. Har stage number naam (Zadoks). Stage jaan kar pani khaad spray. Recommendation 'stage X par Y'. Development stage phenological stage.

text: phenology fasal ki stages kya hoti hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Phenology stages ka waqt—kab phool kab pakka. Kheti mein stages ka calendar: kab ugalna tillering phool. Variety bone mausam. Irrigation kaatai plan. 'Ye variety 90 din mein phool'. Sequence aur waqt.

text: herbicide resistance jhari spray se bach jati hai kya
label: term_explanation
answer: Herbicide resistance jhariyan herbicide se bach jati hain—weed resistance jaisa. Wahi ya same mode bar bar; resistant barhen. Slow: alag mode rotate non-chemical label. Herbicide resistance bara masla. Ho to woh herbicide kam kaam.

text: cultural control bina chemical ke control kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Cultural control pest ko kheti amal se—chemical nahi. Rotation saaf beej residue spacing resistant hand tillage volunteer. IPM ka hissa. Pesticide kam. Full control hamesha nahi pehla step. Doosre sath.

text: chemical control dawai se control kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Chemical control pesticide se—insecticide fungicide herbicide. Tez asar lekin lagat resistance safety. IPM mein zarurat (threshold) sahi product dose. Ek option; cultural biological doosre. Label safety.

text: crop monitoring fasal check karna kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop monitoring fasal khet regular check—growth pest bimari jhari pani nutrient. Scouting jaisa. Khet chal kar dekhein note. IPM pehla step. Bina monitoring der ya bekar spray. Record. Extension kitni dafa.

text: kharif mausam kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Kharif mausam barish garmi ka. South Asia April–May se Sep–Oct monsoon. Chawal makki kapas mung ganna. Barish shuru par bone. Rabi ka ulta. Ilaqa se farq. Kharif ko zyada pani garmi.

text: rabi mausam kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Rabi mausam sardi ka. Oct–Nov se March–April. Gandum jau chana sarson aaloo. Kharif kattai ke baad bone. Thanda aksar irrigated. Kharif ka ulta. Pakistan mein gandum rabi. Waqt par bone zaroori.

text: MSP minimum support price kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: MSP (minimum support price) = support price: sarkar kam az kam ye rate degi procurement par. Floor price. Mausam se pehle. Bazar kam ho to madad. India MSP Pakistan support price procurement price.

text: crop loan fasal ka karz kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Crop loan fasal ke mausam ke liye—beej khaad pesticide. Bank cooperative deta; kaatai ke baad adaa. Scheme mein kam sood. Zameen pehchan. Sowing par paisa na ho to. Agri bank.

text: insurance premium bima ki qeemat kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Insurance premium woh raqam jo kisan (ya sarkar) company ko bima ke liye deta. Bima ki qeemat. Nuqsan (barish sukha oala) par claim compensation. Scheme mein sarkar hissa. Sum insured crop. Waqt par premium policy.

text: seed quota beej ki hadd kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Seed quota certified ya subsidised beej ki hadd jo kisan ko ek mausam mein mil sakti. Sarkar scheme per farmer ya per acre. Maximum subsidised. Zyada kisan ko beej. Waqt par apply; quota khatam. Agri dealer.

text: fertilizer subsidy khaad par sarkari madad kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Fertilizer subsidy sarkar ki madad taake khaad sasti mile. Kisan kam de sarkar hissa. Khaad zyada istemal. Quota ho sakta. Authorised dealer documents. Har saal change.

text: node internode tane par kya hote hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Node tane par woh point jahan patta ya shaakh. Internode do nodes ke beech. Tana nodes internodes. Gandum mein tillers neeche nodes se. Makki mein node clear. Internode length height. Node se bimari andar. Node = joint internode = beech ka hissa.

text: floret gandum ke bal mein kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Floret spikelet ke andar chhota phool. Gandum mein har spikelet 2–9 florets; har floret ek dana. Floret = woh unit jo pollination ke baad dana. Sab florets dana nahi; phool par achi halat. Floret = ghaas ka phool. Bal mein spikelets spikelet mein florets.

text: husk dane ka chhilka kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Husk dane ka bahar ka patla cover—chhilka. Kaatne ke baad grain alag to husk chaff. Rice ka husk bhoosi; andar chawal. Winnowing ya combine husk alag. Clean grain kam husk. Husk = chhilka bhoosi.

text: pupa keerey ka stage kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Pupa keerey ka woh stage jab larva andar se badal kar adult ban raha—sakt cover mein. Larva ke baad adult se pehle. Is stage par keera move nahi karta; andar change. Pupa ke baad adult nikalta. Lifecycle: anda larva pupa adult.

text: primary infection pehli bimari kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Primary infection pehli infection jab pathogen paude par pehli dafa lagta. Secondary infection purani jagah se nayi jagah. Primary control karein to secondary kam. Fungus primary se failta. Jaldi primary rokain.

text: lesion patte pe daag kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Lesion patte ya tane par bimari ka daag—marta hua tissue. Brown grey kaala. Rust blight spot sab mein lesion. Size shape bimari. Lesion zyada = zyada bimari. Pehchan kar bimari.

text: pustule zang pe danay kya hote hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Pustule zang jaisi bimari mein patte tanon par powder jaisi chhoti goliyan—fungus ke spores. Peeli zang stripe rust mein pustulen nas ke sath. Pustule phut kar spores nikalte. Rust ki pehchan. Fungicide pustule pe control.

text: spore fungus ka beej kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Spore fungus ka woh hissa jo hawa pani se fail kar nayi jagah bimari shuru karta—beej jaisa. Rust ke spores patte se. Spore chhota; microscope se dikhta. Inoculum ka hissa. Spores kam = bimari kam. Residue saaf beej treatment.

text: wilt disease murjhana bimari kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Wilt disease woh bimari jismein pauda murjha kar sookh jata—jaden ya neeche ka tana fungus bacteria se. Pauda pani nahi le pata. Wilting symptom. Control: resistant variety rotation saaf beej drainage. Wilt tez fail sakti.

text: outbreak bimari ka phootna kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Outbreak bimari ka achanak zyada phailna—kayi paude chhoti mudat mein. Epidemic jaisa. Inoculum mausam susceptible. Outbreak par jald spray resistant. Report bhi karein.

text: rodenticide chooha marni dawai kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Rodenticide chooha marni wali dawai. Poison bait trap. Chooha grain khet nuqsan. Safe jagah bachon janwar door. Storage khet dono. Label follow. Rodent = chooha.

text: fumigant fumigation ki dawai kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Fumigant woh chemical jo fumigation mein use hota hai—gas ban kar keeron ko marta. Store band karke chhoden. Phosphine aluminium phosphide aam. Label safety. Bachon janwar door. Fumigation = process fumigant = dawai.

text: impurity dane mein gandagi kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Impurity dane mein woh cheez jo grain nahi—gandagi pathar doosri faslen toota. Dockage foreign matter jaisa. Kam impurity behtar rate. Saaf karein grade. Quality parameter. Zyada impurity reject.

text: quality parameter dane ki quality kaise naapte hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Quality parameter woh cheezein jis se dane ki quality naapte hain: test weight moisture dockage size colour. Mills kharedar in se rate. Behtar parameter = zyada rate. Grading quality par. Storage harvest quality.

text: advisory mashwara kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Advisory mashwara jo extension department app ya worker deta—kab boen kitna khaad kaunsi dawai. Recommendation jaisa. Advisory mausam ilaqa ke hisaab. Follow karein. Radio SMS app advisory.

text: demonstration field trial kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Demonstration (field trial) woh khet jahan nayi variety ya tareeqa kisan ko dikhane ke liye ugaya jata. Research station ya extension. Compare purana naya. Dikh kar seekhna. Trial se pata naya kaam karega ya nahi.

text: variety release nayi variety ka aana kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Variety release jab sarkar research station nayi variety approve karke kisan ke liye jari karti. Test ke baad. Naam number. List mein aati. Nahi release to beej legally bika nahi. Release ke baad certified beej.

text: eligibility scheme ke liye kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Eligibility scheme (subsidy loan insurance) ke liye woh shartain jo kisan ko puri karni—zameen paisa limit. Eligible ho to apply. Documents. Agri office scheme ki eligibility batata. Puri na hon to milega nahi.

text: soil organism zameen mein rehne wale kya hote hain
label: term_explanation
answer: Soil organism zameen mein rehne wale—kechwaye bacteria fungus chhotay keerey. Organic matter khate. Structure behtar. Zyada chemical tillage inhe nuqsan. Healthy zameen = zyada organisms. Decomposition inhi se.

text: nitrification zameen mein nitrogen ka badalna kya hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Nitrification zameen mein nitrogen ka ammonia se nitrate mein badalna—bacteria se. Nitrate paude lete hain. Nitrification ke baad N plant use ya leach. Wet warm zameen nitrification. Lime acidic zameen nitrification.

text: denitrification nitrogen ka loss kya hota hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Denitrification zameen se nitrogen ka gas ban kar hawa mein chala jana—bacteria se. N loss. Waterlogging zameen denitrification. Is liye gili zameen par urea zaya. Drainage denitrification kam. N cycle ka hissa.

text: perennial fasal saal bhar wali kya hoti hai
label: term_explanation
answer: Perennial fasal woh jo ek se zyada saal ugti rehti—kaatne ke baad phir ugti. Ganna alfalfa kuch fodder. Annual se farq jo ek mausam. Perennial ko zyada waqt; beej kam. Ratoon perennial jaisi.
